local function textWidth(text, size, font)
    local ok, w = pcall(function()
        return TextService:GetTextSize(text, size, font, Vector2.new(10000, 100)).X
    end)
    if ok and w and w > 0 then
        return math.ceil(w)
    end
    return math.ceil(# text * size * 0.55) + 2
end

local function _kbActionName(k)
    local pretty = {
        AutoBat = "Bat Aimbot",
        SpeedToggle = "Carry Mode",
        LaggerToggle = "Lagger Mode",
        InfiniteJump = "Infinite Jump",
        UIToggle = "UI Toggle",
        DropBrainrot = "Drop Brainrot",
        TPDown = "TP Down",
        LaggerSpeed = "Lagger Speed",
        NormalSpeed = "Normal Speed",
        InstaReset = "Insta Reset",
        AutoLeft = "Auto Left",
        AutoRight = "Auto Right",
    }
    return pretty[k] or k
end
local function _kbConflict(kc, selfKey)
    if not kc or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
        return nil
    end
    for k, v in pairs(Keybinds) do
        if k ~= selfKey and v == kc then
            return _kbActionName(k)
        end
    end
    local ap = _G._AdaptAPKeybinds
    if type(ap) == "table" then
        for k, v in pairs(ap) do
            if k ~= selfKey and v == kc then
                return _kbActionName(k)
            end
        end
    end
    if selfKey ~= "InstaReset" and _G._VynxInstaResetKey == kc.Name then
        return _kbActionName("InstaReset")
    end
    return nil
end
_G._AdaptKeybindConflict = _kbConflict

    [Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1] = true,
    [Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2] = true,
    [Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3] = true,
    [Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4] = true,
    [Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad5] = true,
    [Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad6] = true,
    [Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad7] = true,
    [Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad8] = true,
}
local function _isGamepadInput(input)
    return input ~= nil and GAMEPAD_TYPES[input.UserInputType] == true
end
local function _isBindableInput(input)
    if input == nil then
        return false
    end
    return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or _isGamepadInput(input)
end

local Spd = {
    family = "normal",
    carry = false
}
_G._VioletteccSpd = Spd
Spd.Refresh = function()
end
function Spd.Values()
    if Spd.family == "lagger" then
        return tonumber(_G.LaggerSpeed_Normal) or 50, tonumber(_G.LaggerSpeed_Carry) or 25
    end
    return tonumber(_G.NormalSpeed_Normal) or 60, tonumber(_G.NormalSpeed_Carry) or 29
end
function Spd.SetProfile(family, carrying)
    Spd.family =(family == "lagger") and family or "normal"
    Spd.carry = carrying and true or false
    local char = LocalPlayer and LocalPlayer.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hum then
        hum.PlatformStand = false;
        hum.AutoRotate = true
    end
    if root then
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end
    Spd.Refresh()
    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
    end
end
function Spd.Method()
    return "V2"
end
function Spd.Carry()
    _G._VynxCarryUserOverride = true
    if Spd.Method() == "V2" then
        return Spd.SetProfile(Spd.family, not Spd.carry)
    end
    if Spd.family ~= "normal" then
        return Spd.SetProfile("normal", true)
    end
    return Spd.SetProfile("normal", not Spd.carry)
end
function Spd.Family(fam)
    _G._VynxCarryUserOverride = true
    if Spd.Method() == "V2" then
        if Spd.family == fam then
            return Spd.SetProfile("normal", false)
        end
        return Spd.SetProfile(fam, false)
    end
    if Spd.family ~= fam then
        return Spd.SetProfile(fam, Spd.carry)
    end
    return Spd.SetProfile(fam, not Spd.carry)
end
function Spd.Lagger()
    return Spd.Family("lagger")
end
function Spd.Normal()
    _G._VynxCarryUserOverride = true
    if Spd.Method() == "V2" then
        return Spd.SetProfile(Spd.family, not Spd.carry)
    end
    if Spd.family ~= "normal" then
        return Spd.SetProfile("normal", Spd.carry)
    end
    return Spd.SetProfile("normal", not Spd.carry)
end
function Spd.Button(fam, wantCarry)
    _G._VynxCarryUserOverride = true
    if fam == "desync" or fam == "custom" then
        fam = "normal"
    end
    wantCarry = wantCarry and true or false
    if Spd.family == fam and Spd.carry == wantCarry and not(fam == "normal" and not wantCarry) then
        return Spd.SetProfile("normal", false)
    end
    return Spd.SetProfile(fam, wantCarry)
end

local function _formatSpeed(v)
    if type(v) ~= "number" then
        return tostring(v)
    end
    return(v == math.floor(v)) and tostring(math.floor(v)) or string.format("%.1f", v)
end

    -- LIGHT HUB cover is embedded below, so this is a single-file script.
    -- It writes the bundled image locally, then loads it through the executor asset API.
    do
        local COVER_FILE = "LIGHT_HUB_COVER.jpg"
        local COVER_BASE64 = [[

        ]]

        local function decodeBase64(data)
            local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
            local output = {}
            data = data:gsub("[^%w%+/%=]", "")

            for i = 1, #data, 4 do
                local c1 = data:sub(i, i)
                local c2 = data:sub(i + 1, i + 1)
                local c3 = data:sub(i + 2, i + 2)
                local c4 = data:sub(i + 3, i + 3)
                if c1 == "" or c2 == "" then break end

                local a = alphabet:find(c1, 1, true)
                local b = alphabet:find(c2, 1, true)
                if not a or not b then break end
                a, b = a - 1, b - 1

                local c = (c3 ~= "" and c3 ~= "=") and alphabet:find(c3, 1, true) or nil
                local d = (c4 ~= "" and c4 ~= "=") and alphabet:find(c4, 1, true) or nil
                if c then c = c - 1 end
                if d then d = d - 1 end

                output[#output + 1] = string.char(a * 4 + math.floor(b / 16))
                if c ~= nil then
                    output[#output + 1] = string.char((b % 16) * 16 + math.floor(c / 4))
                end
                if d ~= nil and c ~= nil then
                    output[#output + 1] = string.char((c % 4) * 64 + d)
                end
            end

            return table.concat(output)
        end

        local coverReady = false
        if type(writefile) == "function" then
            local okWrite = pcall(function()
                writefile(COVER_FILE, decodeBase64(COVER_BASE64))
            end)
            coverReady = okWrite
        end

        local assetLoader = getcustomasset or getsynasset
        if type(assetLoader) == "function" then
            local okAsset, assetUri = pcall(assetLoader, COVER_FILE)
            if okAsset and type(assetUri) == "string" and assetUri ~= "" then
                lordHubMainArtwork.Image = assetUri
                lordHubMainArtwork.Visible = true
            else
                lordHubMainArtwork.Visible = false
                warn("[LIGHT HUB] Could not load the embedded cover. Check executor file/asset permissions.")
            end
        else
            lordHubMainArtwork.Visible = false
            warn("[LIGHT HUB] This executor needs getcustomasset/getsynasset to display the embedded cover.")
        end
    end

            panelPop.Scale = 1
            _hubShown = true
            if reopenBtn and reopenBtn.Parent then
                reopenBtn.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end

    _G._VioletteccApplyLogoTheme = function(img, accent, instant)
        if not(img and img.Parent) then
            return
        end
        local ids = _G._VioletteccLogoIds
        local best, bestD = "Purple", math.huge
        for name, col in pairs(_G._VioletteccLogoThemeColors) do
            local d =(col.R - accent.R) ^ 2 +(col.G - accent.G) ^ 2 +(col.B - accent.B) ^ 2
            if d < bestD then
                best, bestD = name, d
            end
        end
        local id = ids[best]
        local hasArt = type(id) == "string" and id ~= ""
        img.Image = "rbxassetid://" ..(hasArt and id or ids.Purple)
        local color = hasArt and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or _G._VezyLogoTintFor(accent)
        if instant then
            img.ImageColor3 = color
        else
            TweenService:Create(img, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
                ImageColor3 = color
            }):Play()
        end
    end

        v = math.clamp(v or 1, 0, 1)
        _G._VezyBtnOpacity = v
        if not innerPanel then
            return
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(innerPanel:GetDescendants()) do
            if not _skipNames[d.Name] and(d:IsA("Frame") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("ImageButton")) then
                if _originalBgTrans[d] == nil then
                    _originalBgTrans[d] = d.BackgroundTransparency
                end
                local orig = _originalBgTrans[d]
                if orig < 0.95 then
                    d.BackgroundTransparency = orig +(1 - orig) *(1 - v)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    _G.VezySetBtnColor = function(color)
        _G._VezyBtnColor = color
        if not innerPanel then
            return
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(innerPanel:GetDescendants()) do
            if not _skipNames[d.Name] and d:IsA("Frame") and not d:IsA("ScrollingFrame") and d.Parent ~= innerPanel then
                if _originalBgColor[d] == nil then
                    _originalBgColor[d] = d.BackgroundColor3
                end
                local orig = _originalBgColor[d]
                local r, g, b = orig.R, orig.G, orig.B
                local brightness =(r + g + b) / 3
                if brightness < 0.25 then
                    d.BackgroundColor3 = color
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function searchPage(page, query)
        if not page then
            return 0
        end
        query = string.lower(query or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        local children = {}
        local matchedGroups = {}
        for _, item in ipairs(page:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("GuiObject") and item.Name ~= "UIListLayout" and item.Name ~= "UIPadding" then
                table.insert(children, item)
                if query ~= "" and not item:GetAttribute("SearchGroupOption") then
                    local parts = {}
                    if item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") or item:IsA("TextBox") then
                        table.insert(parts, item.Text or "")
                    end
                    for _, child in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                        if child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton") or child:IsA("TextBox") then
                            table.insert(parts, child.Text or "")
                        end
                    end
                    if string.find(string.lower(table.concat(parts, " ")), query, 1, true) then
                        local group = item:GetAttribute("SearchGroup")
                        if group then
                            matchedGroups[group] = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local matchCount = 0
        for _, item in ipairs(children) do
            local group = item:GetAttribute("SearchGroup")
            local isOption = item:GetAttribute("SearchGroupOption") == true
            local matches =(query == "")
            if query ~= "" then
                if isOption and group and matchedGroups[group] then
                    matches = true
                elseif not isOption then
                    local parts = {}
                    if item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") or item:IsA("TextBox") then
                        table.insert(parts, item.Text or "")
                    end
                    for _, child in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                        if child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton") or child:IsA("TextBox") then
                            table.insert(parts, child.Text or "")
                        end
                    end
                    matches = string.find(string.lower(table.concat(parts, " ")), query, 1, true) ~= nil
                else
                    local parts = {}
                    for _, child in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
                        if child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("TextButton") or child:IsA("TextBox") then
                            table.insert(parts, child.Text or "")
                        end
                    end
                    matches = string.find(string.lower(table.concat(parts, " ")), query, 1, true) ~= nil
                end
            end
            item.Visible = matches
            if matches then
                matchCount = matchCount + 1
            end
        end
        return matchCount
    end
    local function refreshPageSearch()
        local query = string.lower(searchBox.Text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
        if query == "" then
            for name, page in pairs(tabPages) do
                searchPage(page, "")
                page.Visible =(name == currentTab)
            end
        else
            for _, page in pairs(tabPages) do
                local matches = searchPage(page, query)
                page.Visible = matches > 0
            end
        end
    end
    searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(refreshPageSearch)

    local function switchTab(name)
        currentTab = name
        for tn, pg in pairs(tabPages) do
            pg.Visible =(tn == name)
        end
        local accent = _G._VioletteccAccent or ACC
        for tn, btn in pairs(tabButtons) do
            local active =(tn == name)
            local st = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            local sc = btn:FindFirstChild("TabPop")
            if active then
                TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.22), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,
                    0,
                    0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
                    TextColor3 = accent,
                }):Play()
                if st then
                    TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.22), {
                        Color = accent,
                        Thickness = 1.5,
                        Transparency = 0,
                    }):Play()
                end
                if sc then
                    TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {
                        Scale = 1.06
                    }):Play()
                end
            else
                TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.22), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,
                    0,
                    0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.45,
                    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,
                    255,
                    255),
                }):Play()
                if st then
                    TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.22), {
                        Color = Color3.fromRGB(0,
                        0,
                        0),
                        Thickness = 1.0,
                        Transparency = 0.08,
                    }):Play()
                end
                if sc then
                    TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {
                        Scale = 1
                    }):Play()
                end
            end
        end
        if contentArea then
            contentArea.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        end
        if searchBox then
            refreshPageSearch()
        end
    end
    local _firstSectionDone = false
    local function sectionHeader(parent, text, order)
        local top = _firstSectionDone and 20 or 2
        _firstSectionDone = true
        local f = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
        f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, top + 22);
        f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.LayoutOrder = order or 1

        l.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top);
        l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        l.Text = text:upper()
        l.TextColor3 = ACC;
        l.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        l.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(13, 12)
        l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        l.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        l.ZIndex = 4
        local line = Instance.new("Frame", f)
        line.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1);
        line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, top + 18)
        line.BackgroundColor3 = ACC;
        line.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
        line.BorderSizePixel = 0;
        line.ZIndex = 3
        return f
    end
    local RH = math.floor(34 * G_29)
    local function addPressPop(target, btn)
        if not target or not btn then
            return
        end
        local pop = target:FindFirstChild("PressPop")
        if not pop then
            pop = Instance.new("UIScale", target)
            pop.Name = "PressPop"
            pop.Scale = 1
        end
        btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(pop, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {
                Scale = 0.98
            }):Play()
        end)
        local function release()
            TweenService:Create(pop, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Scale = 1
            }):Play()
        end
        btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(release)
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(release)
    end
    local function makeRowBase(page, order)

            }):Play()

        f.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {

    local function nameWithUnderline(parent, text)
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", parent)
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 16);
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, - 9)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = text
        lbl.TextColor3 = WHITE;
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(12, 11)
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;
        lbl.ZIndex = 5
        local ul = Instance.new("Frame", parent)
        local txtW = textWidth(text, lbl.TextSize, lbl.Font)
        ul.Size = UDim2.new(0, txtW, 0, 1);

    local function addGlow(btn, radius)
        local s = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
        s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        s.Thickness = 1.4
        s.Color = ACC
        s.Transparency = 1
    end
    local function addFillHover(btn, lbl)
        local baseBg = btn.BackgroundColor3
        local baseTxt = lbl and lbl.TextColor3
        local function fill(on)
            TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.14), {
                BackgroundColor3 = on and ACC or baseBg
            }):Play()
            if lbl then
                lbl.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or baseTxt
                lbl.ZIndex =(btn.ZIndex or 1) + 8
            end
        end
        local function unfillIfIdle()
            if not btn:GetAttribute("Held") and not btn:GetAttribute("Open") then
                fill(false)
            end
        end
        btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            fill(true)
        end)
        btn.MouseLeave:Connect(unfillIfIdle)
        btn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
            btn:SetAttribute("Held", true);
            fill(true)
        end)
        btn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
            btn:SetAttribute("Held", false);
            unfillIfIdle()
        end)
        return fill
    end
    local _openDropdown = nil
    local function makeDropdown(row, options, getV, setV, width, rightPad, title, multi)
        local BS = 32
        local H = 22
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, BS, 0, H)
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(BS +(rightPad or 12)), 0.5, - H / 2)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = BG_DARK
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        btn.Text = ""
        btn.ZIndex = 12
        Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        local btnSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
        btnSt.Color = ACC;
        btnSt.Thickness = 1;
        btnSt.Transparency = 1
        btnSt.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        local chev = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
        chev.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        chev.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        chev.Text = utf8.char(0x25BC)
        chev.TextColor3 = ACC
        chev.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        chev.TextSize = 15
        chev.ZIndex = 20
        local _fill = addFillHover(btn, chev)
        local panel = Instance.new("Frame", row.Parent)
        panel.Name = "DropdownPanel"
        panel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, getMobileOptimized(38, 34))
        panel.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
        panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
        panel.LayoutOrder =(row.LayoutOrder or 1) + 1
        panel.ZIndex = 4
        panel.Visible = false
        Instance.new("UICorner", panel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
        local pSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", panel)
        pSt.Color = ACC;
        pSt.Thickness = 1;
        pSt.Transparency = 1
        pSt.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        if not title then
            for _, c in ipairs(row:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("TextLabel") and c.Text ~= "" then
                    title = c.Text;
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if title and title ~= "" then
            local pl = Instance.new("TextLabel", panel)
            pl.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16)
            pl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, - 9)
            pl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            pl.Text = title
            pl.TextColor3 = WHITE
            pl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            pl.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(12, 11)
            pl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            pl.ZIndex = 5
            local pu = Instance.new("Frame", panel)
            pu.Size = UDim2.new(0, textWidth(title, pl.TextSize, pl.Font), 0, 1)
            pu.Visible = false
            pu.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, 7)
            pu.BackgroundColor3 = ACC
            pu.BorderSizePixel = 0
            pu.ZIndex = 5
        end
        local optBtns = {}
        local BW = width or 78
        local BH = 24
        local GAP = 6
        local PANEL_H = getMobileOptimized(38, 34)
        local avail = PW - 24 - 110
        local perRow = math.max(1, math.floor((avail + GAP) /(BW + GAP)))
        if perRow > # options then
            perRow = # options
        end
        local lineCount = math.ceil(# options / perRow)
        if lineCount > 1 then
            panel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, PANEL_H +(lineCount - 1) *(BH + GAP))
        end
        local function refresh()
            local sel =(not multi) and getV() or nil
            for _, v in ipairs(options) do
                local b = optBtns[v]
                if b then
                    local on
                    if multi then
                        on = getV(v) == true
                    else
                        on =(v == sel)
                    end
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = on and ACC or DIM
                    b.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                end
            end
        end
        for i, opt in ipairs(options) do
            local lineIdx = math.floor((i - 1) / perRow)
            local colIdx =(i - 1) % perRow
            local inLine = math.min(perRow, # options - lineIdx * perRow)
            local lineTotal = inLine * BW +(inLine - 1) * GAP
            local yTop =(PANEL_H - BH) / 2 + lineIdx *(BH + GAP)
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton", panel)
            b.Size = UDim2.new(0, BW, 0, BH)
            b.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(lineTotal + 12) + colIdx *(BW + GAP), 0, yTop)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = CARD2
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.Text = tostring(opt)
            b.TextColor3 = DIM
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            b.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10)
            b.ZIndex = 5
            Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
            optBtns[opt] = b
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                setV(opt)
                refresh()
                if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
                end
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end)
        end
        local function closeList()
            panel.Visible = false
            chev.Rotation = 0
            btn:SetAttribute("Open", false)
            _fill(false)
            if _openDropdown == closeList then
                _openDropdown = nil
            end
        end
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if panel.Visible then
                closeList()
            else
                if _openDropdown then
                    _openDropdown()
                end
                panel.Visible = true
                chev.Rotation = 180
                _openDropdown = closeList
                btn:SetAttribute("Open", true)
                _fill(true)
            end
        end)
        refresh()
        return refresh, panel
    end
    _G._AdaptMakeDropdown = makeDropdown
    local function makeSliderRow(page, order, labelTxt, minV, maxV, getV, setV, step, allowValueEdit)
        step = step or 1
        local dec =(step < 1) and 1 or 0
        local f = Instance.new("Frame", page)
        f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, getMobileOptimized(62, 58))
        f.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.LayoutOrder = order
        f.ZIndex = 4
        Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", f)
        st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0);
        st.Thickness = 1;
        st.Transparency = 0.4
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", f)
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 16)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 11)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = labelTxt
        lbl.TextColor3 = WHITE
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(12, 11)
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        lbl.ZIndex = 5
        local und = Instance.new("Frame", f)
        und.Size = UDim2.new(0, textWidth(labelTxt, lbl.TextSize, lbl.Font), 0, 1)
        und.Visible = false
        und.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 27)
        und.BackgroundColor3 = ACC
        und.BorderSizePixel = 0
        und.ZIndex = 5
        local box = Instance.new("Frame", f)
        box.Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 24)
        box.Position = UDim2.new(1, - 64, 0, 9)
        box.BackgroundColor3 = BG_DARK
        box.BorderSizePixel = 0
        box.ZIndex = 5
        Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local boxSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", box)
        boxSt.Color = ACC;
        boxSt.Thickness = 1;
        boxSt.Transparency = 1
        boxSt.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        local val = Instance.new("TextLabel", box)
        val.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        val.TextColor3 = WHITE
        val.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        val.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(12, 11)
        val.ZIndex = 6
        local track = Instance.new("Frame", f)
        track.Size = UDim2.new(1, - 24, 0, 6)
        track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, - 18)
        track.BackgroundColor3 = BG_DARK
        track.BorderSizePixel = 0
        track.ZIndex = 5
        Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local trkSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", track)
        trkSt.Color = ACC;
        trkSt.Thickness = 1;
        trkSt.Transparency = 1
        trkSt.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        local fill = Instance.new("Frame", track)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
        fill.BackgroundColor3 = ACC
        fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
        fill.ZIndex = 6
        Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local knob = Instance.new("Frame", track)
        knob.Name = "SliderKnob"
        knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
        knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
        knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
        knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
        knob.ZIndex = 8
        Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local knobSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", knob)
        knobSt.Color = ACC;
        knobSt.Thickness = 1.5;
        knobSt.Transparency = 1
        knobSt.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        local function snap(v)
            v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
            v = math.floor((v - minV) / step + 0.5) * step + minV
            v = math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5) / 100
            return math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
        end
        local function refresh()
            local v = snap(getV() or minV)
            local a =(maxV > minV) and((v - minV) /(maxV - minV)) or 0
            fill.Size = UDim2.new(a, 0, 1, 0)
            knob.Position = UDim2.new(a, 0, 0.5, 0)
            val.Text = string.format("%." .. dec .. "f", v)
        end
        if allowValueEdit then
            local editBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", box)
            editBtn.Name = "ValueEditButton"
            editBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
            editBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            editBtn.Text = ""
            editBtn.ZIndex = 8
            local editBox = Instance.new("TextBox", box)
            editBox.Name = "ValueEditBox"
            editBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, - 4, 1, 0)
            editBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 0)
            editBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            editBox.TextColor3 = WHITE
            editBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            editBox.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(12, 11)
            editBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            editBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
            editBox.Visible = false
            editBox.ZIndex = 9
            editBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                editBox.Text = tostring(getV() or minV)
                editBtn.Visible = false
                val.Visible = false
                editBox.Visible = true
                editBox:CaptureFocus()
                editBox.CursorPosition = # editBox.Text + 1
            end)
            editBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                local n = tonumber(editBox.Text)
                if n then
                    n = snap(n)
                    setV(n)
                end
                editBox.Visible = false
                val.Visible = true
                editBtn.Visible = true
                refresh()
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end)
        end
        local hit = Instance.new("TextButton", f)
        hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, - 24, 0, 26)
        hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, - 28)
        hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        hit.Text = ""
        hit.AutoButtonColor = false
        hit.ZIndex = 9
        local dragging = false
        local function setFromX(x)
            local w = track.AbsoluteSize.X
            if w <= 0 then
                return
            end
            local a = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / w, 0, 1)
            setV(snap(minV + a *(maxV - minV)))
            refresh()
        end
        hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                setFromX(i.Position.X)
            end
        end)
        hit.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
            if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
            if dragging and(i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                setFromX(i.Position.X)
            end
        end)
        refresh()
        return refresh, f
    end
    local function makeStepper(f, getV, setV, minV, maxV, step, fmt)
        local BS, VW, GAP = 28, 50, 6
        local W = BS * 2 + VW + GAP * 2
        local wrap = Instance.new("Frame", f)
        wrap.Size = UDim2.new(0, W, 0, BS)
        wrap.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(W + 12), 0.5, - BS / 2)
        wrap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        wrap.ZIndex = 5
        local box = Instance.new("Frame", wrap)
        box.Size = UDim2.new(0, VW, 0, BS)
        box.Position = UDim2.new(0, BS + GAP, 0, 0)
        box.BackgroundColor3 = BG_DARK
        box.BorderSizePixel = 0
        box.ZIndex = 6
        Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local boxSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", box)
        boxSt.Color = ACC;
        boxSt.Thickness = 1;
        boxSt.Transparency = 1
        local val = Instance.new("TextLabel", box)
        val.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        val.TextColor3 = WHITE
        val.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        val.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(12, 11)
        val.ZIndex = 7
        local function refresh()
            local v = getV() or 1
            if fmt == "%d" then
                v = math.floor(v + 0.5)
            end
            val.Text = string.format(fmt or "%.2f", v)
        end
        local function mkArrow(txt, xOff, delta)
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton", wrap)
            b.Size = UDim2.new(0, BS, 0, BS)
            b.Position = UDim2.new(0, xOff, 0, 0)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = CARD2
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.Text = txt
            b.TextColor3 = ACC
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            b.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(15, 14)
            b.ZIndex = 6
            Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
            local s = Instance.new("UIStroke", b)
            s.Color = ACC;
            s.Thickness = 1;
            s.Transparency = 1;
            s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            local lastClick = 0
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local now = os.clock()
                if now - lastClick < 0.08 then
                    return
                end
                lastClick = now
                local cur = getV() or minV
                local snapped = math.floor((cur - minV) / step + 0.5) * step + minV
                local nv = math.clamp(snapped + delta, minV, maxV)
                nv = math.floor(nv * 100 + 0.5) / 100
                setV(nv)
                refresh()
            end)
        end
        mkArrow("-", 0, - step)
        mkArrow("+", BS + VW + GAP * 2, step)
        refresh()
        return refresh
    end

    end
    local function mkNumberBox(parent, val)
        local bx = Instance.new("Frame", parent)

        bx.Position = UDim2.new(1, - getMobileOptimized(66, 54), 0.5, - getMobileOptimized(12, 11))

        tb.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1

            TweenService:Create(bxSt, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                Transparency = 0.45
            }):Play()

    local KB = {}
    local waitingForKey = nil
    local function _kbSteal(kc, selfKey)
        if not kc or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
            return false
        end
        local stole = false
        for k, v in pairs(Keybinds) do
            if k ~= selfKey and v == kc then
                Keybinds[k] = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
                local lbl = KB[k]
                if lbl and lbl.Parent then
                    lbl.Text = "None"
                end
                stole = true
            end
        end
        local ap = _G._AdaptAPKeybinds
        if type(ap) == "table" then
            for k, v in pairs(ap) do
                if k ~= selfKey and v == kc then
                    ap[k] = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
                    stole = true
                end
            end
        end
        if selfKey ~= "InstaReset" and _G._VynxInstaResetKey == kc.Name then
            _G._VynxInstaResetKey = nil
            if _G._VynxRefreshInstaResetKey then
                pcall(_G._VynxRefreshInstaResetKey)
            end
            stole = true
        end
        local panelStates = {
            ["panel:duelLagger"] = _G._VioletteccDuelLagger,
            ["panel:pingLagger"] = _G._VioletteccPingLagger,
            ["panel:speedBypass"] = _G._VioletteccSpeedBypass,
        }
        for tag, st in pairs(panelStates) do
            if tag ~= selfKey and type(st) == "table" and st.key == kc.Name then
                st.key = nil
                stole = true
            end
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRefreshAllPanelKeys then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRefreshAllPanelKeys)
        end
        if _G._VynxRefreshDuelLaggerKey then
            pcall(_G._VynxRefreshDuelLaggerKey)
        end
        return stole
    end
    _G._AdaptKeybindSteal = _kbSteal
    local function _isAllowedStandardKeybind(kc)
        if typeof(kc) ~= "EnumItem" or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
            return false
        end
        if kc == Enum.KeyCode.LeftAlt or kc == Enum.KeyCode.RightAlt then
            return true
        end
        return kc.Name:match("^[A-Z]$") ~= nil
    end
    local function TR(page, order, name, kbKey, enabledKey, defOn, onToggle, noSwitch)
        local f = makeRowBase(page, order)
        nameWithUnderline(f, name)
        local _bdRef
        local rawSetV = noSwitch and
        function(v)
            if _bdRef then
                _bdRef.BackgroundTransparency = v and 0 or 0.65
                local lb = _bdRef:FindFirstChildOfClass("TextLabel")
                if lb then
                    lb.TextColor3 = v and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or WHITE
                end
            end
        end
        or mkSwitch(f, defOn)
        local isOn = defOn or false
        local _inSetV = false
        local setV = function(v)
            if _inSetV then
                return
            end
            _inSetV = true
            local prev = isOn
            isOn = v and true or false
            rawSetV(v)
            if prev ~= isOn then
                if enabledKey then
                    Enabled[enabledKey] = isOn
                end
                if onToggle then
                    pcall(onToggle, isOn)
                end
            end
            _inSetV = false
        end
        if enabledKey then
            VisualSetters[enabledKey] = setV
        end
        local kbLbl = nil
        if kbKey and kbKey ~= "" then
            local BW = noSwitch and SW_W or getMobileOptimized(42, 38)
            local BH = noSwitch and 22 or getMobileOptimized(18, 16)
            local bd = Instance.new("Frame", f)
            bd.Size = UDim2.new(0, BW, 0, BH)
            bd.Position = noSwitch and UDim2.new(1, -(BW + 12), 0.5, - BH / 2) or UDim2.new(1, -(SW_W + 20 + BW), 0.5, - BH / 2)
            bd.BackgroundColor3 = ACC;
            bd.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
            bd.BorderSizePixel = 0;
            bd.ZIndex = 9
            Instance.new("UICorner", bd).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, noSwitch and 8 or 6)
            kbLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bd)
            kbLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0);
            kbLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            kbLbl.Text =(Keybinds[kbKey] and Keybinds[kbKey] ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown) and _G._VioletteccKeyName(Keybinds[kbKey]) or "None"
            _bdRef = bd
            if noSwitch then
                bd.BackgroundTransparency = defOn and 0 or 0.65
            end
            kbLbl.TextColor3 = WHITE;
            kbLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            kbLbl.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10);
            kbLbl.ZIndex = 10
            kbLbl.TextScaled = true do
                local c = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", kbLbl);
                c.MaxTextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10);
                c.MinTextSize = 6
            end
            bd.ClipsDescendants = true
            if noSwitch and defOn then
                kbLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            end
            KB[kbKey] = kbLbl
        end
        local function startKB()
            if not kbKey or not kbLbl then
                return
            end
            waitingForKey = kbKey;
            kbLbl.Text = "...";
            _G._VioletteccBeginKeyCapture()
            local conn;
            conn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, g)
                if waitingForKey ~= kbKey then
                    conn:Disconnect();
                    return
                end
                if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                    return
                end
                local kc = i.KeyCode
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                    kbLbl.Text =(Keybinds[kbKey] ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown) and _G._VioletteccKeyName(Keybinds[kbKey]) or "None";
                    waitingForKey = nil;
                    _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture();
                    conn:Disconnect();
                    return
                end
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
                    Keybinds[kbKey] = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown;
                    kbLbl.Text = "None"
                    waitingForKey = nil;
                    _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture();
                    conn:Disconnect()
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
                    end
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                    end
                    return
                end
                if not _isAllowedStandardKeybind(kc) then
                    return
                end
                _kbSteal(kc, kbKey)
                Keybinds[kbKey] = kc;
                kbLbl.Text = _G._VioletteccKeyName(kc)
                if _G._VynxRefreshAPKeys then
                    pcall(_G._VynxRefreshAPKeys)
                end
                waitingForKey = nil;
                _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture();
                conn:Disconnect()
                if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
                end
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end)
        end
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", f)
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0);
        btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        btn.Text = "";
        btn.ZIndex = 8
        addPressPop(f, btn)
        local ih = false;
        local hs = 0
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if not ih then
                setV(not isOn)
                if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
                end
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end
            ih = false;
            hs = 0
        end)
        if kbLbl then
            local kbBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", kbLbl.Parent)
            kbBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0);
            kbBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            kbBtn.Text = "";
            kbBtn.ZIndex = 11
            kbBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(startKB)
        end
        return setV, f
    end

    local function KR(page, order, name, kbKey, width)
        local f = makeRowBase(page, order)
        nameWithUnderline(f, name)
        local BW = width or 84
        local BH = 22
        local bd = Instance.new("Frame", f)
        bd.Size = UDim2.new(0, BW, 0, BH)
        bd.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(BW + 12), 0.5, - BH / 2)
        bd.BackgroundColor3 = ACC
        bd.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
        bd.BorderSizePixel = 0
        bd.ZIndex = 9
        Instance.new("UICorner", bd).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
        local kbLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bd)
        kbLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        kbLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        kbLbl.Text =(Keybinds[kbKey] and Keybinds[kbKey] ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown) and _G._VioletteccKeyName(Keybinds[kbKey]) or "None"
        kbLbl.TextColor3 = WHITE
        kbLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        kbLbl.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10)
        kbLbl.ZIndex = 10
        kbLbl.TextScaled = true do
            local c = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint", kbLbl);
            c.MaxTextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10);
            c.MinTextSize = 6
        end
        bd.ClipsDescendants = true
        KB[kbKey] = kbLbl
        local function startKB()
            waitingForKey = kbKey;
            kbLbl.Text = "...";
            _G._VioletteccBeginKeyCapture()
            local conn;
            conn = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, g)
                if waitingForKey ~= kbKey then
                    conn:Disconnect();
                    return
                end
                if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                    return
                end
                local kc = i.KeyCode
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                    kbLbl.Text =(Keybinds[kbKey] and Keybinds[kbKey] ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown) and _G._VioletteccKeyName(Keybinds[kbKey]) or "None"
                    waitingForKey = nil;
                    _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture();
                    conn:Disconnect();
                    return
                end
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
                    Keybinds[kbKey] = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown;
                    kbLbl.Text = "None"
                    waitingForKey = nil;
                    _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture();
                    conn:Disconnect()
                    if _G._VynxRefreshAPKeys then
                        pcall(_G._VynxRefreshAPKeys)
                    end
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
                    end
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                    end
                    return
                end
                if not _isAllowedStandardKeybind(kc) then
                    return
                end
                _kbSteal(kc, kbKey)
                Keybinds[kbKey] = kc;
                kbLbl.Text = _G._VioletteccKeyName(kc)
                if _G._VynxRefreshAPKeys then
                    pcall(_G._VynxRefreshAPKeys)
                end
                waitingForKey = nil;
                _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture();
                conn:Disconnect()
                if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
                end
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end)
        end
        local kbBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", bd)
        kbBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        kbBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        kbBtn.Text = ""
        kbBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
        kbBtn.ZIndex = 11
        kbBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(startKB)

    end

    local function CR(page, order, name, initValue, values, onChange)
        local AW = 34
        local f = Instance.new("Frame", page)
        f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, getMobileOptimized(68, 62))
        f.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
        f.BorderSizePixel = 0
        f.LayoutOrder = order
        f.ZIndex = 4
        Instance.new("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", f)
        st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0);
        st.Thickness = 1;
        st.Transparency = 0.4
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", f)
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 16)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 8)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = name
        lbl.TextColor3 = WHITE
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(12, 11)
        lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        lbl.ZIndex = 5
        local und = Instance.new("Frame", f)
        und.Size = UDim2.new(0, textWidth(name, lbl.TextSize, lbl.Font), 0, 1)
        und.Visible = false
        und.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 26)
        und.BackgroundColor3 = ACC
        und.BorderSizePixel = 0
        und.ZIndex = 5
        local val = Instance.new("TextLabel", f)
        val.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(24 + AW * 2 + 16), 0, 26)
        val.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12 + AW + 8, 1, - 34)
        val.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        val.Text = tostring(initValue):upper()
        val.TextColor3 = WHITE
        val.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        val.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(12, 11)
        val.ZIndex = 6
        local function step(dir)
            local idx = 1
            for i, v in ipairs(values) do
                if tostring(v):upper() == val.Text then
                    idx = i;
                    break
                end
            end
            idx =((idx - 1 + dir) % # values) + 1
            val.Text = tostring(values[idx]):upper()
            if onChange then
                onChange(values[idx])
            end
            if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
            end
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end
        local function mkArrow(txt, xPos, dir)
            local a = Instance.new("TextButton", f)
            a.Size = UDim2.new(0, AW, 0, 26)
            a.Position = UDim2.new(xPos,(xPos == 0) and 12 or -(AW + 12), 1, - 34)
            a.BackgroundColor3 = BG_DARK
            a.BorderSizePixel = 0
            a.AutoButtonColor = false
            a.Text = txt
            a.TextColor3 = ACC
            a.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            a.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(14, 13)
            a.ZIndex = 7
            Instance.new("UICorner", a).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
            addFillHover(a, a)
            local ast = Instance.new("UIStroke", a)
            ast.Color = ACC;
            ast.Thickness = 1;
            ast.Transparency = 1
            ast.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            a.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                step(dir)
            end)
        end
        mkArrow("<", 0, - 1)
        mkArrow(">", 1, 1)
        return val
    end

        local function startKB()
            waitingForKey = kbKey;

                    return
                end
                if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                    return
                end
                local kc = i.KeyCode
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                    kbLbl.Text =(Keybinds[kbKey] ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown) and _G._VioletteccKeyName(Keybinds[kbKey]) or "None"
                    waitingForKey = nil;
                    _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture()
                    conn:Disconnect()
                    return
                end
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
                    Keybinds[kbKey] = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown;
                    kbLbl.Text = "None"
                    waitingForKey = nil;
                    _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture();
                    conn:Disconnect()
                    if _G._VynxRefreshAPKeys then
                        pcall(_G._VynxRefreshAPKeys)
                    end
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
                    end
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                    end
                    if saveConfig then
                        pcall(saveConfig)
                    end
                    return
                end
                if not _isAllowedStandardKeybind(kc) then
                    return
                end
                _kbSteal(kc, kbKey)
                Keybinds[kbKey] = kc
                kbLbl.Text = _G._VioletteccKeyName(kc)
                if _G._VynxRefreshAPKeys then
                    pcall(_G._VynxRefreshAPKeys)
                end
                waitingForKey = nil;
                _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture()
                conn:Disconnect()
                if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
                end
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
                if saveConfig then
                    pcall(saveConfig)
                end
            end)
        end
        local ih, hs = false, 0
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            ih = false;
            hs = 0
        end)
        kbClick.Activated:Connect(startKB)
        return setVisual, carryTb, normalTb
    end

    Spd.Refresh = function()
        local n, c = Spd.Values()
        NORMAL_SPEED = n
        CARRY_SPEED = c
        LAGGER_SPEED = tonumber(_G.LaggerSpeed_Normal) or LAGGER_SPEED
        _G.NormalSpeedActive =(Spd.family == "normal")
        _G.LaggerSpeedActive =(Spd.family == "lagger")
        if normalSpeedV then
            pcall(normalSpeedV, _G.NormalSpeedActive, Spd.carry)
        end
        if laggerSpeedV then
            pcall(laggerSpeedV, _G.LaggerSpeedActive, Spd.carry)
        end
        if nsb then
            nsb.Text = _formatSpeed(NORMAL_SPEED)
        end
        if csb then
            csb.Text = _formatSpeed(CARRY_SPEED)
        end
        if lsb then
            lsb.Text = _formatSpeed(LAGGER_SPEED)
        end
        if carryV then
            pcall(carryV, Spd.carry)
        end
        if laggerV then
            pcall(laggerV, Spd.family == "lagger")
        end
        if modeSR then
            local fam =(Spd.family == "lagger" and "Lagger") or "Normal"
            modeSR.Text = Spd.carry and(fam .. " Carry") or fam
        end
        if _G._VioletteccSyncMobileSpeedBtns then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccSyncMobileSpeedBtns)
        end
    end

        end
    end

    local antiBatConn = nil
    local antiBatActive = false
    local function enableAntiBat()
        if antiBatConn then
            return
        end
        antiBatActive = true
        antiBatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not antiBatActive then
                return
            end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char then
                return
            end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then
                return
            end
            local vel = hrp.Velocity
            local y = vel.Y
            hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(math.random(- 4000, 4000), y, math.random(- 4000, 4000))
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
            if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                hrp.Velocity = vel
            end
        end)
    end
    local function disableAntiBat()
        antiBatActive = false
        if antiBatConn then
            antiBatConn:Disconnect()
            antiBatConn = nil
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccAntiBatRuntime = {

    local ThemeMap =(function()
        local M = {}
        M.PURPLE = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        local TP_H, TP_S, TP_V = M.PURPLE:ToHSV()
        M.reg = setmetatable({}, {
            __mode = "k"
        })
        M.scanned = false
        M.SKIP = {
            VioletteHeaderLogo = true,
            VioletteHeaderLogoGlow = true,
            VioletteHeaderLogoBoost = true,
            VioletteTitleImage = true,
            BackgroundImage = true,
        }
        function M.isPurpleish(c)
            local h, s, v = c:ToHSV()
            return h >= 0.68 and h <= 0.86 and s >= 0.2 and v >= 0.25
        end
        function M.target(_orig, _theme)
            return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        end
        local function seqEqual(seq, kps)
            local a = seq.Keypoints
            if # a ~= # kps then
                return false
            end
            for i, kp in ipairs(a) do
                if kp.Value ~= kps[i].Value then
                    return false
                end
            end
            return true
        end
        function M.repaintGradient(g, old, theme, canRegister)
            local entry = M.reg[g]
            if not entry then
                local has = false
                for _, kp in ipairs(g.Color.Keypoints) do
                    if kp.Value == old or(canRegister and M.isPurpleish(kp.Value)) then
                        has = true
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not has then
                    return
                end
                local origKps = {}
                for i, kp in ipairs(g.Color.Keypoints) do
                    origKps[i] = {
                        Time = kp.Time,
                        Value =(kp.Value == old) and M.PURPLE or kp.Value
                    }
                end
                entry = {
                    orig = origKps,
                    last = g.Color.Keypoints
                }
                M.reg[g] = entry
            elseif not seqEqual(g.Color, entry.last) then
                return
            end
            local out = {}
            for i, kp in ipairs(entry.orig) do
                local v = kp.Value
                if v == M.PURPLE or M.isPurpleish(v) then
                    v = M.target(v, theme)
                end
                out[i] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, v)
            end
            g.Color = ColorSequence.new(out)
            entry.last = g.Color.Keypoints
        end
        return M
    end)()
    local function applyAccent(newColor)
        if typeof(newColor) ~= "Color3" then
            return
        end
        newColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        local old = _G._VioletteccAccent or ACC
        if newColor == old then
            return
        end
        local firstPass = not ThemeMap.scanned
        ThemeMap.scanned = true
        local oldIsPurple =(old == ThemeMap.PURPLE)
        local function repaint(inst, prop)
            local ok, cur = pcall(function()
                return inst[prop]
            end)
            if not ok or typeof(cur) ~= "Color3" then
                return
            end
            local reg = ThemeMap.reg[inst]
            if not reg then
                reg = {};
                ThemeMap.reg[inst] = reg
            end
            local entry = reg[prop]
            if not entry then
                if cur == old then
                    entry = {
                        orig = ThemeMap.PURPLE,
                        last = cur
                    }
                elseif firstPass and oldIsPurple and ThemeMap.isPurpleish(cur) then
                    entry = {
                        orig = cur,
                        last = cur
                    }
                else
                    return
                end
                reg[prop] = entry
            elseif cur ~= entry.last and cur ~= old then
                return
            end
            pcall(function()
                inst[prop] = ThemeMap.target(entry.orig, newColor)
                entry.last = inst[prop]
            end)
        end
        for _, d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
            pcall(function()
                if d:IsA("UIStroke") then
                    repaint(d, "Color")
                elseif d:IsA("UIGradient") then
                    ThemeMap.repaintGradient(d, old, newColor, firstPass and oldIsPurple)
                elseif d:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    if not ThemeMap.SKIP[d.Name] and not(d:IsA("TextButton") and d.Name:sub(1, 3) == "MB_") then
                        repaint(d, "BackgroundColor3")
                        repaint(d, "BorderColor3")
                        if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox") then
                            repaint(d, "TextColor3")
                        end
                        if d:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                            repaint(d, "ScrollBarImageColor3")
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        ACC = newColor
        _G._VioletteccAccent = newColor
        local logoTween = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        local function tintLogo(img)
            if img and img.Parent then
                img.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                _G._VioletteccApplyLogoTheme(img, newColor, false)
            end
        end
        for _, letter in ipairs(hdrWordmark) do
            tintLogo(letter)
        end
        tintLogo(gui:FindFirstChild("VioletteTitleImage", true))
        if _G._VezyRefreshBgTint then
            pcall(_G._VezyRefreshBgTint, newColor)
        end
        if _G._VynxRefreshMobileBtnColors then
            pcall(_G._VynxRefreshMobileBtnColors)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRepaintTabs then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRepaintTabs)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccSetTagColor then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccSetTagColor, newColor)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRefreshAvatarESPColor then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRefreshAvatarESPColor)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRefreshRagdollCDColor then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRefreshRagdollCDColor)
        end
        if _G._AdaptRefreshESPColor then
            pcall(_G._AdaptRefreshESPColor, newColor)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRefreshPanels then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRefreshPanels)
        end
    end

        local function makePresets(row, values, getV, setV)
            local btns = {}
            local BW, BH, GAP = 42, 24, 6
            local total = # values * BW +(# values - 1) * GAP
            local function refresh()
                for v, b in pairs(btns) do
                    local on =(v == getV())
                    TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                        BackgroundColor3 = on and ACC or DIM,
                        TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(0,
                        0,
                        0) or Color3.fromRGB(255,
                        255,
                        255),
                    }):Play()
                end
            end
            for i, v in ipairs(values) do
                local b = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
                b.Size = UDim2.new(0, BW, 0, BH)
                b.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(total + 12) +(i - 1) *(BW + GAP), 0.5, - BH / 2)
                b.BackgroundColor3 = CARD2
                b.BorderSizePixel = 0
                b.AutoButtonColor = false
                b.Text = tostring(v)
                b.TextColor3 = DIM
                b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                b.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10)
                b.ZIndex = 5

                    setV(v)
                    refresh()
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
                    end
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                    end
                end)
            end
            refresh()
            return refresh
        end

            for _, kind in ipairs(ESP_KINDS) do
                espSel[kind] = nil

                    if ESP_BINDINGS[kind] then
                        espSel[kind] = true
                    end
                end

                for _, kind in ipairs(ESP_KINDS) do

                        espSel[kind] = true
                    end
                end
                espSelSave()
            end

            local function mkInputRow(yPos, labelText, getValue, onConfirm)
                local row = Instance.new("Frame", settingsFrame)
                row.Size = UDim2.new(1, - 20, 0, 36)
                row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos)
                row.BackgroundColor3 = C.card
                row.BorderSizePixel = 0
                row.ZIndex = 22
                corner(row, 10)
                stroke(row, C.edge, 1, 0.25)
                local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
                lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
                lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
                lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                lbl.Text = labelText
                lbl.TextColor3 = C.white
                lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                lbl.TextSize = 11
                lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                lbl.ZIndex = 23
                local box = Instance.new("TextBox", row)
                box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(68, 24)
                box.Position = UDim2.new(1, - 78, 0.5, - 12)
                box.BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg
                box.BorderSizePixel = 0
                box.Text = tostring(getValue())
                box.TextColor3 = C.accent
                box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                box.TextSize = 11
                box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
                box.ZIndex = 24
                corner(box, 7)
                local bs = stroke(box, C.accent, 1, 0.55)
                box.Focused:Connect(function()
                    tw(bs, {
                        Transparency = 0.1
                    })
                end)
                box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                    tw(bs, {
                        Transparency = 0.55
                    })
                    local n = tonumber(box.Text)
                    if n then
                        onConfirm(n)
                        box.Text = tostring(getValue())
                        saveConfig()
                    else
                        box.Text = tostring(getValue())
                    end
                end)
                return box
            end
            local kbBindBtn, gpBindBtn
            local function updateKbLabels()
                if kbBindBtn then
                    if listeningFor == "kb" then
                        kbBindBtn.Text = "..."
                        kbBindBtn.TextColor3 = C.waiting
                    else
                        kbBindBtn.Text = cfg.keybindKb ~= "" and cfg.keybindKb or "None"
                        kbBindBtn.TextColor3 = C.accent
                    end
                end
                if gpBindBtn then
                    if listeningFor == "gp" then
                        gpBindBtn.Text = "..."
                        gpBindBtn.TextColor3 = C.waiting
                    else
                        gpBindBtn.Text = cfg.keybindGp ~= "" and cfg.keybindGp or "None"
                        gpBindBtn.TextColor3 = C.accent
                    end
                end
            end
            local function mkKeybindRow(yPos, labelText, which)
                local row = Instance.new("Frame", settingsFrame)
                row.Size = UDim2.new(1, - 20, 0, 36)
                row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos)
                row.BackgroundColor3 = C.card
                row.BorderSizePixel = 0
                row.ZIndex = 22
                corner(row, 10)
                stroke(row, C.edge, 1, 0.25)
                local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
                lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 1, 0)
                lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
                lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                lbl.Text = labelText
                lbl.TextColor3 = C.white
                lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                lbl.TextSize = 11
                lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                lbl.ZIndex = 23
                local bindBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
                bindBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(78, 24)
                bindBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, - 112, 0.5, - 12)
                bindBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg
                bindBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                bindBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
                bindBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                bindBtn.TextSize = 10
                bindBtn.TextColor3 = C.accent
                bindBtn.ZIndex = 24
                bindBtn.Text = which == "kb" and cfg.keybindKb or cfg.keybindGp
                corner(bindBtn, 7)
                local bStr = stroke(bindBtn, C.accent, 1, 0.55)
                bindBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                    tw(bStr, {
                        Transparency = 0.1
                    })
                end)
                bindBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                    tw(bStr, {
                        Transparency = 0.55
                    })
                end)
                bindBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    listeningFor =(listeningFor == which) and nil or which
                    updateKbLabels()
                end)
                local clearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
                clearBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
                clearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, - 30, 0.5, - 12)
                clearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                clearBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                clearBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
                clearBtn.Text = "X"
                clearBtn.TextColor3 = C.red
                clearBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                clearBtn.TextSize = 12
                clearBtn.ZIndex = 24
                corner(clearBtn, 7)
                clearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if listeningFor == which then
                        listeningFor = nil
                    end
                    if which == "kb" then
                        cfg.keybindKb = "None"
                    else
                        cfg.keybindGp = "None"
                    end
                    updateKbLabels()
                    saveConfig()
                end)
                if which == "kb" then
                    kbBindBtn = bindBtn
                end
                if which == "gp" then
                    gpBindBtn = bindBtn
                end
                return bindBtn
            end

                nextBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 24)
                nextBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, - 40, 0.5, - 12)
                nextBtn.BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg
                nextBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0

                nextBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack

                corner(nextBtn, 7)

                nextBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                    tw(ns, {
                        Transparency = 0.1
                    })
                end)
                nextBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                    tw(ns, {
                        Transparency = 0.55
                    })
                end)
                local function currentIndex()
                    for i, o in ipairs(STRENGTH_OPTIONS) do
                        if o.key == cfg.strength then
                            return i
                        end
                    end
                    return 4
                end
                local function apply()
                    local preset = STRENGTH_OPTIONS[currentIndex()]
                    cfg.strength = preset.key
                    cycleBtn.Text = preset.label
                    saveConfig()
                end
                prevBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    local i = currentIndex() - 1
                    if i < 1 then
                        i = # STRENGTH_OPTIONS
                    end
                    cfg.strength = STRENGTH_OPTIONS[i].key
                    apply()
                end)
                nextBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    local i = currentIndex() + 1
                    if i > # STRENGTH_OPTIONS then
                        i = 1
                    end
                    cfg.strength = STRENGTH_OPTIONS[i].key
                    apply()
                end)
                cycleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    local i = currentIndex() + 1
                    if i > # STRENGTH_OPTIONS then
                        i = 1
                    end
                    cfg.strength = STRENGTH_OPTIONS[i].key
                    apply()
                end)
                strengthBtn = cycleBtn
                return cycleBtn
            end

            local function createModeRow(yPos)
                local row = Instance.new("Frame", settingsFrame)
                row.Size = UDim2.new(1, - 20, 0, 36)

                local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)

                lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
                lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                lbl.Text = "Mode"

                lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

                local function makeModeBtn(text, key, xPos)
                    local b = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
                    b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 24)
                    b.Position = UDim2.new(1, xPos, 0.5, - 12)
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = C.inputBg
                    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    b.AutoButtonColor = false
                    b.Text = text
                    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
                    b.TextSize = 11
                    b.ZIndex = 24
                    corner(b, 7)
                    stroke(b, C.edge, 1, 0.3)
                    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        cfg.mode = key
                        saveConfig()
                        local on1 = cfg.mode == "v1"
                        local on2 = cfg.mode == "v2"
                        if v1Btn then
                            v1Btn.BackgroundColor3 = on1 and C.accent or C.inputBg
                            v1Btn.TextColor3 = on1 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or C.accent
                        end
                        if v2Btn then
                            v2Btn.BackgroundColor3 = on2 and C.accent or C.inputBg
                            v2Btn.TextColor3 = on2 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or C.accent
                        end
                    end)
                    return b
                end
                v1Btn = makeModeBtn("V1", "v1", - 142)
                v2Btn = makeModeBtn("V2", "v2", - 74)
                return v1Btn, v2Btn
            end
            local function refreshModeButtons()
                local on1 = cfg.mode == "v1"
                local on2 = cfg.mode == "v2"
                if v1Btn then
                    v1Btn.BackgroundColor3 = on1 and C.accent or C.inputBg
                    v1Btn.TextColor3 = on1 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or C.accent
                end
                if v2Btn then
                    v2Btn.BackgroundColor3 = on2 and C.accent or C.inputBg
                    v2Btn.TextColor3 = on2 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or C.accent
                end
            end

            local function createBackgroundRow(yPos)
                local row = Instance.new("Frame", settingsFrame)
                row.Size = UDim2.new(1, - 20, 0, 72)
                row.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPos)
                row.BackgroundColor3 = C.card
                row.BorderSizePixel = 0
                row.ZIndex = 22
                corner(row, 10)
                stroke(row, C.edge, 1, 0.25)
                local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
                lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, - 20, 0, 16)
                lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 6)
                lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                lbl.Text = "Background"
                lbl.TextColor3 = C.white
                lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                lbl.TextSize = 11
                lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
                lbl.ZIndex = 23
                local strip = Instance.new("Frame", row)
                strip.Size = UDim2.new(1, - 20, 0, 40)
                strip.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 26)
                strip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                strip.ZIndex = 23
                local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", strip)
                layout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
                layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
                layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
                local refs = {}
                local function refresh()
                    for _, r in ipairs(refs) do
                        local on = r.id ==(cfg.backgroundId or "")
                        r.stroke.Color = on and C.accent or C.edge
                        r.stroke.Thickness = on and 1.6 or 1
                    end
                end
                for _, opt in ipairs(BG_OPTIONS) do
                    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", strip)
                    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 36)
                    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
                    btn.Text = ""
                    btn.ZIndex = 24
                    corner(btn, 8)
                    local st = stroke(btn, C.edge, 1, 0)
                    if opt.id ~= "" then
                        local thumb = Instance.new("ImageLabel", btn)
                        thumb.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                        thumb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        thumb.Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. opt.id .. "&w=420&h=420"
                        thumb.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
                        thumb.ZIndex = 24
                        corner(thumb, 8)
                    else
                        local off = Instance.new("TextLabel", btn)
                        off.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
                        off.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        off.Text = "Off"
                        off.TextColor3 = C.dim
                        off.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                        off.TextSize = 10
                        off.ZIndex = 25
                    end
                    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        applyBackground(opt.id, {
                            mainBg,
                            setBg
                        })
                        refresh()
                        saveConfig()
                    end)
                    refs[# refs + 1] = {
                        id = opt.id,
                        stroke = st
                    }
                end
                refresh()
                return refresh
            end
