            local function findRemote()
                local rrs = game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
                if not rrs then
                    return nil
                end
                local found
                for _, name in ipairs({
                    "SetPlayerBlockList",
                    "UpdatePlayerBlockList",
                    "SetBlockList",
                    "UpdateBlockList"
                }) do
                    local r = rrs:FindFirstChild(name)
                    if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                        found = r
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not found then
                    for _, c in ipairs(rrs:GetChildren()) do
                        if c:IsA("RemoteEvent") and c.Name:find("Block") then
                            found = c
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                return found
            end

            local function buildPayload(power, depth, scale)
                depth = depth or 186
                scale = scale or 1.0
                local main = {}
                local nested = {
                    {}
                }
                local current = nested[1]
                for _ = 1, depth do
                    local n = {}
                    table.insert(current, n)
                    current = n
                end
                local baseRep = math.floor(power / 188)
                local maxRep = math.floor(baseRep * scale)
                maxRep = math.min(maxRep, math.floor(10000 * scale))
                maxRep = math.max(maxRep, 1)
                for _ = 1, maxRep do
                    table.insert(main, nested)
                end
                return main
            end
            local V2_PAYLOAD_BOOST = 1.35
            local function runPingLoop()
                if cfg.mode == "v2" then
                    while active and remote do
                        local preset = getStrengthPreset()
                        local payload = buildPayload(cfg.power, preset.depth, preset.scale * V2_PAYLOAD_BOOST)
                        pcall(function()
                            remote:FireServer(payload)
                        end)
                        task.wait(cfg.interval)
                    end
                else
                    local delay = cfg.interval
                    while active and remote do
                        local preset = getStrengthPreset()
                        local payload = buildPayload(cfg.power, preset.depth, preset.scale)
                        local ok = pcall(function()
                            remote:FireServer(payload)
                        end)
                        if not ok then
                            delay = math.min(delay * 1.5, 0.5)
                        else
                            delay = math.max(delay * 0.995, 0.05)
                        end
                        task.wait(delay)
                    end
                end
            end
            local function flipLag(state, isManual)
                active = state
                if isManual then
                    if brainrotMode then
                        manualOverride = not state
                    else
                        manualOverride = false
                    end
                end

                    activateStroke.Transparency = 0.45

            end)
            local AUTO_MIN_WS = 10
            local AUTO_MAX_WS = 25
            _conns[# _conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                if not panelOpen then
                    return
                end
                if not cfg.autoBrainrot then
                    if brainrotMode then
                        brainrotMode = false
                        lastBrainrotState = false
                    end
                    return
                end
                local char = plr.Character
                if not char then
                    return
                end
                local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
                if not hum then
                    return
                end
                local ws = hum.WalkSpeed
                local hasBrainrot = ws >= AUTO_MIN_WS and ws <= AUTO_MAX_WS
                if hasBrainrot and not lastBrainrotState then
                    brainrotMode = true
                    lastBrainrotState = true
                    manualOverride = false
                    flipLag(true)
                elseif not hasBrainrot and lastBrainrotState then
                    brainrotMode = false
                    lastBrainrotState = false
                    manualOverride = false
                    flipLag(false)
                end
            end)
            _conns[# _conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
                local kc = input.KeyCode
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                    return
                end
                local isGp = isGamepad(kc)
                local isKb = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
                if listeningFor then
                    if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                        listeningFor = nil
                        updateKbLabels()
                        return
                    end
                    if listeningFor == "kb" and isKb and not BLACKLISTED[kc] then
                        cfg.keybindKb = kc.Name
                        listeningFor = nil
                        updateKbLabels()
                        saveConfig()
                        return
                    end
                    if listeningFor == "gp" and isGp then
                        cfg.keybindGp = kc.Name
                        listeningFor = nil
                        updateKbLabels()
                        saveConfig()
                        return
                    end
                    return
                end
                if processed or not panelOpen then
                    return
                end
                local kbEnum = resolveKb(cfg.keybindKb)
                local gpEnum = resolveKb(cfg.keybindGp)
                if (kbEnum and kc == kbEnum and isKb) or(gpEnum and kc == gpEnum and isGp) then
                    flipLag(not active, true)
                end
            end)
            updateKbLabels()
            local function setOpen(on)
                on = on == true
                if panelOpen == on then
                    return
                end
                panelOpen = on

                    mainFrame.Visible = true
                else
                    closeSettings()
                    if active then
                        flipLag(false)
                    end
                    brainrotMode, lastBrainrotState, manualOverride = false, false, false
                    mainFrame.Visible = false
                end
            end

                    setOpen(not panelOpen);
                    return panelOpen

            local function snapPower(value)
                local steps = math.floor((value - MIN_POWER) / STEP + 0.5)
                return math.clamp(MIN_POWER + steps * STEP, MIN_POWER, MAX_POWER)
            end
            local function snapGui(value)
                local steps = math.floor((value - MIN_GUI) / GUI_STEP + 0.5)
                return math.clamp(MIN_GUI + steps * GUI_STEP, MIN_GUI, MAX_GUI)
            end
            local function saveData()
                pcall(function()
                    local data = {
                        Mode = State.Mode,
                        ModeScheme = 2,
                        BackgroundIndex = State.BackgroundIndex,
                        Power = State.Power,
                        Keybind = State.Keybind and State.Keybind.Name or nil,
                        GuiSize = State.GuiSize,
                        AutoEnable = State.AutoEnable,
                        Compact = State.Compact
                    }
                    writefile(SAVE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(data))
                end)
            end
            local function loadData()
                if not isfile(SAVE_FILE) then
                    return false
                end
                local success, data = pcall(function()
                    return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SAVE_FILE))
                end)
                if success and data then
                    if data.ModeScheme == 2 and(data.Mode == "V1" or data.Mode == "V2") then
                        State.Mode = data.Mode
                    else
                        State.Mode = "V1"
                    end
                    if data.BackgroundIndex ~= nil then
                        State.BackgroundIndex = math.clamp(tonumber(data.BackgroundIndex) or 1, 1, 4)
                    end
                    if data.Power then
                        State.Power = snapPower(data.Power)
                    end
                    if data.Keybind then
                        local key = Enum.KeyCode[data.Keybind]
                        if key then
                            State.Keybind = key
                        end
                    end
                    if data.GuiSize then
                        State.GuiSize = snapGui(tonumber(data.GuiSize) or DEFAULT_GUI)
                    end
                    if data.AutoEnable ~= nil then
                        State.AutoEnable = data.AutoEnable
                    end
                    State.Compact = data.Compact == true
                    return true
                end
                return false
            end

                if unlimitedKbps then
                    pcall(function()
                        game:GetService("NetworkClient"):SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge)
                    end)
                end
                if not remote then
                    remote = findRemote()
                    if not remote then
                        return
                    end
                end
                payload = buildFn()
                if loopTask then
                    task.cancel(loopTask)
                    loopTask = nil
                end

                    while State.Enabled do
                        if not remote then
                            remote = findRemote()
                            task.wait(1)
                        else
                            pcall(function()
                                remote:FireServer(payload)
                            end)
                            task.wait(delay)
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end

                if loopTask then
                    task.cancel(loopTask)
                    loopTask = nil
                end
            end

            end

                value = snapPower(value)
                State.Power = value

                if not skipTextbox then

                end
                saveData()
                if State.Enabled and State.Mode == "V1" then
                    payload = buildPayload()

            do
                local dragging = false
                local function updateFromInputPosition(inputPos)
                    local trackPos = SliderTrack.AbsolutePosition.X
                    local trackSize = SliderTrack.AbsoluteSize.X
                    local alpha = math.clamp((inputPos - trackPos) / trackSize, 0, 1)
                    setPower(MIN_POWER + alpha *(MAX_POWER - MIN_POWER))
                end
                SliderKnob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

                    end

                SliderTrack.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        dragging = true
                        updateFromInputPosition(input.Position.X)
                    end
                end)
                _conns[# _conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if dragging and(input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        updateFromInputPosition(input.Position.X)
                    end
                end)
                _conns[# _conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        dragging = false

                end)

                    startPos = MainFrame.Position
                end
                local function updateDrag(input)
                    if dragging and(input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
                    end
                end
                local function endDrag()
                    dragging = false
                end
                TitleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        startDrag(input)
                    end
                end)
                _conns[# _conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(updateDrag)
                _conns[# _conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        endDrag()
                    end
                end)
            end
            local function checkAutoWalkSpeed()
                if not State.AutoEnable then
                    if State.AutoActive then
                        State.AutoActive = false
                        setEnabled(false)
                    end
                    return
                end
                local char = LocalPlayer.Character
                if not char then
                    if State.AutoActive then
                        State.AutoActive = false
                        setEnabled(false)
                    end
                    return
                end
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not hum then
                    if State.AutoActive then
                        State.AutoActive = false
                        setEnabled(false)
                    end
                    return
                end
                local ws = hum.WalkSpeed
                local inRange = ws >= AUTO_MIN_WS and ws <= AUTO_MAX_WS
                if inRange and not State.Enabled then
                    State.AutoActive = true
                    setEnabled(true)
                elseif not inRange and State.Enabled and State.AutoActive then
                    State.AutoActive = false
                    setEnabled(false)
                end
            end
            local function autoSave()
                saveTimer = saveTimer + 1
                if saveTimer >= saveInterval then
                    saveTimer = 0
                    saveData()
                end
            end
            _conns[# _conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
                autoSave()
                checkAutoWalkSpeed()
                if not remote then
                    remote = findRemote()
                end
            end)
            _conns[# _conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
                if State.Listening then
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then
                        if input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                            State.Keybind = input.KeyCode
                            if KeybindButton then
                                KeybindButton.Text = input.KeyCode.Name
                            end
                            State.Listening = false
                            saveData()
                        end
                    end
                    return
                end
                if gameProcessed then
                    return
                end
                if State.Keybind and input.KeyCode == State.Keybind then
                    toggleEnabled()
                end
            end)
            updateAccentTheme = function(previousAccent, previousAccentDim)
                for _, object in ipairs(MainFrame:GetDescendants()) do
                    if object:IsA("UIStroke") then
                        if object.Color == previousAccent then
                            object.Color = Theme.Accent
                        elseif object.Color == previousAccentDim then
                            object.Color = Theme.AccentDim
                        end
                    elseif object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
                        if object.TextColor3 == previousAccent then
                            object.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent
                        end
                    elseif object:IsA("GuiObject") then
                        if object.BackgroundColor3 == previousAccent then
                            object.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
                        elseif object.BackgroundColor3 == previousAccentDim then
                            object.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentDim
                        end
                    end
                end
                applyModeVisual()
                applyStartVisual()
                updateToggleVisual()
            end

                    end

            end
        end

        _G.VezySaveUserConfigs = function()
            if not writefile then
                return
            end
            pcall(function()
                local json = HttpService:JSONEncode(_G._VezyUserConfigs)
                writefile("VezyUserConfigs.json", json)
            end)
        end
        _G.VezyLoadUserConfigs = function()
            if not readfile then
                return
            end
            pcall(function()
                if isfile and isfile("VezyUserConfigs.json") then
                    local data = readfile("VezyUserConfigs.json")
                    local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
                        return HttpService:JSONDecode(data)
                    end)
                    if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then
                        _G._VezyUserConfigs = decoded
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        local function makeUserConfigRow(name)
            local row = Instance.new("Frame", pSettings)
            row.Name = "UserConfig_" .. name
            row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, getMobileOptimized(38, 34))
            row.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
            row.BorderSizePixel = 0
            _G._VezyUserConfigOrder = _G._VezyUserConfigOrder + 1
            row.LayoutOrder = _G._VezyUserConfigOrder
            row.ZIndex = 4
            Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
            local rSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", row)
            rSt.Color = ACC;
            rSt.Thickness = 1;
            rSt.Transparency = 1
            local loadBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
            loadBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, - 42, 1, 0)
            loadBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            loadBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            loadBtn.Text = string.upper(name)
            loadBtn.TextColor3 = WHITE
            loadBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            loadBtn.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10)
            loadBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
            loadBtn.ZIndex = 5
            local delBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
            delBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 22)
            delBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, - 36, 0.5, - 11)
            delBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            delBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            delBtn.Text = "x"
            delBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            delBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            delBtn.TextSize = 12
            delBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
            delBtn.ZIndex = 6
            Instance.new("UICorner", delBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
            row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = CARD2
                }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(rSt, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    Transparency = 0.1
                }):Play()
            end)
            row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = CARD
                }):Play()
                TweenService:Create(rSt, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    Transparency = 0.5
                }):Play()
            end)
            loadBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if _G._VezyUserConfigs[name] then
                    _G.VezyApplyConfig(_G._VezyUserConfigs[name])
                    TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
                        BackgroundColor3 = ACC
                    }):Play()
                    loadBtn.Text = "LOADED!"
                    loadBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                    task.delay(1.2,
                    function()
                        if row and row.Parent then
                            TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
                                BackgroundColor3 = CARD
                            }):Play()
                            loadBtn.Text = string.upper(name)
                            loadBtn.TextColor3 = WHITE
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
            delBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(delBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,
                    0,
                    0)
                }):Play()
            end)
            delBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(delBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,
                    0,
                    0)
                }):Play()
            end)
            delBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                _G._VezyUserConfigs[name] = nil
                _G._VezyUserConfigButtons[name] = nil
                if _G.VezySaveUserConfigs then
                    _G.VezySaveUserConfigs()
                end
                TweenService:Create(row, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {
                    Size = UDim2.new(1,
                    0,
                    0,
                    0)
                }):Play()
                task.delay(0.25,
                function()
                    if row and row.Parent then
                        row:Destroy()
                    end
                end)
            end)
            _G._VezyUserConfigButtons[name] = row
            return row
        end
        do
            local saveRow = Instance.new("Frame", pSettings)
            saveRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, getMobileOptimized(38, 34))
            saveRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            saveRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
            saveRow.LayoutOrder = 31
            saveRow.ZIndex = 4
            local inputBg = Instance.new("Frame", saveRow)
            inputBg.Size = UDim2.new(0.65, - 4, 1, 0)
            inputBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
            inputBg.BackgroundColor3 = CARD
            inputBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
            Instance.new("UICorner", inputBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
            local inSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", inputBg)
            inSt.Color = ACC;
            inSt.Thickness = 1;
            inSt.Transparency = 1
            local nameBox = Instance.new("TextBox", inputBg)
            nameBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, - 16, 1, 0)
            nameBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
            nameBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            nameBox.Text = ""
            nameBox.PlaceholderText = "Config name..."
            nameBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            nameBox.TextColor3 = WHITE
            nameBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            nameBox.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10)
            nameBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            nameBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
            nameBox.ZIndex = 5
            nameBox.Focused:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(inSt, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    Color = ACC,
                    Transparency = 0
                }):Play()
            end)
            nameBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(inSt, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    Color = ACC,
                    Transparency = 0.5
                }):Play()
            end)
            local saveBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", saveRow)
            saveBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.35, - 4, 1, 0)
            saveBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.65, 4, 0, 0)
            saveBtn.BackgroundColor3 = ACC
            saveBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            saveBtn.Text = "SAVE"
            saveBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            saveBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            saveBtn.TextSize = getMobileOptimized(11, 10)
            saveBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
            saveBtn.ZIndex = 5
            Instance.new("UICorner", saveBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
            saveBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(saveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,
                    255,
                    255)
                }):Play()
            end)
            saveBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(saveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.15), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = ACC
                }):Play()
            end)
            saveBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                local name =(nameBox.Text or ""):gsub("^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
                if name == "" then
                    local origPos = inputBg.Position
                    for i = 1, 3 do
                        TweenService:Create(inputBg, TweenInfo.new(0.04), {
                            Position = UDim2.new(origPos.X.Scale,
                            origPos.X.Offset + 6,
                            origPos.Y.Scale,
                            origPos.Y.Offset)
                        }):Play()
                        task.wait(0.05)
                        TweenService:Create(inputBg, TweenInfo.new(0.04), {
                            Position = UDim2.new(origPos.X.Scale,
                            origPos.X.Offset - 6,
                            origPos.Y.Scale,
                            origPos.Y.Offset)
                        }):Play()
                        task.wait(0.05)
                    end
                    TweenService:Create(inputBg, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {
                        Position = origPos
                    }):Play()
                    return
                end
                if # name > 20 then
                    name = name:sub(1, 20)
                end
                _G._VezyUserConfigs[name] = _G.VezyBuildConfigSnapshot()
                if _G.VezySaveUserConfigs then
                    _G.VezySaveUserConfigs()
                end
                if not _G._VezyUserConfigButtons[name] then
                    makeUserConfigRow(name)
                end
                nameBox.Text = ""
                TweenService:Create(saveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.1), {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,
                    255,
                    255)
                }):Play()
                saveBtn.Text = "SAVED!"
                task.delay(1.0,
                function()
                    if saveBtn and saveBtn.Parent then
                        TweenService:Create(saveBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {
                            BackgroundColor3 = ACC
                        }):Play()
                        saveBtn.Text = "SAVE"
                    end
                end)
            end)
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.5)
            pcall(function()
                _G.VezyLoadUserConfigs()
            end)
            if _G._VezyUserConfigs then
                for name, _ in pairs(_G._VezyUserConfigs) do
                    if not _G._VezyUserConfigButtons[name] then
                        pcall(function()
                            makeUserConfigRow(name)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    reopenWordmark.TextScaled = true
    reopenWordmark.TextWrapped = false
    reopenWordmark.ZIndex = 41
    local reopenWordmarkStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", reopenWordmark)
    reopenWordmarkStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    reopenWordmarkStroke.Thickness = getMobileOptimized(1.4, 1.1)
    reopenWordmarkStroke.Transparency = 0
    reopenWordmarkStroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round do
        local dragging, dragStart, startPos, moved, activeInput
        reopenBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if _G._VynxUILocked then
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging, dragStart, startPos = true, input.Position, reopenBtn.Position
                moved, activeInput = false, input
                reopenBtn:SetAttribute("_Moved", false)
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if _G._VynxUILocked then
                dragging, activeInput = false, nil
                return
            end
            if not dragging then
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input ~= activeInput then
                return
            end
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            if math.abs(delta.X) > 5 or math.abs(delta.Y) > 5 then
                moved = true
                reopenBtn:SetAttribute("_Moved", true)
            end
            reopenBtn.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging then
                return
            end
            if input == activeInput or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                dragging, activeInput = false, nil
                if moved then
                    task.delay(0.15,
                    function()
                        reopenBtn:SetAttribute("_Moved", false)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

        local MB_CELL_GAP = 5
        local MB_EDGE_PAD = 12

            if def.row + 1 > MB_ROWS then
                MB_ROWS = def.row + 1

        local mobileButtonRefs = {}
        for _, def in ipairs(mobileBtnDefs) do
            local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", gui)
            btn.Name = "MB_" .. def.key
            btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, MB_W, 0, MB_H)
            local baseX = -((def.col + 1) * MB_W + def.col * MB_CELL_GAP + MB_EDGE_PAD)
            local baseY =(def.row -(MB_ROWS - 1) / 2) *(MB_H + MB_CELL_GAP) - MB_H / 2
            local savedPos = _G._VezyMobileBtnPos and _G._VezyMobileBtnPos[def.key]
            if savedPos then
                btn.Position = UDim2.new(savedPos.xs, savedPos.xo, savedPos.ys, savedPos.yo)
            else
                btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, baseX, 0.5, baseY)
            end
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            btn.Text = def.name
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            btn.TextSize = math.floor(11 * _bsize() + 0.5)
            btn.TextWrapped = true
            btn.AutoButtonColor = false
            btn.Active = true
            btn.Selectable = false
            btn.ZIndex = 101
            local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", btn)
            btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
            btn.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            btn.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
            local bSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
            bSt.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160)
            bSt.Thickness = 2.2
            bSt.Transparency = 1
            bSt.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            mobileButtonRefs[def.key] = {
                btn = btn,
                stroke = bSt,
                gradient = nil,
                corner = btnCorner,
                active = false,
                dragGuard = false
            }
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            bSt.Transparency = 1 do
                local ref = mobileButtonRefs[def.key]
                local pressing, dragging = false, false
                local pressPos, btnStart, pressInput = nil, nil, nil
                local DRAG_THRESHOLD = 6
                local function setPressedVisual(isPressed)
                    ref.pressing = isPressed == true
                    local on = ref.active == true
                    local showWhite = on or ref.pressing
                    btn.BackgroundColor3 = showWhite and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                    btn.TextColor3 = showWhite and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
                    btn.TextTransparency = 0
                    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
                    ref.stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160)
                    ref.stroke.Thickness = 2.2
                    ref.stroke.Transparency =(on or ref.pressing) and 0 or 1
                    ref.stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
                end
                btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if _G._VynxUILocked then
                        return
                    end
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        pressing = true
                        pressInput = input
                        setPressedVisual(true)
                        dragging = false
                        pressPos = input.Position
                        btnStart = btn.Position
                    end
                end)
                UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        return
                    end
                    if not pressing or(pressInput and input ~= pressInput) then
                        return
                    end
                    pressing = false
                    pressInput = nil
                    setPressedVisual(false)
                    if dragging then
                        dragging = false
                        _G._VezyMobileBtnPos = _G._VezyMobileBtnPos or {}
                        _G._VezyMobileBtnPos[def.key] = {
                            xs = btn.Position.X.Scale,
                            xo = btn.Position.X.Offset,
                            ys = btn.Position.Y.Scale,
                            yo = btn.Position.Y.Offset,
                        }
                        if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                            _G.KRIXSaveNow()
                        end
                        task.delay(0.15,
                        function()
                            ref.dragGuard = false
                        end)
                    end
                end)
                UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if _G._VynxUILocked then
                        pressing = false
                        dragging = false
                        pressInput = nil
                        ref.dragGuard = false
                        setPressedVisual(false)
                        return
                    end
                    if not pressing then
                        return
                    end
                    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        return
                    end
                    local delta = input.Position - pressPos
                    if not dragging then
                        if math.abs(delta.X) > DRAG_THRESHOLD or math.abs(delta.Y) > DRAG_THRESHOLD then
                            dragging = true
                            ref.dragGuard = true
                        end
                    end
                    if dragging then
                        btn.Position = UDim2.new(btnStart.X.Scale, btnStart.X.Offset + delta.X, btnStart.Y.Scale, btnStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        local function setMobileBtnState(key, on)
            local ref = mobileButtonRefs[key]
            if not ref then
                return
            end
            on =(on == true)
            ref.active = on
            if ref.gradient then
                ref.gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(on and MB_ACTIVE or MB_BG, on and MB_ACTIVE or MB_BG)
            end
            ref.btn.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            ref.btn.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            ref.btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            ref.btn.TextTransparency = 0
            ref.btn.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
            ref.btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
            ref.btn.AutoButtonColor = false
            if ref.pressing then
                ref.btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                ref.btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            end
            ref.stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 160)
            ref.stroke.Transparency = ref.pressing and 0 or(on and 0 or 1)
            ref.stroke.Thickness = 2.2
            ref.stroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        end
        _G._VynxSetMobileBtnState = setMobileBtnState
        local mobileActionFlashToken = {}
        local function flashMobileActionButton(key)
            local ref = mobileButtonRefs[key]
            if not ref then
                return
            end
            local token =(mobileActionFlashToken[key] or 0) + 1
            mobileActionFlashToken[key] = token
            setMobileBtnState(key, true)
            task.delay(0.45,
            function()
                if mobileActionFlashToken[key] == token then
                    setMobileBtnState(key, false)
                end
            end)
        end

                    ref.stroke.Transparency = ref.active and 0 or 1
                    ref.stroke.Thickness = 2.2
                end
            end
        end

        local MB_GAP = MB_BASE_GX - MB_BASE_W
        local function mbMetrics(s)
            local circle = _G._VynxMobileCircle == true
            local w = math.floor(MB_BASE_W * s + 0.5)
            local h = circle and w or math.floor(MB_BASE_H * s + 0.5)
            local gap = math.floor(MB_GAP * s + 0.5)
            local gx = circle and(w + gap) or math.floor(MB_BASE_GX * s + 0.5)
            local gy = circle and(h + gap) or math.floor(MB_BASE_GY * s + 0.5)
            return w, h, gx, gy
        end
        local function mbDefaultPos(def, s)
            local w, h = mbMetrics(s)
            local xOffset = -((def.col + 1) * w + def.col * MB_CELL_GAP + MB_EDGE_PAD)
            local yOffset =(def.row -(MB_ROWS - 1) / 2) *(h + MB_CELL_GAP) - h / 2
            return UDim2.new(1, xOffset, 0.5, yOffset)
        end
        _G._VynxResetMobileBtnPos = function()
            _G._VezyMobileBtnPos = {}
            local s = math.clamp(_G._VynxMobileBtnScale or 1.0, 0.7, 2.0)
            for _, def in ipairs(mobileBtnDefs) do
                local ref = mobileButtonRefs[def.key]
                if ref and ref.btn then
                    TweenService:Create(ref.btn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {
                        Position = mbDefaultPos(def,
                        s)
                    }):Play()
                end
            end
            if _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNowInstant)
            end
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end
        _G._VynxMobileCircle = _G._VynxMobileCircle or false
        _G._VynxMobileShown = _G._VynxMobileShown or {}

            table.insert(_G._VynxMobileButtonList, {
                key = def.key,
                label =(def.name:gsub("\n",
                " ")),
            })
        end
        local function mbShown(key)
            if _G._VezyHideSideBtns == true then
                return false
            end
            return _G._VynxMobileShown[key] ~= false
        end
        _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale = function(newScale)
            _G._VynxMobileBtnScale = math.clamp(newScale or 1.0, 0.7, 2.0)
            local s = _G._VynxMobileBtnScale * DEVICE_UI_SCALE
            local circle = _G._VynxMobileCircle == true
            local nw, nh = mbMetrics(s)
            local newTextSize = math.floor((circle and 11 or 11) * s + 0.5)
            for _, def in ipairs(mobileBtnDefs) do
                local ref = mobileButtonRefs[def.key]
                if ref and ref.btn then
                    ref.btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, nw, 0, nh)
                    ref.btn.TextSize = newTextSize
                    ref.btn.Visible = mbShown(def.key)
                    if ref.corner then
                        ref.corner.CornerRadius = circle and UDim.new(1, 0) or UDim.new(0, 14)
                    end
                    if not(_G._VezyMobileBtnPos and _G._VezyMobileBtnPos[def.key]) then
                        ref.btn.Position = mbDefaultPos(def, s)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        _G._VynxSetMobileCircle = function(on)
            _G._VynxMobileCircle = on and true or false
            _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale(_G._VynxMobileBtnScale)
        end
        _G._VynxSetMobileButtonShown = function(key, on)

    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, g)
        if hubStale() then
            return
        end
        if _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive and _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive() then
            return
        end
        local isKey = i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard
        local isPad = _isGamepadInput(i)
        if not isKey and not isPad then
            return
        end
        local toggleKey = Keybinds.UIToggle
        local hitToggle =(toggleKey ~= nil and toggleKey ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and i.KeyCode == toggleKey)
        local hitStart = isPad and i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonStart
        if not hitToggle and not hitStart then
            return
        end
        local currentlyOpen =(_hubShown == true) and outer and outer.Visible == true
        if gui and gui.Parent then
            gui.Enabled = true
        end
        setHubVisible(not currentlyOpen, true)
    end)

    local function sbRadiusText(value)
        local text = string.format("%.1f", tonumber(value) or 0)
        return(text:gsub("%.0$", ""))
    end
    local function sbAimbotSpeed()
        local fam = Spd and Spd.family
        if fam == "lagger" then
            return tonumber(_G._VezyBatAimbotSpeedLagger) or 40
        end
        return tonumber(_G._VezyBatAimbotSpeed) or 58
    end
    local function sbModeText()
        if _G._VezyBatAimbotOn == true then
            return "AIMBOT " .. sbRadiusText(sbAimbotSpeed()) .. " SPEED"
        end
        local mode = "Normal"
        if false then
            local radius = tonumber(_G._VynxStealRadiusSemi) or 8.7
            return "SEMI " .. sbRadiusText(radius) .. " RADIUS"
        end
        local radius = tonumber(_G._VynxStealRadiusNormal) or tonumber(Settings.StealRadius) or 62
        return "NORMAL " .. sbRadiusText(radius) .. " RADIUS"
    end
    local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
    task.spawn(function()
        local fpsAvg = 60
        local fpsFrames, fpsElapsed = 0, 0
        RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if hubStale() then
                return
            end
            dt = tonumber(dt) or 0
            if dt <= 0 or dt > 1 then
                return
            end
            fpsFrames = fpsFrames + 1
            fpsElapsed = fpsElapsed + dt
            if fpsElapsed >= 0.5 then
                fpsAvg = fpsFrames / fpsElapsed
                fpsFrames = 0
                fpsElapsed = 0
            end
        end))
        local pingSmooth = nil
        while pb.Parent do
            local ping = 0
            pcall(function()
                local v = LocalPlayer:GetNetworkPing()
                if type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then
                    ping = v * 1000
                end
            end)
            if ping <= 0 then
                pcall(function()
                    local stat = Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]
                    if not stat then
                        return
                    end
                    local raw = stat:GetValue()
                    if type(raw) == "number" then
                        ping = raw
                    elseif type(raw) == "string" then
                        ping = tonumber((raw:gsub("[^%d%.]", ""))) or 0
                    end
                end)
            end
            if ping > 0 then
                if pingSmooth == nil then
                    pingSmooth = ping
                else
                    pingSmooth = pingSmooth * 0.65 + ping * 0.35
                end
            end
            local show = pingSmooth or ping
            sbFps.Text = string.format("FPS: %d", math.floor(fpsAvg + 0.5))
            sbPing.Text = string.format("PING: %dms", math.floor((show or 0) + 0.5))
            sbMode.Text = sbModeText()
            task.wait(0.4)
        end
    end) do
        local dragging, dStart, sPos, activeInp
        pb.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if _G._VynxUILocked then
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true;
                dStart = input.Position;
                sPos = pb.Position;
                activeInp = input
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if _G._VynxUILocked then
                dragging = false
                activeInp = nil
                return
            end
            if not dragging then
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or(input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == activeInp) then
                local d = input.Position - dStart
                pb.Position = UDim2.new(sPos.X.Scale, sPos.X.Offset + d.X, sPos.Y.Scale, sPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            end
        end)
        UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging then
                return
            end
            if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
                return
            end
            dragging = false;
            activeInp = nil
            local p = pb.Position
            _G._VlPbPos = {
                p.X.Scale,
                p.X.Offset,
                p.Y.Scale,
                p.Y.Offset
            }
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
            end
        end)
    end
    local sbFillTween, sbResetTween
    local function ResetProgressBar()
        pctMiniLbl.Text = "0%"
        if sbFillTween then
            pcall(function()
                sbFillTween:Cancel()
            end);
            sbFillTween = nil
        end
        if sbResetTween then
            pcall(function()
                sbResetTween:Cancel()
            end)
        end
        sbResetTween = TweenService:Create(ProgressBarFill, TweenInfo.new(0.06, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(0,
            1)
        })
        sbResetTween:Play()
    end
    _G.StealBar = {
        SetProgress = function(v)
            v = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 0,
            0,
            1)
            if sbFillTween then
                pcall(function()
                    sbFillTween:Cancel()
                end);
                sbFillTween = nil

            pctMiniLbl.Text = math.floor(v * 100 + 0.5) .. "%"

        end,

        end,

    local function hkb(kc)
        if _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive and _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive() then
            return
        end
        if waitingForKey then
            return
        end
        if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
            return
        end
        do
            local irKeyName = _G._VynxInstaResetKey
            if (Keybinds.InstaReset and Keybinds.InstaReset ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and kc == Keybinds.InstaReset) or(irKeyName and kc.Name == irKeyName) then
                if _G.VynxDoInstaReset then
                    _G.VynxDoInstaReset()
                end
                return
            end
        end
        if kc == Keybinds.SpeedToggle then
            Spd.Carry()
        elseif kc == Keybinds.LaggerToggle or kc == Keybinds.LaggerSpeed then
            Spd.Lagger()
        elseif kc == Keybinds.NormalSpeed then
            Spd.Normal()
        end
        if kc == Keybinds.AutoBat then
            if batClk then
                batClk(not(_G._VezyBatAimbotOn or false))
            end
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                _G.KRIXSaveNow()
            end
        end
        if kc == Keybinds.InfiniteJump then
            Enabled.InfiniteJump = not Enabled.InfiniteJump
            if VisualSetters.InfiniteJump then
                VisualSetters.InfiniteJump(Enabled.InfiniteJump)
            end
            if Enabled.InfiniteJump then
                startInfiniteJump()
            else
                stopInfiniteJump()
            end
            if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                _G.KRIXSaveNow()
            end
        end
        if kc == Keybinds.DropBrainrot then
            if setDropBrainrotVisual then
                setDropBrainrotVisual(true)
            end
            task.spawn(runDropBrainrot)
        end
        if kc == Keybinds.TPDown then
            if _G._VynxRunTPDown then
                pcall(_G._VynxRunTPDown)
            end
        end
    end
    UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, g)
        if hubStale() then
            return
        end
        if g then
            return
        end
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            hkb(i.KeyCode)
        elseif _isGamepadInput(i) then
            hkb(i.KeyCode)
        end
    end)

    (function()
        local function applyUIScale(val)
            local prevScale =(UI_SCALE or 1) * DEVICE_UI_SCALE
            UI_SCALE = math.clamp(val, 0.5, 2.0)
            local newScale = UI_SCALE * DEVICE_UI_SCALE
            local function recentre()
                if not outer or prevScale == newScale then
                    return
                end
                local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
                local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
                local baseW, baseH = outer.Size.X.Offset, outer.Size.Y.Offset
                if baseW <= 0 or baseH <= 0 then
                    return
                end
                local p = outer.Position
                local ox = p.X.Offset - baseW *(newScale - prevScale) / 2
                local oy = p.Y.Offset - baseH *(newScale - prevScale) / 2
                local w, h = baseW * newScale, baseH * newScale
                local minX, minY = 8 - p.X.Scale * vp.X, 8 - p.Y.Scale * vp.Y
                ox = math.clamp(ox, minX, math.max(minX, vp.X - w - 8 - p.X.Scale * vp.X))
                oy = math.clamp(oy, minY, math.max(minY, vp.Y - h - 8 - p.Y.Scale * vp.Y))
                outer.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, ox, p.Y.Scale, oy)
            end
            local function applyToFrame(frame)
                if not frame then
                    return
                end
                local s = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
                if not s then
                    s = Instance.new("UIScale");
                    s.Parent = frame
                end
                s.Scale = UI_SCALE * DEVICE_UI_SCALE
            end
            local function doApply()
                applyToFrame(outer)
                recentre()
                if not apMain then
                    return
                end
                if apMain:IsDescendantOf(outer) then
                    local s = apMain:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
                    if s then
                        s.Scale = 1
                    end
                else
                    applyToFrame(apMain)
                end
            end
            if outer then
                doApply()
            else
                task.spawn(function()
                    repeat
                        task.wait(0.05)
                    until outer and apMain;
                    doApply()
                end)
            end
        end
        _G._VynxApplyUIScale = applyUIScale
        if UI_SCALE then
            pcall(applyUIScale, UI_SCALE)
        end

                end
                if cfg.hitDist and type(cfg.hitDist) == "number" then
                    _G._VezyHitDist = cfg.hitDist
                end
                if cfg.batAimbotOn ~= nil then
                    _G._VezyBatAimbotOn = cfg.batAimbotOn
                    if cfg.batAimbotOn then
                        task.delay(0.5,
                        function()
                            if _G.VezyStartBatAimbotDispatch then
                                pcall(_G.VezyStartBatAimbotDispatch)
                            elseif _G.VezyStartBatAimbot then
                                pcall(_G.VezyStartBatAimbot)
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
                if cfg.aimbotSpeed and type(cfg.aimbotSpeed) == "number" then
                    _G._VezyBatAimbotSpeed = cfg.aimbotSpeed
                    if _G._VezyAimbotSpeedInputRef then
                        pcall(function()
                            _G._VezyAimbotSpeedInputRef.Text = tostring(cfg.aimbotSpeed)
                        end)
                    end
                end
                if cfg.btnOpacity and type(cfg.btnOpacity) == "number" then
                    _G._VezyBtnOpacity = 1
                end
                if cfg.bgOpacity and type(cfg.bgOpacity) == "number" then
                    _G._VezyBgOpacity = cfg.bgOpacity
                    if _G._VezyBgImageRef then
                        _G._VezyBgImageRef.ImageTransparency = 1 - cfg.bgOpacity
                    end
                end
                if cfg.uiLocked ~= nil then
                    _G._VynxUILocked = cfg.uiLocked
                    task.delay(0.5,
                    function()
                        if VisualSetters.LockUI then
                            pcall(VisualSetters.LockUI, cfg.uiLocked)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                if cfg.hideSideBtns ~= nil then
                    _G._VezyHideSideBtns = cfg.hideSideBtns
                    task.delay(0.5,
                    function()
                        local gui = _G._VezyMobileButtonsFrame and _G._VezyMobileButtonsFrame.Parent
                        if gui then
                            for _, child in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
                                if child:IsA("TextButton") and child.Name:sub(1, 3) == "MB_" then

                                end

                        end

                            pcall(VisualSetters.HideSideBtns, cfg.hideSideBtns)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                if cfg.controllerBinds and type(cfg.controllerBinds) == "table" then

                end
                if lsb then

                end
                local function _fmtV(v)
                    return(v == math.floor(v)) and tostring(math.floor(v)) or string.format("%.1f", v)
                end
                if lagNormalInput then

                if lagCarryInput then
                    lagCarryInput.Text = _fmtV(_G.LaggerSpeed_Carry)

                    if Keybinds[kName] and lbl and lbl.Parent then

                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        loadConfig()
        task.spawn(function()
            for _, t in ipairs({

                0.8,
                1.5,
                3,
                5
            }) do
                task.wait(t)

                            lbl.Text = _G._VioletteccKeyName(Keybinds[kName])

                    end
                    if _G._VynxRefreshInstaResetKey then
                        pcall(_G._VynxRefreshInstaResetKey)
                    end
                end)
            end
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            for _, t in ipairs({
                0.3,
                0.8,
                1.5,
                3,
                5
            }) do
                task.wait(t)
                if _G.VezySetBtnOpacity then
                    pcall(_G.VezySetBtnOpacity, 1)
                end
                if _G.VezySetBgOpacity then
                    pcall(_G.VezySetBgOpacity, _G._VezyBgOpacity or 1)
                end
                if _G._VezyBgImageId and _G._VezyBgImageId ~= "" and _G.VezySetBgImage then
                    pcall(_G.VezySetBgImage, _G._VezyBgImageId)
                end
            end
        end)
    end)()

(function()
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService");
    local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local AP_C_CARD = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0);
    local AP_C_ACC = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
    local AP_C_DIM = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
    local AP_C_SW_OFF = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0);
    local AP_C_WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local SAVE_FILE = "AutoPlayConfig.json"
    local function apSaveConfig()
        pcall(function()
            if not writefile then
                return
            end
            writefile(SAVE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({
                mode = _G._AdaptAutoPlayMode
            }))
        end)
    end
    pcall(function()
        if not(isfile and isfile(SAVE_FILE)) then
            return
        end
        local ok, cfg = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SAVE_FILE))
        end)
        if not ok or not cfg then
            return
        end
        if cfg.mode == "Normal" or cfg.mode == "Auto Play" then
            _G._AdaptAutoPlayMode = cfg.mode
        end
    end)
    local autoPlayPage = _G._V7AutoPlayPage
    local _apFrame = Instance.new("Frame", autoPlayPage)
    _apFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0);
    _apFrame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    _apFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1;
    _apFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0;
    _apFrame.LayoutOrder = 1
    local apVstack = _apFrame
    local apLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", apVstack)
    apLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;
    apLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
    local _apPad = Instance.new("UIPadding", apVstack)
    _apPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 2);
    _apPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 2);
    _apPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 4)
    apMain = autoPlayPage
    local apOrder = 0;
    local function APO()
        apOrder = apOrder + 1;
        return apOrder
    end
    _G._AdaptAutoPlayMode =(_G._AdaptAutoPlayMode == "Auto Play") and "Auto Play" or "Normal" do
        local mRow = Instance.new("Frame", apVstack)
        mRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
        mRow.BackgroundColor3 = AP_C_CARD
        mRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        mRow.LayoutOrder = APO()
        mRow.ZIndex = 3
        Instance.new("UICorner", mRow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        local mLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", mRow)
        mLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 18)
        mLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, - 9)
        mLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        mLbl.Text = "Auto Play Mode"
        mLbl.TextColor3 = AP_C_WHITE
        mLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        mLbl.TextSize = 13
        mLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        mLbl.ZIndex = 4
        local apModeBtns = {}
        local ABW, ABH, AGAP = 66, 24, 6
        local aTotal = 2 * ABW + AGAP
        local function refreshApMode()
            for k, b in pairs(apModeBtns) do
                local on =(k == _G._AdaptAutoPlayMode)
                b.BackgroundColor3 = on and AP_C_ACC or AP_C_SW_OFF
                b.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            end
        end
        for i, option in ipairs({
            {
                value = "Normal",
                label = "Normal"
            },
            {
                value = "Auto Play",
                label = "Full"
            }
        }) do
            local v = option.value
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton", mRow)
            b.Size = UDim2.new(0, ABW, 0, ABH)
            b.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(aTotal + 12) +(i - 1) *(ABW + AGAP), 0.5, - ABH / 2)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = AP_C_SW_OFF
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.Text = option.label
            b.TextColor3 = AP_C_DIM
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
            b.TextSize = 11
            b.ZIndex = 5
            Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
            apModeBtns[v] = b
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                _G._AdaptAutoPlayMode = v
                _G._KawatanPathMode =(v == "Auto Play") and "AUTO PLAY" or "NORMAL"
                if _G._VynxOnPathModeChanged then
                    pcall(_G._VynxOnPathModeChanged)
                end
                refreshApMode()
                apSaveConfig()
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    _G.KRIXSaveNow()
                end
            end)
        end
        _G._AdaptRefreshAutoPlayMode = refreshApMode
        refreshApMode()
    end

(function()

    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    local SETTINGS_FILE = "KrixDesync_settings.json"
    local desyncActive = false
    local function setDesync(state)
        desyncActive = state and true or false
    end
    local waitingForKey = false
    local toggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.Y
    local unwalkActive = false
    local unwalkConn = nil
    local winPos = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, - 195)
    local function saveSettings()
        local ok = pcall(function()
            local cfg = {
                hotkey = toggleKey.Name,
                winX = winPos.X.Offset,
                winY = winPos.Y.Offset,
                winXS = winPos.X.Scale,
                winYS = winPos.Y.Scale,
            }
            local parts = {}
            for k, v in pairs(cfg) do
                local vStr =(type(v) == "string") and('"' .. v .. '"') or tostring(v)
                table.insert(parts, '"' .. k .. '":' .. vStr)
            end
            writefile(SETTINGS_FILE, "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}")
        end)
    end
    local function loadSettings()
        pcall(function()
            local ok, data = pcall(readfile, SETTINGS_FILE)
            if not ok or not data or data == "" then
                return
            end
            local function toVal(s)
                s = s:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
                if s:sub(1, 1) == '"' then
                    return s:sub(2, - 2)
                end
                return tonumber(s)
            end
            for k, v in data:gmatch("\"([^\"]+)\"%s*:%s*(\"?[^\",}]+\"?)") do
                local val = toVal(v)
                if k == "hotkey" and type(val) == "string" then
                    local kc = Enum.KeyCode[val]
                    if kc then
                        toggleKey = kc
                    end
                elseif k == "winX" then
                    winPos = UDim2.new(winPos.X.Scale, val, winPos.Y.Scale, winPos.Y.Offset)
                elseif k == "winY" then
                    winPos = UDim2.new(winPos.X.Scale, winPos.X.Offset, winPos.Y.Scale, val)
                elseif k == "winXS" then
                    winPos = UDim2.new(val, winPos.X.Offset, winPos.Y.Scale, winPos.Y.Offset)
                elseif k == "winYS" then
                    winPos = UDim2.new(winPos.X.Scale, winPos.X.Offset, val, winPos.Y.Offset)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    loadSettings()
    local function startUnwalkLoop()
    end
    local function setUnwalk(state, btn)
        if state then
            unwalkActive = true
            startUnwalkLoop()
            if btn then
                tween(btn, 0.25, {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,
                    255,
                    255),
                    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,
                    0,
                    0)
                })
                btn.Text = "UNWALK: ON"
            end
        else
            unwalkActive = false
            if unwalkConn then
                unwalkConn:Disconnect()
                unwalkConn = nil
            end
            if btn then
                tween(btn, 0.25, {
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,
                    0,
                    0),
                    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,
                    255,
                    255)
                })
                btn.Text = "UNWALK: OFF"
            end
        end
    end

        KeyRow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        KeyRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", KeyRow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        local keyStrokeRow = Instance.new("UIStroke", KeyRow)
        keyStrokeRow.Color = C_STROKE
        keyStrokeRow.Thickness = 1
        keyStrokeRow.Transparency = 0.6
        local KeyLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", KeyRow)
        KeyLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 1, 0)
        KeyLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
        KeyLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        KeyLbl.Text = "Hotkey"
        KeyLbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        KeyLbl.TextSize = 9
        KeyLbl.TextColor3 = C_DIM2
        KeyLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        local KeyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", KeyRow)
        KeyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 18)
        KeyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, - 56, 0.5, - 9)

        KeyBtn.Text = toggleKey.Name
        KeyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        KeyBtn.TextSize = 9
        KeyBtn.TextColor3 = C_PURPLE
        KeyBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
        KeyBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", KeyBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)

        keyStroke.Color = C_PUR_DARK
        keyStroke.Thickness = 1
        keyStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        keyStroke.Transparency = 0.4

            waitingForKey = true
            KeyBtn.Text = "..."
            tween(keyStroke, 0.2, {
                Color = C_WHITE,
                Transparency = 0.1,
                Thickness = 1.5
            })
        end)
        updateVisual = function()
            if desyncActive then
                tween(StatusDot, 0.25, {
                    BackgroundColor3 = C_PURPLE
                })
                tween(StatusLabel, 0.25, {
                    TextColor3 = C_WHITE
                })
                StatusLabel.Text = "Active"
                tween(ActivateBtn, 0.25, {
                    BackgroundColor3 = C_PUR_DARK,
                    TextColor3 = C_WHITE,
                })
                tween(actStroke, 0.25, {
                    Color = C_PURPLE,
                    Transparency = 0.15
                })
                tween(pillStroke, 0.25, {
                    Color = C_PURPLE,
                    Transparency = 0.4
                })
                ActivateBtn.Text = "DEACTIVATE"
                tween(logoGlow, 0.25, {
                    Transparency = 0.3
                })
            else
                tween(StatusDot, 0.25, {
                    BackgroundColor3 = C_DIM2
                })
                tween(StatusLabel, 0.25, {
                    TextColor3 = C_DIM
                })
                StatusLabel.Text = "Inactive"
                tween(ActivateBtn, 0.25, {
                    BackgroundColor3 = C_BG2,
                    TextColor3 = C_WHITE,
                })
                tween(actStroke, 0.25, {
                    Color = C_PUR_DARK,
                    Transparency = 0.4
                })
                tween(pillStroke, 0.25, {
                    Color = C_STROKE,
                    Transparency = 0.55
                })
                ActivateBtn.Text = "ACTIVATE"
                tween(logoGlow, 0.25, {
                    Transparency = 0.55
                })
            end
        end
        ActivateBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            setDesync(not desyncActive)
            if updateVisual then
                updateVisual()
            end
        end)
        UnwalkBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local newState = not unwalkActive
            setUnwalk(newState, nil)
            if newState then
                tween(UnwalkBtn, 0.25, {
                    BackgroundColor3 = C_PUR_DARK,
                    TextColor3 = C_WHITE,
                })

                    Color = C_PURPLE,
                    Transparency = 0.25
                })

                    BackgroundColor3 = C_BG2,
                    TextColor3 = C_DIM,
                })
                tween(uwStroke, 0.25, {
                    Color = C_STROKE,
                    Transparency = 0.55
                })
                UnwalkBtn.Text = "UNWALK    OFF"
            end
        end)
        ActivateBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if not desyncActive then

                    BackgroundColor3 = C_HOVER
                })
            end
        end)
        ActivateBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if not desyncActive then
                tween(ActivateBtn, 0.15, {
                    BackgroundColor3 = C_BG2
                })
            end
        end)
        UnwalkBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if not unwalkActive then
                tween(UnwalkBtn, 0.15, {
                    BackgroundColor3 = C_HOVER
                })
            end
        end)
        UnwalkBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            if not unwalkActive then
                tween(UnwalkBtn, 0.15, {
                    BackgroundColor3 = C_BG2
                })
            end
        end)
        CloseBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            tween(CloseBtn, 0.15, {
                BackgroundColor3 = C_HOVER
            })
        end)
        CloseBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            tween(CloseBtn, 0.15, {
                BackgroundColor3 = C_BG2
            })
        end)
        KeyBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            tween(KeyBtn, 0.15, {
                BackgroundColor3 = C_HOVER
            })
        end)
        KeyBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            tween(KeyBtn, 0.15, {
                BackgroundColor3 = C_BG2
            })
        end)
        Panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_W, 0, PANEL_H)
        Panel.Position = winPos
        Panel.Visible = false
        return ScreenGui, Panel, KeyBtn, keyStroke, UnwalkBtn, PANEL_W, PANEL_H
    end
    local ScreenGui, Panel, KeyBtn, keyStroke, UnwalkBtn, PANEL_W, PANEL_H = buildUI()
    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
        if hubStale() then
            return
        end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and true and not _isGamepadInput(input) then
            return
        end
        if waitingForKey then
            if gpe then
                return
            end
            toggleKey = input.KeyCode
            if KeyBtn then
                KeyBtn.Text = "[ " .. toggleKey.Name .. " ]"
            end
            if keyStroke then
                tween(keyStroke, 0.2, {
                    Color = Color3.fromRGB(0,
                    0,
                    0),
                    Thickness = 1
                })
            end
            waitingForKey = false
            saveSettings()
            return
        end
        if gpe then
            return
        end
        if _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive and _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive() then
            return
        end
        if input.KeyCode == toggleKey then
            setDesync(not desyncActive)
            if updateVisual then
                updateVisual()
            end
        end
    end)
    _G.KrixDesyncToggle = function(on)
        setDesync(on and true or false)
        if updateVisual then
            updateVisual()
        end
    end
    _G.KrixDesyncShowPanel = function()
        Panel.Visible = true
        Panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_W, 0, 0)
        Panel.Position = UDim2.new(winPos.X.Scale, winPos.X.Offset, winPos.Y.Scale, winPos.Y.Offset +(PANEL_H / 2))
        TS:Create(Panel, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = UDim2.new(0,
            PANEL_W,
            0,
            PANEL_H),
            Position = winPos
        }):Play()
    end
    _G.KrixDesyncHidePanel = function()
        TS:Create(Panel, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
            Size = UDim2.new(0,
            PANEL_W,
            0,
            0)
        }):Play()
        task.delay(0.27,
        function()
            Panel.Visible = false
        end)
    end
    _G.KrixDesyncTogglePanel = function()
        if Panel.Visible then
            _G.KrixDesyncHidePanel()
        else
            _G.KrixDesyncShowPanel()
        end
    end
end)()
local function playVioletteLoadIntro(onFinished)

        pcall(_G._VioletteccLoadIntroCleanup)
    end
    if _G._VioletteccPlayIntroSong then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccPlayIntroSong, _G._VioletteccIntroSong or "Song 1", false)
    end
    local introIsMobile = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
    local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local oldIntro = playerGui:FindFirstChild("VioletteLoadIntro")

    end
    local oldBlur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("VioletteLoadIntroBlur")

        introGui.DisplayOrder = 1000005
        introGui.Parent = playerGui
    end
    introGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    local ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local DIM = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local PINK = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

    local particles = {}
    for i = 1, introIsMobile and 28 or 48 do

        p.Parent = particleField
        Instance.new("UICorner", p).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        particles[i] = {
            frame = p,
            x =((i * 41) % 100) / 100,
            y =((i * 67) % 100) / 100,
            speed = 0.012 +(i % 4) * 0.006,
            phase = i * 0.91,
            opacity = 0.25 +(i % 5) * 0.08,
        }
    end
    local topBar = Instance.new("Frame")

    discord.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 20)
    discord.ZIndex = 1005
    discord.Parent = intro
    local tapPrompt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    tapPrompt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    tapPrompt.Text = introIsMobile and "TAP TO CONTINUE" or "CLICK OR PRESS ANY KEY"
    tapPrompt.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    tapPrompt.TextTransparency = 1
    tapPrompt.TextSize = introIsMobile and 10 or 12
    tapPrompt.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    tapPrompt.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
    tapPrompt.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, - 36)
    tapPrompt.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 20)
