        Settings.StealRadius = StealRadii.Normal
        _G.K7NormalSteal.radius = StealRadii.Normal
    end
    local function setSemiRadius(v)
        StealRadii.Semi = tonumber(v) or StealRadii.Semi
        AS.radius = StealRadii.Semi
    end

    _G._RaVeApplyAnimationPack = function(name)
        name = name or "Off"
        _G._AdaptAnimPack = name
        _G._VynxAnimPack = name
        local char = LP.Character
        local animate = char and char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        if not animate then
            return
        end
        local function ref(folder, child)
            local f = animate:FindFirstChild(folder);
            return f and f:FindFirstChild(child)
        end
        local refs = {
            ref("idle",
            "Animation1"),
            ref("idle",
            "Animation2"),
            ref("walk",
            "WalkAnim"),
            ref("run",
            "RunAnim"),
            ref("jump",
            "JumpAnim"),
            ref("fall",
            "FallAnim"),
            ref("climb",
            "ClimbAnim")
        }
        if not _G._RaVeAnimationOriginals[char] then
            local original = {}
            for i, a in ipairs(refs) do
                original[i] = a and a.AnimationId or nil
            end
            _G._RaVeAnimationOriginals[char] = original
        end
        local values = _G._RaVeAnimationOriginals[char]
        local pack = _G._RaVeAnimationPacks[name]
        if pack then
            values = {
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[1][1],
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[1][2],
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[2],
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[3],
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[4],
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[5],
                "rbxassetid://" .. pack[6]
            }
        end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            for _, track in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                pcall(function()
                    track:Stop(0)
                end)
            end
        end
        for i, a in ipairs(refs) do
            if a and values and values[i] then
                a.AnimationId = values[i]
            end
        end
        pcall(function()
            animate.Disabled = true;
            task.wait();
            animate.Disabled = false
        end)
    end
    _G._RaVeApplySelectedAnimation = function(name)
        name = name or "Off"
        if _G._AdaptUnwalk and _G._AdaptUnwalk.enabled and name ~= "Unwalk" then
            _G._AdaptUnwalk.enabled = false
            pcall(_G._AdaptStopUnwalk)
        end
        if _G._AdaptTryHard and _G._AdaptTryHard.enabled and name ~= "Try Hard" then
            _G._AdaptTryHard.enabled = false
            pcall(_G._AdaptStopTryHard)
        end
        if name == "Unwalk" then
            _G._AdaptAnimPack = "Unwalk";
            _G._VynxAnimPack = "Unwalk"
            Enabled.Unwalk = true
            if _G._AdaptUnwalk then
                _G._AdaptUnwalk.enabled = true
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(_G._AdaptStartUnwalk)
            end)
            return
        end
        Enabled.Unwalk = false
        if name == "Try Hard" then
            _G._AdaptAnimPack = "Try Hard";
            _G._VynxAnimPack = "Try Hard"
            if _G._AdaptTryHard then
                _G._AdaptTryHard.enabled = true
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                pcall(_G._AdaptApplyTryHard)

            return
        end
        pcall(_G._RaVeApplyAnimationPack, name)
    end

(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccBatAimbotRuntime and _G._VioletteccBatAimbotRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccBatAimbotRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local Conns = {}
    local MEDUSA_RANGE = 30
    local MEDUSA_ACTIVATE_GAP = 0.15
    local medusaLastActivate = 0
    local function isMedusaTool(tool)
        if not(tool and tool:IsA("Tool")) then
            return false
        end
        local n = tool.Name:lower()
        return n:find("medusa") ~= nil or n:find("head") ~= nil or n:find("stone") ~= nil
    end
    local function heldMedusa()
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then
            return nil
        end
        for _, t in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if isMedusaTool(t) then
                return t
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function tryMedusa(tool, targetRoot)
        if _G._VioletteccAutoMedusa == false or not isMedusaTool(tool) then
            return false
        end
        local char = LP.Character
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tool.Parent == char and root and targetRoot and(targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= MEDUSA_RANGE and os.clock() - medusaLastActivate >= MEDUSA_ACTIVATE_GAP then
            medusaLastActivate = os.clock()
            pcall(function()
                tool:Activate()
            end)
        end
        return true
    end
    local BAT_SLAP_LIST = {
        "Bat",
        "Slap",
        "Iron Slap",
        "Gold Slap",
        "Diamond Slap",
        "Emerald Slap",
        "Ruby Slap",
        "Dark Matter Slap",
        "Flame Slap",
        "Nuclear Slap",
        "Galaxy Slap",
        "Glitched Slap",
    }
    local function findBat()
        local char = LP.Character;
        if not char then
            return nil
        end
        for _, name in ipairs(BAT_SLAP_LIST) do
            local t = char:FindFirstChild(name)
            if t and t:IsA("Tool") then
                return t
            end
        end
        local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if bp then
            for _, name in ipairs(BAT_SLAP_LIST) do
                local t = bp:FindFirstChild(name)
                if t and t:IsA("Tool") then
                    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum then
                        pcall(function()
                            hum:EquipTool(t)
                        end)
                    end
                    return t
                end
            end
        end
        for _, ch in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("Tool") and(ch.Name:lower():find("bat") or ch.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
                return ch
            end
        end
        local bp2 = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if bp2 then
            for _, t in ipairs(bp2:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") and(t.Name:lower():find("bat") or t.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
                    return t
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local BYPASS_CHASE_SPEED = 58.76
    local BYPASS_HIT_DIST = 8
    local BYPASS_SWING_CD = 0.15
    local bypassHitCD = false
    local function bypassSwing()
        if _G._VioletteccAutoMedusa ~= false and heldMedusa() then
            return
        end
        if _G._VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing ~= true then
            return
        end
        if bypassHitCD then
            return
        end
        bypassHitCD = true
        pcall(function()
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then
                return
            end
            local bat = findBat()
            if not bat then
                return
            end
            if bat.Parent ~= char then
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hum then
                    pcall(function()
                        hum:EquipTool(bat)
                    end)
                end
            end
            pcall(function()
                bat:Activate()
            end)
            local handle = bat:FindFirstChild("Handle")
            if not(handle and firetouchinterest) then
                return
            end
            local myHRP = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not myHRP then
                return
            end
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
                    local tHRP = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if tHRP and(tHRP.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude <= BYPASS_HIT_DIST then
                        for _, part in ipairs(plr.Character:GetChildren()) do
                            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                                pcall(function()
                                    firetouchinterest(handle, part, 0)
                                    firetouchinterest(handle, part, 1)
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        task.delay(BYPASS_SWING_CD,
        function()
            bypassHitCD = false
        end)
    end
    local function closestPlayerRoot()
        local root = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then
            return nil
        end
        local best, bd = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                local tr = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hm = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if tr and hm and hm.Health > 0 then
                    local d =(tr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < bd then
                        bd = d;
                        best = tr
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    local function closestPlayerRootAndDist()
        local root = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then
            return nil, math.huge
        end
        local best, bd = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                local tr = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hm = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if tr and hm and hm.Health > 0 then
                    local d =(tr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < bd then
                        bd = d;
                        best = tr
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best, bd
    end
    local AIMBOT_ATTACHMENT_NAME = "AceAimbotMoveAttachment"
    local AIMBOT_MOVER_NAME = "AceAimbotMoveVelocity"
    local BYPASS_ATTACHMENT_NAME = "VioletteBypassV3Attachment"
    local BYPASS_MOVER_NAME = "VioletteBypassV3Velocity"
    local function clearAimbotMoverOn(root)
        local mover = root and root:FindFirstChild(AIMBOT_MOVER_NAME)
        if mover and mover:IsA("LinearVelocity") then
            mover:Destroy()
        end
        local attachment = root and root:FindFirstChild(AIMBOT_ATTACHMENT_NAME)
        if attachment and attachment:IsA("Attachment") then
            attachment:Destroy()
        end
        local bypassMover = root and root:FindFirstChild(BYPASS_MOVER_NAME)
        if bypassMover and bypassMover:IsA("LinearVelocity") then
            bypassMover:Destroy()
        end
        local bypassAttachment = root and root:FindFirstChild(BYPASS_ATTACHMENT_NAME)
        if bypassAttachment and bypassAttachment:IsA("Attachment") then
            bypassAttachment:Destroy()
        end
    end
    _G._AceClearAimbotMover = function()
        local char = LP.Character
        clearAimbotMoverOn(char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
    end
    local function aimbotSpeed()
        if Spd.family == "lagger" then
            return tonumber(_G._VezyBatAimbotSpeedLagger) or 56.5
        end
        return tonumber(_G._VezyBatAimbotSpeed) or 56.5
    end
    local function aimbotGateBlocked()
        if _G._VynxSafeMode ~= true then
            return false
        end
        if _G._RaVeSafeMode and _G._RaVeSafeMode.IsLocked then
            local ok, locked = pcall(_G._RaVeSafeMode.IsLocked)
            if ok then
                return locked == true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function aimbotOn()
        return autoBatToggled == true or _G._VezyBatAimbotOn == true
    end
    local function swingOn()
        return autoSwingEnabled == true or _G._VezyAutoSwingEnabled == true
    end
    local function usesBypassLoop()
        return _G._VezyBatAimbotMode == "old"
    end
    local function usesV3Loop()
        return _G._VezyBatAimbotMode == "v1"
    end
    local function usesV2Loop()
        return _G._VezyBatAimbotMode == "v2"
    end
    local function usesV4Loop()
        return _G._VezyBatAimbotMode == "v4"
    end
    local BAV2_ANG = "_GB_AngV"
    local BAV2_ATT = "_GB_Att"
    local BAV2_CLEAN = {
        "LockBAV",
        "LockAngVel",
        "LockBodyAtt",
        "BatLock",
        "LockBAVAtt",
        "AutoBatAtt",
        "AutoBatAV",
        "AntiBatDet",
        "AntiAim",
        "VelocityLock"
    }
    local V2 = {
        enabled = false,
        conn = nil,
        safetyConn = nil,
        target = nil,
        equipped = false,
        intendedVelocity = Vector3.zero,
        attachment = nil,
        angularVelocity = nil,
        speed = 56.5,
        swingRange = 12,
    }
    local PRED = {
        part = nil,
        trail = nil
    }
    local function cleanMovers(root)
        if not root then
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            for _, n in ipairs(BAV2_CLEAN) do
                local c = root:FindFirstChild(n);
                if c then
                    c:Destroy()
                end
            end
            for _, child in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
                if child.Name ~= BAV2_ANG and child.Name ~= BAV2_ATT then
                    local ln = child.Name:lower()
                    if ln:find("lockb") or ln:find("lockangv") or ln:find("batlock") or ln:find("antiaim") or ln:find("velocitylock") then
                        child:Destroy()
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function ensureAngular(root)
        if not root then
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            local a = root:FindFirstChild(BAV2_ANG);
            if a then
                a:Destroy()
            end
            local b = root:FindFirstChild(BAV2_ATT);
            if b then
                b:Destroy()
            end
        end)
        local att = Instance.new("Attachment");
        att.Name = BAV2_ATT;
        att.Parent = root
        local angV = Instance.new("AngularVelocity")
        angV.Name = BAV2_ANG
        angV.Attachment0 = att
        angV.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
        angV.MaxTorque = math.huge
        angV.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        angV.Parent = root
        V2.attachment = att;
        V2.angularVelocity = angV
    end
    local function removeAngular()
        pcall(function()
            if V2.angularVelocity and V2.angularVelocity.Parent then
                V2.angularVelocity:Destroy()
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if V2.attachment and V2.attachment.Parent then
                V2.attachment:Destroy()
            end
        end)
        V2.angularVelocity = nil;
        V2.attachment = nil
    end
    local function pickTarget(root)
        local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                    local d =(hrp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < bestD then
                        bestD = d;
                        best = hrp
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best, bestD
    end
    local function getBat(char)
        local eq = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
        if eq then
            local n = eq.Name:lower()
            if n:find("bat") or n:find("slap") then
                return eq
            end
        end
        local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
        if bp then
            for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") then
                    local n = t.Name:lower()
                    if n:find("bat") or n:find("slap") then
                        return t
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function ensurePredictionBall()
        if PRED.part and PRED.part.Parent then
            return
        end
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name = "MNL_PredBall"
        p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
        p.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 2.2, 2.2)
        p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
        p.Color = Color3.fromRGB(20, 40, 90)
        p.Transparency = 0.55
        p.CanCollide = false
        p.CanQuery = false
        p.CanTouch = false
        p.Anchored = true
        p.CastShadow = false
        p.Parent = workspace
        local light = Instance.new("PointLight", p)
        light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 169, 255);
        light.Range = 6;
        light.Brightness = 1.5
        local trail = Instance.new("Trail", p)
        trail.Attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment", p)
        trail.Attachment1 = Instance.new("Attachment", p)
        trail.Attachment0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0)
        trail.Attachment1.Position = Vector3.new(0, - 0.9, 0)
        trail.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(90, 169, 255), Color3.fromRGB(10, 15, 30))
        trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,
            0.2),
            NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,
            1),
        })
        trail.Lifetime = 0.35
        trail.MinLength = 0.1
        trail.Enabled = false
        PRED.part = p;
        PRED.trail = trail
    end
    local function hidePredictionBall()
        if PRED.part then
            PRED.part.Parent = nil
        end
        PRED.part = nil;
        PRED.trail = nil
    end
    local function updatePredictionBall(targetHrp)
        ensurePredictionBall()
        if not targetHrp then
            if PRED.part then
                PRED.part.Transparency = 0.85
            end
            if PRED.trail then
                PRED.trail.Enabled = false
            end
            return
        end
        local predicted = targetHrp.Position + targetHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity * 0.35
        PRED.part.Position = predicted
        PRED.part.Transparency = 0.55
        if PRED.trail then
            PRED.trail.Enabled = true
            PRED.trail.Attachment0.WorldPosition = PRED.part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0)
            PRED.trail.Attachment1.WorldPosition = PRED.part.Position + Vector3.new(0, - 0.9, 0)
        end
    end
    local function stopBatV2()
        V2.enabled = false;
        V2.equipped = false;
        V2.target = nil
        if V2.conn then
            V2.conn:Disconnect();
            V2.conn = nil
        end
        if V2.safetyConn then
            V2.safetyConn:Disconnect();
            V2.safetyConn = nil
        end
        local c = LP.Character
        local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            pcall(function()
                root.Velocity = root.Velocity * 0.3
            end)
        end
        local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.AutoRotate = true
        end
        if V2.angularVelocity then
            pcall(function()
                V2.angularVelocity.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
        end
        removeAngular();
        hidePredictionBall()
    end
    local function startBatV2()
        stopBatV2()
        V2.enabled = true;
        V2.equipped = false;
        V2.target = nil
        V2.intendedVelocity = Vector3.zero;
        V2.speed = 56.5
        local c = LP.Character
        local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
            cleanMovers(root);
            ensureAngular(root)
        end
        ensurePredictionBall()
        V2.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not V2.enabled or not aimbotOn() or not usesV2Loop() then
                return
            end
            if aimbotGateBlocked() then
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                return
            end
            cleanMovers(hrp)
            if not V2.angularVelocity or not V2.angularVelocity.Parent then
                ensureAngular(hrp)
            end
            if not V2.equipped then
                V2.equipped = true
                if not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
                    local b = getBat(char)
                    if b then
                        pcall(function()
                            hum:EquipTool(b)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            local target, dist = pickTarget(hrp)
            if not target then
                V2.target = nil;
                hum.AutoRotate = true
                if V2.angularVelocity then
                    V2.angularVelocity.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
                updatePredictionBall(nil);
                return
            end
            V2.target = target
            updatePredictionBall(target)
            local aimPos = target.Position + target.CFrame.LookVector *(target.Velocity.Magnitude < 0.1 and 1.5 or 5)
            local delta = aimPos - hrp.Position
            local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            if delta.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat.Magnitude > 0.01 then
                local curY = hrp.Orientation.Y
                local yawD =(math.deg(math.atan2(- flat.X, - flat.Z)) - curY + 180) % 360 - 180
                local curX = hrp.Orientation.X
                local pitchD =(math.deg(math.atan2(delta.Y, flat.Magnitude)) - curX + 180) % 360 - 180
                local rotY = math.clamp(math.rad(yawD) * 40, - 28, 28)
                local rotX = math.clamp(math.rad(pitchD) * 40, - 28, 28)
                local yawR = math.rad(hrp.Orientation.Y)
                local fwd = Vector3.new(math.cos(yawR), 0, - math.sin(yawR))
                V2.angularVelocity.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, rotY, 0) + fwd * rotX
            else
                V2.angularVelocity.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
            local spd = V2.speed
            V2.intendedVelocity =(flat.Magnitude > 0.1 and flat.Unit * spd or Vector3.zero) +(math.abs(delta.Y) > 0.8 and Vector3.new(0, math.sign(delta.Y) * spd, 0) or Vector3.new(0, - 2, 0))
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = V2.intendedVelocity
            hrp.Velocity = V2.intendedVelocity
            if flat.Magnitude > 0.3 then
                pcall(function()
                    hum:Move(flat.Unit, false)
                end)
            else
                pcall(function()
                    hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
                end)
            end
            if dist <= V2.swingRange then
                local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                if bat and(bat.Name:lower():find("bat") or bat.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
                    pcall(function()
                        bat:Activate()
                        local re = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                        if re then
                            re:FireServer()
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)
        V2.safetyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not V2.enabled or not aimbotOn() or not usesV2Loop() then
                return
            end
            if aimbotGateBlocked() then
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not hum then
                return
            end
            if V2.target and V2.target.Parent then
                local delta = V2.target.Position - hrp.Position
                local flat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
                if flat.Magnitude > 0.3 then
                    pcall(function()
                        hum:Move(flat.Unit, false)
                    end)
                end
                if math.abs(hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X - V2.intendedVelocity.X) > 30 or math.abs(hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z - V2.intendedVelocity.Z) > 30 then
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = V2.intendedVelocity
                end
            end
            local v = hrp.Velocity
            if math.abs(v.X) > 350 or math.abs(v.Z) > 350 then
                hrp.Velocity = V2.intendedVelocity
            end
            cleanMovers(hrp)
        end)
    end
    _G._VioletteccGetAimbotSpeed = function()
        if not aimbotOn() or aimbotGateBlocked() then
            return nil
        end
        local spd
        if usesBypassLoop() then
            spd = tonumber(_G._VezyBypassChaseSpeed) or aimbotSpeed()
        else
            spd = aimbotSpeed()
        end
        spd = tonumber(spd)
        if spd and spd > 0 then
            return spd
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function stepVioletteccNormalV2(root, hum, target, distance)
        local targetVelocity = target.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local targetPosition = target.Position
        local aimPosition = targetPosition + targetVelocity * .14 + target.CFrame.LookVector * .3
        local direction = aimPosition - root.Position
        local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
        flat = flat.Magnitude < .05 and root.CFrame.LookVector or flat.Unit
        local vertical =(targetPosition.Y + 3.7 - root.Position.Y) * 19.5 + targetVelocity.Y * .8
        if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
            vertical = math.max(vertical, 13)
        end
        vertical = math.clamp(vertical, - 70, 110)
        local speed = 58
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Lerp(Vector3.new(flat.X * speed, vertical, flat.Z * speed), .8)
        local facing = targetPosition + targetVelocity * math.clamp(targetVelocity.Magnitude / 150, .05, .2)
        if (facing - root.Position).Magnitude > .1 then
            local rx, ry, rz =(root.CFrame:Inverse() * CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, facing)):ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = root.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.clamp(rx, - 2.5, 2.5) * 42, math.clamp(ry, - 2.5, 2.5) * 42, math.clamp(rz, - 2.5, 2.5) * 42))
        end
    end
    local VIS = {
        track = setmetatable({},
        {
            __mode = "k"
        }),
        intended = Vector3.zero,
        nextSwingAt = 0,
        lastClean = 0
    }
    local VIS_SAMPLES = 6
    local function visBypassReset()
        VIS.intended = Vector3.zero
        VIS.nextSwingAt = 0
        VIS.track = setmetatable({}, {
            __mode = "k"
        })
    end
    local function visTrueVelocity(rootPart, now)
        if not rootPart or not rootPart.Parent then
            return Vector3.zero
        end
        local rec = VIS.track[rootPart]
        if not rec then
            rec = {
                s = {},
                vel = Vector3.zero,
                ready = false
            }
            VIS.track[rootPart] = rec
        end
        local pos = rootPart.Position
        local last = rec.s[# rec.s]
        if last then
            local ddt = now - last.t
            if ddt > 1 / 240 and ddt < 0.2 then
                local raw =(pos - last.pos) / ddt
                local clamped = Vector3.new(math.clamp(raw.X, - 150, 150), math.clamp(raw.Y, - 150, 150), math.clamp(raw.Z, - 150, 150))
                if rec.ready then
                    rec.vel = rec.vel:Lerp(clamped, 0.5)
                else
                    rec.vel = clamped
                    rec.ready = true
                end
            end
        end
        table.insert(rec.s, {
            pos = pos,
            t = now
        })
        while # rec.s > VIS_SAMPLES do
            table.remove(rec.s, 1)
        end
        return rec.vel
    end
    local function visReadVelocity(tgt, now)
        local raw = tgt.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local tracked = visTrueVelocity(tgt, now)
        if not tracked or tracked.Magnitude < 0.5 then
            if raw.Magnitude > 400 then
                return Vector3.zero
            end
            return raw
        end
        local diff =(raw - tracked).Magnitude
        local rawMag, trackMag = raw.Magnitude, tracked.Magnitude
        if rawMag > 250 then
            return tracked
        end
        if diff > math.max(80, trackMag * 1.5) then
            return tracked
        end
        return raw
    end
    local function stepVisibleBypass(root, hum, target)
        local me = root.Position
        local them = target.Position
        local spd = tonumber(_G._VezyBypassChaseSpeed) or aimbotSpeed()
        local now = os.clock()
        if now - VIS.lastClean >= 5 then
            VIS.lastClean = now
            for r in pairs(VIS.track) do
                if not r.Parent then
                    VIS.track[r] = nil
                end
            end
        end
        local targetVel = visReadVelocity(target, now)
        local predictPos = them + targetVel * 0.14 + target.CFrame.LookVector * 0.3
        local direction = predictPos - me
        local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
        local flatDir = flat.Magnitude > 0.01 and flat.Unit or Vector3.zero
        local yVel =(them.Y + 3.7 - me.Y) * 19.5 + targetVel.Y * 0.8
        if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
            yVel = math.max(yVel, 13)
        end
        yVel = math.clamp(yVel, - 70, 110)
        local desiredVel = Vector3.new(flatDir.X * spd, yVel, flatDir.Z * spd)
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Lerp(desiredVel, 0.8)
        VIS.intended = desiredVel
        local predictTime = math.clamp(targetVel.Magnitude / 150, 0.05, 0.2)
        local predictedPos = them + targetVel * predictTime
        if (predictedPos - me).Magnitude > 0.1 then
            local rx, ry, rz =(root.CFrame:Inverse() * CFrame.lookAt(me, predictedPos)):ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = root.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(math.clamp(rx, - 2.5, 2.5) * 42, math.clamp(ry, - 2.5, 2.5) * 42, math.clamp(rz, - 2.5, 2.5) * 42))
        end
        local v = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        if math.abs(v.X) > 350 or math.abs(v.Z) > 350 then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = VIS.intended
        end
        return(root.Position - them).Magnitude <= 8
    end
    local EXO = {
        cfg = {
            ACTIVATE_DISTANCE = 13,
            MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE = 1,
            PREDICTION_TIME = 0.22,
            PREDICT_AHEAD = 3,
            MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE = 150,
            VELOCITY_SMOOTHING = 0.2,
            MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY = 80,
            SERVER_TICKRATE = 1 / 60,
            ACCELERATION_PREDICTION_WEIGHT = 0.3,
            DIRECTION_CHANGE_DETECTION_TIME = 0.12,
            QUICK_DIRECTION_CHANGE_MULTIPLIER = 1.5,
            GRAVITY = 196.2,
            AIR_CONTROL_FACTOR = 0.8,
            MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME = 0.08,
            MIN_PING_COMPENSATION = 0.04,
            MAX_PING_COMPENSATION = 0.35,
        },
        st = {},
        currentPing = 0.1,
    }
    local function exoAvg(list)
        if # list == 0 then
            return Vector3.zero
        end
        local sum = Vector3.zero
        for _, v in ipairs(list) do
            sum = sum + v
        end
        return sum / # list
    end
    local function exoPush(list, value, maxSize)
        table.insert(list, value)
        if # list > maxSize then
            table.remove(list, 1)
        end
    end
    local function exoReset()
        EXO.st = {
            target = nil,
            lastTargetPos = nil,
            targetVelocity = Vector3.zero,
            smoothedVelocity = Vector3.zero,
            accelerationHistory = {},
            aerialVelocityHistory = {},
            previousDirection = nil,
            lastDirectionChangeTime = 0,
            airborneTime = 0,
            lastSwing = EXO.st and EXO.st.lastSwing or 0,
        }
    end
    exoReset()
    local function exoRefreshPing()
        local ms = 100
        pcall(function()
            local stats = game:GetService("Stats")
            local net = stats and stats.Network
            local item = net and net.ServerStatsItem
            local pingItem = item and item["Data Ping"]
            if pingItem and pingItem.GetValue then
                ms = pingItem:GetValue()
            end
        end)
        if type(ms) ~= "number" then
            ms = 100
        end
        EXO.currentPing = math.clamp(ms / 1000, EXO.cfg.MIN_PING_COMPENSATION, EXO.cfg.MAX_PING_COMPENSATION)
    end
    local function exoFace(root, direction)
        if direction.Magnitude < 0.01 then
            return
        end
        local cross = root.CFrame.LookVector:Cross(direction.Unit)
        local angle = math.asin(math.clamp(cross.Magnitude, - 1, 1))
        root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = cross.Magnitude > 0.01 and cross.Unit * angle * 80 or Vector3.zero
    end
    local function stepExoticV3(root, target, targetHum, dt)
        local C, S = EXO.cfg, EXO.st
        if S.target ~= target then
            exoReset();
            S = EXO.st;
            S.target = target
        end
        local now = os.clock()
        local targetPos = target.Position
        local dtc = math.max(dt or 1 / 60, 1 / 240)
        if S.lastTargetPos then
            local instantVel =(targetPos - S.lastTargetPos) / dtc
            local accel = instantVel - S.targetVelocity
            if accel.Magnitude > C.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE then
                instantVel = S.targetVelocity + accel.Unit * C.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE
            end
            local hv = Vector3.new(instantVel.X, 0, instantVel.Z)
            if hv.Magnitude > C.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY then
                hv = hv.Unit * C.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY
                instantVel = Vector3.new(hv.X, instantVel.Y, hv.Z)
            end
            exoPush(S.accelerationHistory, instantVel - S.targetVelocity, 8)
            S.targetVelocity = instantVel
            S.smoothedVelocity = S.smoothedVelocity:Lerp(instantVel, C.VELOCITY_SMOOTHING)
        end
        S.lastTargetPos = targetPos
        local isAirborne = targetHum and targetHum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
        S.airborneTime = isAirborne and(S.airborneTime + dtc) or 0
        if isAirborne and S.airborneTime >= C.MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME then
            exoPush(S.aerialVelocityHistory, S.targetVelocity, 6)
        elseif not isAirborne then
            S.aerialVelocityHistory = {}
        end
        local smoothedVel = S.smoothedVelocity
        if isAirborne and # S.aerialVelocityHistory > 0 then
            local avgAerial = exoAvg(S.aerialVelocityHistory)
            smoothedVel = Vector3.new(avgAerial.X, S.targetVelocity.Y, avgAerial.Z) * C.AIR_CONTROL_FACTOR
        end
        local isQuickTurn = false
        local htv = Vector3.new(S.targetVelocity.X, 0, S.targetVelocity.Z)
        if htv.Magnitude > 5 then
            local newDir = htv.Unit
            if S.previousDirection and S.previousDirection:Dot(newDir) < 0.5 then
                isQuickTurn =(now - S.lastDirectionChangeTime) < C.DIRECTION_CHANGE_DETECTION_TIME
                S.lastDirectionChangeTime = now
            end
            S.previousDirection = newDir
        end
        exoRefreshPing()
        local serverDelay = EXO.currentPing + C.SERVER_TICKRATE
        local adjustedDelay = isQuickTurn and(serverDelay * C.QUICK_DIRECTION_CHANGE_MULTIPLIER) or serverDelay
        local avgAccel = exoAvg(S.accelerationHistory)
        local accelContribution = avgAccel * C.ACCELERATION_PREDICTION_WEIGHT *(adjustedDelay * adjustedDelay * 0.5)
        local predictedPos = targetPos + smoothedVel * adjustedDelay + accelContribution
        local predictionTime = C.PREDICTION_TIME * 1.1
        if isAirborne then
            predictedPos = predictedPos + smoothedVel * predictionTime + Vector3.new(0, - 0.5 * C.GRAVITY * predictionTime * predictionTime, 0)
        else
            predictedPos = predictedPos + smoothedVel * predictionTime
        end
        local hs = Vector3.new(smoothedVel.X, 0, smoothedVel.Z)
        if hs.Magnitude > 1 then
            predictedPos = predictedPos + hs.Unit * C.PREDICT_AHEAD
        end
        local direction = predictedPos - root.Position
        exoFace(root, direction)
        if direction.Magnitude > C.MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = direction.Unit * aimbotSpeed()
        else
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y * 0.5, 0)
        end
    end
    V2.V11 = {
        target = nil,
        lastTargetPos = nil,
        targetVelocity = Vector3.zero,
        smoothedVelocity = Vector3.zero,
        velocityHistory = {},
        accelerationHistory = {},
        aerialVelocityHistory = {},
        verticalVelocityHistory = {},
        previousDirection = nil,
        lastDirectionChangeTime = 0,
        airborneTime = 0,
        lastActivationTime = 0,
        currentPing = 0.1,
        realPingMs = 100,
        lastPingRefresh = 0,
        underSince = nil,
        lastRelock = 0,
    }
    V2.V11.cfg = {
        ACTIVATE_DISTANCE = 13,
        MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE = 1,
        PREDICTION_TIME = 0.22,
        PREDICT_AHEAD = 3,
        MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE = 150,
        VELOCITY_SMOOTHING = 0.2,
        MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY = 80,
        SERVER_TICKRATE = 1 / 60,
        MIN_PING_COMPENSATION = 0.03,
        MAX_PING_COMPENSATION = 0.25,
        ACCELERATION_PREDICTION_WEIGHT = 0.3,
        DIRECTION_CHANGE_DETECTION_TIME = 0.12,
        QUICK_DIRECTION_CHANGE_MULTIPLIER = 1.5,
        GRAVITY = 196.2,
        AIR_CONTROL_FACTOR = 0.8,
        MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME = 0.08,
    }
    function V2.V11.average(list)
        if # list == 0 then
            return Vector3.zero
        end
        local total = Vector3.zero
        for _, value in ipairs(list) do
            total += value
        end
        return total / # list
    end
    function V2.V11.push(list, value, maxSize)
        table.insert(list, value)
        if # list > maxSize then
            table.remove(list, 1)
        end
    end
    function V2.V11.reset()
        V2.V11.target = nil
        V2.V11.lastTargetPos = nil
        V2.V11.targetVelocity = Vector3.zero
        V2.V11.smoothedVelocity = Vector3.zero
        V2.V11.velocityHistory = {}
        V2.V11.accelerationHistory = {}
        V2.V11.aerialVelocityHistory = {}
        V2.V11.verticalVelocityHistory = {}
        V2.V11.previousDirection = nil
        V2.V11.lastDirectionChangeTime = 0
        V2.V11.airborneTime = 0
        V2.V11.underSince = nil
        V2.V11.lastActivationTime = 0
        V2.V11.lastRelock = 0
        V2.V11.lastPingRefresh = 0
    end
    function V2.V11.refreshPing()
        local now = tick()
        if now - V2.V11.lastPingRefresh < 0.5 then
            return
        end
        V2.V11.lastPingRefresh = now
        local ok, value = pcall(function()
            return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
        end)
        if ok and type(value) == "number" then
            V2.V11.realPingMs = math.floor(value)
        end
        V2.V11.currentPing = math.clamp(V2.V11.realPingMs / 1000, V2.V11.cfg.MIN_PING_COMPENSATION, V2.V11.cfg.MAX_PING_COMPENSATION)
    end
    function V2.V11.step(root, target, targetHum, dt)
        local C = V2.V11.cfg
        if V2.V11.target ~= target then
            V2.V11.reset()
            V2.V11.target = target
        end
        local now = tick()
        local targetPos = target.Position
        local frameDt = math.max(dt or(1 / 60), 1 / 240)
        if V2.V11.lastTargetPos then
            local rawVelocity =(targetPos - V2.V11.lastTargetPos) / frameDt
            local velocityDelta = rawVelocity - V2.V11.targetVelocity
            if velocityDelta.Magnitude > C.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE then
                rawVelocity = V2.V11.targetVelocity + velocityDelta.Unit * C.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE
            end
            local horizontal = Vector3.new(rawVelocity.X, 0, rawVelocity.Z)
            if horizontal.Magnitude > C.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY then
                horizontal = horizontal.Unit * C.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY
                rawVelocity = Vector3.new(horizontal.X, rawVelocity.Y, horizontal.Z)
            end
            V2.V11.push(V2.V11.accelerationHistory,(rawVelocity - V2.V11.targetVelocity) / frameDt, 4)
            V2.V11.push(V2.V11.velocityHistory, rawVelocity, 8)
            V2.V11.targetVelocity = rawVelocity
            V2.V11.smoothedVelocity = V2.V11.smoothedVelocity:Lerp(rawVelocity, C.VELOCITY_SMOOTHING)
        end
        V2.V11.lastTargetPos = targetPos
        local airborne = targetHum and targetHum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
        V2.V11.airborneTime = airborne and(V2.V11.airborneTime + frameDt) or 0
        if airborne and V2.V11.airborneTime >= C.MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME then
            V2.V11.push(V2.V11.aerialVelocityHistory, V2.V11.targetVelocity, 6)
        elseif not airborne then
            V2.V11.aerialVelocityHistory = {}
        end
        local predictionVelocity = V2.V11.smoothedVelocity
        if airborne and # V2.V11.aerialVelocityHistory > 0 then
            local averageAir = V2.V11.average(V2.V11.aerialVelocityHistory)
            predictionVelocity = Vector3.new(averageAir.X, V2.V11.targetVelocity.Y, averageAir.Z) * C.AIR_CONTROL_FACTOR
        end
        local quickTurn = false
        local horizontalVelocity = Vector3.new(V2.V11.targetVelocity.X, 0, V2.V11.targetVelocity.Z)
        if horizontalVelocity.Magnitude > 5 then
            local direction = horizontalVelocity.Unit
            if V2.V11.previousDirection and V2.V11.previousDirection:Dot(direction) < 0.5 then
                quickTurn =(now - V2.V11.lastDirectionChangeTime) < C.DIRECTION_CHANGE_DETECTION_TIME
                V2.V11.lastDirectionChangeTime = now
            end
            V2.V11.previousDirection = direction
        end
        local serverDelay = V2.V11.currentPing + C.SERVER_TICKRATE
        if quickTurn then
            serverDelay = serverDelay * C.QUICK_DIRECTION_CHANGE_MULTIPLIER
        end
        local averageAcceleration = V2.V11.average(V2.V11.accelerationHistory)
        local predicted = targetPos + predictionVelocity * serverDelay + averageAcceleration * C.ACCELERATION_PREDICTION_WEIGHT *(serverDelay * serverDelay * 0.5)
        local predictionTime = C.PREDICTION_TIME * 1.1
        if airborne then
            predicted = predicted + predictionVelocity * predictionTime + Vector3.new(0, - 0.5 * C.GRAVITY * predictionTime * predictionTime, 0)
        else
            predicted = predicted + predictionVelocity * predictionTime
        end
        local flatPrediction = Vector3.new(predictionVelocity.X, 0, predictionVelocity.Z)
        if flatPrediction.Magnitude > 1 then
            predicted = predicted + flatPrediction.Unit * C.PREDICT_AHEAD
        end
        local toTarget = predicted - root.Position
        exoFace(root, toTarget)
        if toTarget.Magnitude > C.MIN_FOLLOW_DISTANCE then
            local followSpeed = math.clamp(aimbotSpeed(), 1, 500)
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = toTarget.Unit * followSpeed
        else
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y * 0.5, 0)
        end
    end
    local function startBatAimbot()
        _G._AdaptTPMirrorEnabled =(_G._VynxMirrorTPDown == true) or(desyncEnabled == true)
        if Conns.aimbot then
            Conns.aimbot:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbot = nil
        end
        if Conns.aimbotNew then
            Conns.aimbotNew:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbotNew = nil
        end
        if Conns.aimbotV3 then
            Conns.aimbotV3:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbotV3 = nil
        end
        if Conns.aimbotV11 then
            Conns.aimbotV11:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbotV11 = nil
        end
        stopBatV2()
        exoReset()
        if usesV2Loop() then
            startBatV2()
        end
        _G._AdaptNormalAimbot = _G._AdaptNormalAimbot or {
            target = nil,
            swingCooldown = false
        }
        local aimbotState = _G._AdaptNormalAimbot
        aimbotState.target = nil
        aimbotState.swingCooldown = false
        aimbotState.equipped = false
        local hum0 = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum0 then
            hum0.AutoRotate = false
        end
        local root0 = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root0 then
            clearAimbotMoverOn(root0)
        end
        Conns.aimbot = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not aimbotOn() or usesBypassLoop() or usesV3Loop() or usesV2Loop() or usesV4Loop() or _G._VezyBatAimbotMode == "v3" then
                return
            end
            if aimbotGateBlocked() then
                pcall(_G._AceClearAimbotMover);
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root or not hum then
                return
            end
            if not aimbotState.equipped then
                aimbotState.equipped = true
                if not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
                    local b = findBat()
                    if b then
                        pcall(function()
                            hum:EquipTool(b)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
            local target = closestPlayerRoot()
            aimbotState.target = target
            if not target then
                local idleBat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or findBat()
                if _G._VioletteccAutoMedusa ~= false and isMedusaTool(idleBat) then
                    return
                end
                if _G._VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing == true and idleBat and idleBat.Parent == char then
                    pcall(function()
                        idleBat:Activate()
                    end)
                end
                return
            end
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            stepVioletteccNormalV2(root, hum, target)
            local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or findBat()
            if tryMedusa(bat, target) then
            elseif _G._VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing == true and bat and bat.Parent == char then
                pcall(function()
                    bat:Activate()
                end)
            end
        end))
        Conns.aimbotNew = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not aimbotOn() or not usesBypassLoop() or usesV3Loop() or usesV4Loop() or _G._VezyBatAimbotMode == "v3" then
                return
            end
            if aimbotGateBlocked() then
                pcall(_G._AceClearAimbotMover);
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then
                return
            end
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not root then
                return
            end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then
                return
            end
            local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or findBat()
            if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then
                pcall(function()
                    hum:EquipTool(bat)
                end)
            elseif not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then
                bat = findBat()
                if bat then
                    pcall(function()
                        hum:EquipTool(bat)
                    end)
                end
            end
            local target, targetDist = closestPlayerRootAndDist()
            aimbotState.target = target
            if not target then
                hum.AutoRotate = true
                clearAimbotMoverOn(root)
                visBypassReset()
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                return
            end
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            local inRange = stepVisibleBypass(root, hum, target)
            if tryMedusa(bat, target) then
            elseif inRange and _G._VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing == true and bat and bat.Parent == char then
                local tnow = os.clock()
                if tnow >= VIS.nextSwingAt then
                    VIS.nextSwingAt = tnow + 0.08
                    pcall(function()
                        bat:Activate()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end))
        Conns.aimbotV3 = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not aimbotOn() or(not usesV3Loop() and not usesV4Loop()) then
                return
            end
            if aimbotGateBlocked() then
                pcall(_G._AceClearAimbotMover);
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                return
            end
            local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if not bat then
                bat = findBat()
                if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then
                    pcall(function()
                        hum:EquipTool(bat)
                    end)
                end
            end
            local target, targetDist = closestPlayerRootAndDist()
            aimbotState.target = target
            local targetHum = target and target.Parent and target.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not target or not targetHum then
                hum.AutoRotate = true
                exoReset()
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                return
            end
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            stepExoticV3(root, target, targetHum, dt)
            if tryMedusa(bat, target) then
            elseif _G._VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing == true and bat and bat.Parent == char and targetDist <= EXO.cfg.ACTIVATE_DISTANCE and os.clock() - EXO.st.lastSwing >= 0.3 then
                EXO.st.lastSwing = os.clock()
                pcall(function()
                    bat:Activate()
                    local re = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                    if re then
                        re:FireServer()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end))
        Conns.aimbotV11 = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not aimbotOn() or _G._VezyBatAimbotMode ~= "v3" then
                return
            end
            if aimbotGateBlocked() then
                pcall(_G._AceClearAimbotMover)
                return
            end
            local char = LP.Character
            local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                return
            end
            local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or findBat()
            if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then
                pcall(function()
                    hum:EquipTool(bat)
                end)
            end
            local target, targetDist = closestPlayerRootAndDist()
            local targetHum = target and target.Parent and target.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            aimbotState.target = target
            if not target or not targetHum or targetHum.Health <= 0 then
                hum.AutoRotate = true
                V2.V11.reset()
                root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                return
            end
            hum.AutoRotate = false
            V2.V11.refreshPing()
            V2.V11.step(root, target, targetHum, dt)
            if tryMedusa(bat, target) then
            elseif _G._VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing == true and bat and bat.Parent == char and targetDist <= V2.V11.cfg.ACTIVATE_DISTANCE and tick() - V2.V11.lastActivationTime >= 0.3 then
                V2.V11.lastActivationTime = tick()
                pcall(function()
                    bat:Activate()
                    local remote = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                    if remote then
                        remote:FireServer()
                    end
                end)
            end
        end))
    end
    local function stopBatAimbot()
        _G._AdaptTPMirrorEnabled =(desyncEnabled == true)
        if Conns.aimbot then
            Conns.aimbot:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbot = nil
        end
        if Conns.aimbotNew then
            Conns.aimbotNew:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbotNew = nil
        end
        if Conns.aimbotV3 then
            Conns.aimbotV3:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbotV3 = nil
        end
        if Conns.aimbotV11 then
            Conns.aimbotV11:Disconnect();
            Conns.aimbotV11 = nil
        end
        stopBatV2()
        visBypassReset()
        exoReset()
        V2.V11.reset()
        if _G._AdaptNormalAimbot then
            _G._AdaptNormalAimbot.target = nil
            _G._AdaptNormalAimbot.swingCooldown = false
            _G._AdaptNormalAimbot.equipped = false
        end
        local c = LP.Character;
        if not c then
            return
        end
        local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local h2 = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if h2 then
            h2.AutoRotate = true
            h2.PlatformStand = false
            pcall(function()
                h2:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                h2:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
            end)
        end
        if r then
            clearAimbotMoverOn(r)
            r.Anchored = false
            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            if sethiddenproperty then
                pcall(sethiddenproperty, r, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil)
            end
            local cf = r.CFrame
            local look = cf.LookVector
            local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
            if flatLook.Magnitude < 0.01 then
                flatLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, - 1)
            else
                flatLook = flatLook.Unit
            end
            r.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cf.Position, cf.Position + flatLook)
            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            for i = 1, 12 do
                task.wait(0.05)
                local c2 = LP.Character;
                if not c2 then
                    return
                end
                local r2 = c2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local h3 = c2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if h3 then
                    h3.AutoRotate = true
                    h3.PlatformStand = false
                end
                if r2 then
                    r2.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    local hitCool = false
    local function tryHitBat()
        if hitCool then
            return
        end;
        hitCool = true
        pcall(function()
            local bat = findBat()
            if bat then
                bat:Activate()
                local ev = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                if ev then
                    ev:FireServer()
                end
            end
        end)
        task.delay(0.08,
        function()
            hitCool = false
        end)
    end
    local MIRROR_TP_DROP_THRESHOLD = 3
    local MIRROR_TP_DOWN_Y = - 7.00
    local mirrorTPPreviousY = {}
    local mirrorTPLastTeleport = 0
    local function mirrorTPAimbotActive()
        return aimbotOn() or desyncEnabled == true
    end
    local function mirrorTPTeleportDown()
        local character = LP.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return
        end
        local now = tick()
        if now - mirrorTPLastTeleport < 0.08 then
            return
        end
        mirrorTPLastTeleport = now
        local _, yaw = root.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
        root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, MIRROR_TP_DOWN_Y, root.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
        root.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        pcall(function()
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end)
    end
    local mirrorTPNextCheck = 0
    hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local now = tick()
        if now < mirrorTPNextCheck then
            return
        end
        mirrorTPNextCheck = now + 0.10
        if _G._VynxMirrorTPDown ~= true or not mirrorTPAimbotActive() then
            table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY)
            return
        end
        local character = LP.Character
        local localRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not localRoot then
            return
        end
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LP and player.Character then
                local targetRoot = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if targetRoot and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local dx = targetRoot.Position.X - localRoot.Position.X
                    local dz = targetRoot.Position.Z - localRoot.Position.Z
                    if (dx * dx + dz * dz) <= 64 then
                        local currentY = targetRoot.Position.Y
                        local previousY = mirrorTPPreviousY[player.UserId]
                        if previousY and previousY - currentY >= MIRROR_TP_DROP_THRESHOLD then
                            pcall(mirrorTPTeleportDown)
                            table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY)
                        end
                        mirrorTPPreviousY[player.UserId] = currentY
                    else
                        mirrorTPPreviousY[player.UserId] = nil
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end))
    _G.VezyStartBatAimbot = startBatAimbot
    _G.VezyStopBatAimbot = stopBatAimbot
    _G.VezyStartBatAimbotDispatch = startBatAimbot
    _G._AdaptStartBatAimbot = startBatAimbot
    _G._AdaptStopBatAimbot = stopBatAimbot
    _G._AdaptTryHitBat = tryHitBat
    _G._VioletteccFindBat = findBat
    _G._VioletteccBatAimbotRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            pcall(stopBatAimbot)
            _G._VioletteccBypassPingLoopStarted = false
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccBatAimbotRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    if aimbotOn() then
        startBatAimbot()
    end
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccDropRuntime and _G._VioletteccDropRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccDropRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local Drop = _G._AdaptDrop or {
        active = false
    }
    _G._AdaptDrop = Drop
    local function dropMode()
        return(_G._VynxDropType == "Stand Drop") and "STAND" or "JUMP"
    end
    local function combatLive()
        return autoBatToggled == true or _G._VezyBatAimbotOn == true or desyncEnabled == true
    end
    local findBat = _G._VioletteccFindBat or
    function()
        local char = LP.Character;
        if not char then
            return nil
        end
        for _, t in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if t:IsA("Tool") and(t.Name:lower():find("bat") or t.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
                return t
            end
        end
        local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        if bp then
            for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") and(t.Name:lower():find("bat") or t.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
                    return t
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function closestPlayerRoot()
        local root = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then
            return nil
        end
        local best, bd = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                local tr = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hm = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if tr and hm and hm.Health > 0 then
                    local d =(tr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < bd then
                        bd = d;
                        best = tr
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return best
    end
    local hitCool = false
    local function tryHitBat()
        if _G._AdaptTryHitBat then
            return _G._AdaptTryHitBat()
        end
        if hitCool then
            return
        end;
        hitCool = true
        pcall(function()
            local bat = findBat()
            if bat then
                bat:Activate()
                local ev = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                if ev then
                    ev:FireServer()
                end
            end
        end)
        task.delay(0.08,
        function()
            hitCool = false
        end)
    end
    local JUMP_ASCEND_DURATION, JUMP_ASCEND_SPEED = 0.18, 155
    local function runDropJump()
        if Drop.active then
            return
        end
        Drop.active = true
        _G._RaVeDropToken =(_G._RaVeDropToken or 0) + 1
        local dropToken = _G._RaVeDropToken
        local char = LP.Character
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not char or not root then
            Drop.active = false;
            return
        end
        local rayParams = _G._RaVeDropRayParams
        if not rayParams then
            rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
            rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            pcall(function()
                rayParams.RespectCanCollide = true
            end)
            _G._RaVeDropRayParams = rayParams
        end
        rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
            char
        }
        local initialFloor = workspace:Raycast(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0), Vector3.new(0, - 2000, 0), rayParams)
        if not initialFloor then
            Drop.active = false;
            return
        end
        local savedRotation = root.CFrame.Rotation
        local savedX, savedZ = root.Position.X, root.Position.Z
        local startedAt = tick()
        local conn
        conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local r = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if dropToken ~= _G._RaVeDropToken or not r or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                conn:Disconnect()
                Drop.active = false
                return
            end
            if tick() - startedAt >= JUMP_ASCEND_DURATION then
                conn:Disconnect()
                rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {
                    char
                }
                local rayResult = workspace:Raycast(r.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.35, 0), Vector3.new(0, - 2000, 0), rayParams)
                local surface = rayResult or initialFloor
                if surface then
                    local offset = hum.HipHeight +(r.Size.Y * 0.5) + 0.20
                    r.CFrame = CFrame.new(savedX, surface.Position.Y + offset, savedZ) * savedRotation
                    r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                    r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end
                Drop.active = false
                return
            end
            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, JUMP_ASCEND_SPEED, 0)
        end))
    end
    local standConns = {}
    local function runDropStand()
        if Drop.active then
            return
        end
        Drop.active = true
        local colConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not Drop.active then
                return
            end
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                    for _, part in ipairs(p.Character:GetChildren()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            part.CanCollide = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end))
        table.insert(standConns, colConn)
        local thr = coroutine.create(function()
            while Drop.active do
                RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
                local c = LP.Character
                local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if not root then
                    break
                end
                local vel = root.Velocity
                root.Velocity = vel * 10000 + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)
                RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
                if root and root.Parent then
                    root.Velocity = vel
                end
                RunService.Stepped:Wait()
                if root and root.Parent then
                    root.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
                end
            end
        end)
        table.insert(standConns, thr)
        coroutine.resume(thr)
        task.delay(0.1,
        function()
            Drop.active = false
            for _, c in ipairs(standConns) do
                if typeof(c) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
                    pcall(function()
                        c:Disconnect()
                    end)
                elseif type(c) == "thread" then
                    pcall(coroutine.close, c)
                end
            end
            standConns = {}
        end)
    end
    local function runDrop()
        local autoTPWasOn =(_G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled == true)
        local savedAutoTPHeight = tonumber(_G._VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger) or 20
        if autoTPWasOn then
            _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled = false
        end
        local function restoreAutoTPState()
            _G._VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger = savedAutoTPHeight
            if _atpBox then
                _atpBox.Text = tostring(savedAutoTPHeight)
            end
            if autoTPWasOn then
                _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled = true
            end
        end
        task.delay(0.75, restoreAutoTPState)
        if dropMode() == "STAND" then
            runDropStand()
        else
            runDropJump()
        end
        local target = closestPlayerRoot()
        if target and combatLive() then
            task.spawn(function()
                task.wait(0.06)
                local c = LP.Character;
                if not c then
                    return
                end
                local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                if not r then
                    return
                end
                r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                r.CFrame = CFrame.new(target.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0))
                r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, - 200, 0)
                r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                tryHitBat()
                task.wait(0.08)
                tryHitBat()
            end)
        end
    end
    runDropBrainrot = runDrop
    _G._AdaptRunDrop = runDrop
    _G._VynxRunDrop = runDrop
    _G._AdaptSetDropMode = function(m)
        _G._VynxDropType =(m == "STAND" or m == "Stand Drop") and "Stand Drop" or "Jump Drop"
        if _G._VynxRefreshDropType then
            pcall(_G._VynxRefreshDropType)
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccDropRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            Drop.active = false
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccDropRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccTPDownRuntime and _G._VioletteccTPDownRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccTPDownRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local FALLBACK_Y = - 7.00
    local MAX_DISTANCE = 4000
    local MAX_STEPS = 12
    local EXCLUDE_FILTER =(function()
        local ok, v = pcall(function()
            return Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        end)
        if ok and v then
            return v
        end
        local ok2, v2 = pcall(function()
            return Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
        end)
        if ok2 then
            return v2
        end
        return nil
    end)()
    local function standOffset(hum, hrp)
        local half = 1
        pcall(function()
            half = hrp.Size.Y * 0.5
        end)
        if half <= 0 then
            half = 1
        end
        local off = half * 3
        pcall(function()
            if hum and hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
                off = half * 3
            elseif hum then
                off = half +(hum.HipHeight or(half * 2))
            end
        end)
        if off ~= off or off < 1 or off > 12 then
            off = half * 3
        end
        return off + 0.15
    end
    local function rayDown(fromY, x, z, filter)
        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
        if EXCLUDE_FILTER then
            params.FilterType = EXCLUDE_FILTER
        end
        params.IgnoreWater = true
        pcall(function()
            params.RespectCanCollide = true
        end)
        local result
        pcall(function()
            result = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, fromY, z), Vector3.new(0, - MAX_DISTANCE, 0), params)
        end)
        return result
    end
    local function getGroundTPY(char, hrp, hum)
        char = char or LP.Character
        if not char then
            return nil
        end
        hrp = hrp or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then
            return nil
        end
        hum = hum or char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local filter = {
            char
        }
        pcall(function()
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
                    table.insert(filter, plr.Character)
                end
            end
        end)
        local origin = hrp.Position
        local halfY = 1
        pcall(function()
            halfY = hrp.Size.Y * 0.5
        end)
        local startY = origin.Y - halfY - 0.1
        local groundY
        for _ = 1, MAX_STEPS do
            local result = rayDown(startY, origin.X, origin.Z, filter)
            if not result then
                break
            end
            local part = result.Instance
            local skip = false
            if part then
                pcall(function()
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide == false then
                        skip = true
                    end
                    local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                    if model and model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                        skip = true
                    end
                end)
            else
                skip = true
            end
            if skip then
                if part then
                    table.insert(filter, part)
                end
                startY = result.Position.Y - 0.05
            else
                groundY = result.Position.Y
                break
            end
        end
        if not groundY then
            return nil
        end
        return groundY + standOffset(hum, hrp), groundY,(origin.Y - groundY)
    end
    local function resolveTPDownY(char, hrp, hum)
        local ok, y = pcall(getGroundTPY, char, hrp, hum)
        if ok and type(y) == "number" then
            return y, true
        end
        return FALLBACK_Y, false
    end
    local function runTPDown()
        pcall(function()
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then
                return
            end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                return
            end
            local targetY = resolveTPDownY(char, hrp, hum)
            local _, yaw = hrp.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, targetY, hrp.Position.Z) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end)
    end
    local function autoTPHeight()
        return tonumber(_G._VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger) or 20
    end
    hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled ~= true then
            return
        end
        local char = LP.Character
        if not char then
            return
        end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
            return
        end
        if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
            return
        end
        if hrp.Position.Y < autoTPHeight() then
            return
        end
        local targetY = resolveTPDownY(char, hrp, hum)
        if (hrp.Position.Y - targetY) < 0.75 then
            return
        end
        runTPDown()
    end))
    _G._VynxRunTPDown = runTPDown
    _G._AdaptRunTPDown = runTPDown
    _G._VynxSetTPDownMode = function(m)
        _G._VynxTPDownMode =(m == "half") and "half" or "full"
        return _G._VynxTPDownMode
    end
    _G._AdaptSetTpMode = _G._VynxSetTPDownMode
    _G._AdaptAutoTP = setmetatable({}, {
        __index = function(_,
        k)
            if k == "enabled" then
                return _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled == true
            end
            if k == "height" then
                return autoTPHeight()
            end
            return nil
        end,
        __newindex = function(_,
        k,
        v)
            if k == "enabled" then
                _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled =(v == true)
            elseif k == "height" then
                _G._VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger = tonumber(v) or 20
            end
        end,
    })
    _G._AdaptStartAutoTP = function()
        _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled = true
    end
    _G._AdaptStopAutoTP = function()
        _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled = false
    end
    _G._VioletteccTPDownRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccTPDownRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    _G._AceInstaResetState = _G._AceInstaResetState or {}
    local aceInstaResetState = _G._AceInstaResetState
    for _, connection in ipairs(aceInstaResetState.connections or {}) do
        pcall(function()
            connection:Disconnect()
        end)
    end
    if aceInstaResetState.cameraConnection then
        pcall(function()
            aceInstaResetState.cameraConnection:Disconnect()
        end)
        aceInstaResetState.cameraConnection = nil
    end
    aceInstaResetState.connections = {}
    aceInstaResetState.busy = false
    aceInstaResetState.busyAt = 0
    aceInstaResetState.queued = false
    aceInstaResetState.queuedUntil = 0
    aceInstaResetState.token = 0
    aceInstaResetState.cameraHeld = false
    aceInstaResetState.cameraHeldAt = 0
    aceInstaResetState.wantDie = nil
    aceInstaResetState.wantFling = nil
    aceInstaResetState.suspendAt = nil
    aceInstaResetState.speed = tonumber(aceInstaResetState.speed) or 1000000
    local ACE_RESET_HOLD = 1.5
    local ACE_RESET_FALLBACK = 1.2
    local ACE_RESET_WAIT = 8
    local aceResetStepOk, aceResetStepSignal = pcall(function()
        return RunService.PreSimulation
    end)
    local aceResetStep =(aceResetStepOk and aceResetStepSignal) or RunService.Heartbeat
    local function aceResetTrack(connection)
        table.insert(aceInstaResetState.connections, connection)
        return connection
    end
    local function aceResetFlingApi()
        return _G._AceAntiFling or _G._CandyAntiFling
    end
    local function aceResetSyncGuardVisuals()
        if VisualSetters and VisualSetters.AntiDie then
            pcall(VisualSetters.AntiDie, _G._VynxAntiDie == true)
        end
        local AG = _G._AceGuards or _G._CandyGuards
        if not AG then
            return
        end
        if AG.tglDie and AG.tglDie.SetVisual and type(AG.DieIsOn) == "function" then
            pcall(AG.tglDie.SetVisual, AG.DieIsOn())
        end
        if AG.tglFling and AG.tglFling.SetVisual and type(AG.FlingIsOn) == "function" then
            pcall(AG.tglFling.SetVisual, AG.FlingIsOn())
