    _G._AdaptSkyMode = _G._VezyCustomSkyMode or _G._AdaptSkyMode or "Off"
    _G._AdaptClearSky = function()
        for _, v in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if v:GetAttribute("_AdaptSky") then
                pcall(function()
                    v:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
        local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
        if terrain then
            for _, v in ipairs(terrain:GetChildren()) do
                if v:GetAttribute("_AdaptSky") then
                    pcall(function()
                        v:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    _G._AdaptStartSky = function(mode)
        _G._AdaptClearSky()
        local L = Lighting
        mode = mode or _G._AdaptSkyMode or "Off"
        local preset = _G._AdaptSkyPresets[mode]
        local c3 = function(t)
            return Color3.fromRGB(t[1], t[2], t[3])
        end
        if not preset or preset.kind == "off" then
            pcall(function()
                L.FogEnd = 100000;
                L.FogStart = 0;
                L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                L.Brightness = 2;
                L.ClockTime = 14;
                L.GlobalShadows = true
                L.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0);
                L.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            end)
            _G._AdaptSkyMode = "Off";
            _G._VezyCustomSkyMode = "Off"
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            L.FogEnd = 100000;
            L.FogStart = 0;
            L.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            L.ColorShift_Top = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0);
            L.ColorShift_Bottom = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            L.GlobalShadows = true;
            L.ClockTime = preset.clock or 14;
            L.Brightness = preset.brightness or 2
            if preset.outAmb then
                L.OutdoorAmbient = c3(preset.outAmb)
            end
            if preset.ambient then
                L.Ambient = c3(preset.ambient)
            end
        end)
        if preset.sky then
            pcall(function()
                local sky = Instance.new("Sky");
                sky:SetAttribute("_AdaptSky", true)
                if preset.sky.stars then
                    sky.StarCount = preset.sky.stars
                end
                if preset.sky.moon then
                    sky.MoonAngularSize = preset.sky.moon
                end
                if preset.sky.sun then
                    sky.SunAngularSize = preset.sky.sun
                end
                if preset.sky.moonTex then
                    sky.MoonTextureId = "rbxasset://sky/moon.jpg"
                end
                sky.Parent = L
            end)
        end
        if preset.atm then
            pcall(function()
                local atm = Instance.new("Atmosphere");
                atm:SetAttribute("_AdaptSky", true)
                atm.Density = preset.atm.dens or 0.3
                atm.Color = c3(preset.atm.color);
                atm.Decay = c3(preset.atm.decay)
                atm.Glare = preset.atm.glare or 1;
                atm.Haze = preset.atm.haze or 1
                atm.Parent = L
            end)
        end
        local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
        if preset.clouds and terrain then
            pcall(function()
                local clouds = Instance.new("Clouds");
                clouds:SetAttribute("_AdaptSky", true)
                clouds.Cover = preset.clouds.cover or 0.5
                clouds.Density = preset.clouds.dens or 0.5
                clouds.Color = c3(preset.clouds.color);
                clouds.Parent = terrain
            end)
        end
        _G._AdaptSkyMode = mode
        _G._VezyCustomSkyMode = mode
    end
    _G._AdaptStopSky = function()
        _G._AdaptClearSky()
        pcall(function()
            Lighting.ClockTime = 14;
            Lighting.Brightness = 2
            Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        end)
        _G._AdaptSkyMode = "Off"
        _G._VezyCustomSkyMode = "Off"
    end
    _G._AdaptSkyApply = _G._AdaptStartSky
    _G._AdaptSkyClear = _G._AdaptStopSky
    _G.VezyApplyCustomSky = function(mode)
        _G._VezyCustomSkyMode = mode or "Off"
        _G._AdaptStartSky(_G._VezyCustomSkyMode)
        if _G._VezyRefreshSkyTheme then
            pcall(_G._VezyRefreshSkyTheme)
        end
    end
    if _G._VezyCustomSkyMode and _G._VezyCustomSkyMode ~= "Off" then
        pcall(_G._AdaptStartSky, _G._VezyCustomSkyMode)
    end
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccVisualRuntime and _G._VioletteccVisualRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccVisualRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local Util = _G._AdaptUtil or {
        antilag = false,
        potato = false,
        shiny = false,
        stretch = false,
        fov = false
    }
    _G._AdaptUtil = Util do
        if _G._AdaptAntiLagDescConn then
            pcall(function()
                _G._AdaptAntiLagDescConn:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        _G._AdaptAntiLagDescConn = nil
        _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken = {}
        if type(_G._AdaptAntiLagHiddenObstacleVolumes) == "table" then
            for part in pairs(_G._AdaptAntiLagHiddenObstacleVolumes) do
                pcall(function()
                    if part and part.Parent then
                        part.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        local defaults, terrainDefaults = {}, {}
        local active, descConn = false, nil
        local queue, queueHead, queueTail, queueRunning = {}, 1, 0, false
        local hiddenObstacleVolumes = {}
        _G._AdaptAntiLagHiddenObstacleVolumes = hiddenObstacleVolumes
        local function isBaseObstacleVolume(obj)
            if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                return false
            end
            local events = workspace:FindFirstChild("Events")
            if not events or not obj:IsDescendantOf(events) then
                return false
            end
            local parent = obj.Parent
            while parent and parent ~= events do
                if parent.Name == "ObstacleVolumes" then
                    return true
                end
                parent = parent.Parent
            end
            return false
        end
        local function apply(obj)
            pcall(function()
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    if isBaseObstacleVolume(obj) then
                        if hiddenObstacleVolumes[obj] == nil then
                            hiddenObstacleVolumes[obj] = obj.LocalTransparencyModifier
                        end
                        obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                    end
                    obj.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
                    obj.Reflectance = 0
                    obj.CastShadow = false
                elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
                    obj.Transparency = 1
                elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Beam") or obj:IsA("Fire") or obj:IsA("Smoke") or obj:IsA("Sparkles") then
                    obj.Enabled = false
                elseif obj:IsA("PointLight") or obj:IsA("SpotLight") or obj:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
                    obj.Enabled = false
                elseif obj:IsA("AnimationController") or obj:IsA("Animator") then
                    for _, track in ipairs(obj:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                        pcall(function()
                            track:Stop(0)
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        local function queueObject(obj)
            if not active or not obj then
                return
            end
            queueTail = queueTail + 1
            queue[queueTail] = obj
            if queueRunning then
                return
            end
            queueRunning = true
            local token = _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken
            task.spawn(function()
                while active and token == _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken and queueHead <= queueTail do
                    local remaining = queueTail - queueHead + 1
                    for _ = 1, math.min(80, remaining) do
                        local nextObject = queue[queueHead]
                        queue[queueHead] = nil
                        queueHead = queueHead + 1
                        if nextObject then
                            apply(nextObject)
                        end
                    end
                    task.wait()
                end
                if queueHead > queueTail then
                    queue, queueHead, queueTail = {}, 1, 0
                end
                queueRunning = false
            end)
        end
        _G._AdaptStartAntiLag = function()
            active = true
            queue, queueHead, queueTail = {}, 1, 0
            _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken = {}
            local scanToken = _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken
            defaults.Brightness = defaults.Brightness or Lighting.Brightness
            defaults.FogEnd = defaults.FogEnd or Lighting.FogEnd
            defaults.FogStart = defaults.FogStart or Lighting.FogStart
            defaults.Diffuse = defaults.Diffuse or Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale
            defaults.Specular = defaults.Specular or Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale
            defaults.Ambient = defaults.Ambient or Lighting.Ambient
            pcall(function()
                Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
                Lighting.FogEnd = 1e10
                Lighting.FogStart = 1e10
                Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0
                Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
                Lighting.Brightness = 1.5
                Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local terrain = workspace.Terrain
                terrainDefaults.Decoration = terrainDefaults.Decoration ~= nil and terrainDefaults.Decoration or terrain.Decoration
                terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSize = terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSize or terrain.WaterWaveSize
                terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSpeed = terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSpeed or terrain.WaterWaveSpeed
                terrainDefaults.WaterReflectance = terrainDefaults.WaterReflectance or terrain.WaterReflectance
                terrainDefaults.WaterTransparency = terrainDefaults.WaterTransparency or terrain.WaterTransparency
                terrain.Decoration = false
                terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
                terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
                terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
                terrain.WaterTransparency = 1
            end)
            pcall(function()
                settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
                settings().Rendering.MeshPartDetailLevel = Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.Level01
            end)
            for _, effect in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                pcall(function()
                    if effect:IsA("BlurEffect") or effect:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or effect:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or effect:IsA("BloomEffect") or effect:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
                        effect.Enabled = false
                    end
                end)
            end
            task.spawn(function()
                for index, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if not active or scanToken ~= _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken then
                        return
                    end
                    apply(obj)
                    if index % 200 == 0 then
                        task.wait()
                    end
                end
            end)
            if descConn then
                descConn:Disconnect()
            end
            descConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                if active then
                    queueObject(obj)
                end
            end)
            _G._AdaptAntiLagDescConn = descConn
        end
        _G._AdaptStopAntiLag = function()
            active = false
            _G._AdaptAntiLagScanToken = {}
            queue, queueHead, queueTail = {}, 1, 0
            if descConn then
                descConn:Disconnect();
                descConn = nil
            end
            _G._AdaptAntiLagDescConn = nil
            for part, originalTransparency in pairs(hiddenObstacleVolumes) do
                pcall(function()
                    if part and part.Parent then
                        part.LocalTransparencyModifier = originalTransparency
                    end
                end)
            end
            table.clear(hiddenObstacleVolumes)
            pcall(function()
                Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
                if defaults.Brightness ~= nil then
                    Lighting.Brightness = defaults.Brightness
                end
                if defaults.FogEnd ~= nil then
                    Lighting.FogEnd = defaults.FogEnd
                end
                if defaults.FogStart ~= nil then
                    Lighting.FogStart = defaults.FogStart
                end
                if defaults.Diffuse ~= nil then
                    Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = defaults.Diffuse
                end
                if defaults.Specular ~= nil then
                    Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = defaults.Specular
                end
                if defaults.Ambient ~= nil then
                    Lighting.Ambient = defaults.Ambient
                end
                local terrain = workspace.Terrain
                if terrainDefaults.Decoration ~= nil then
                    terrain.Decoration = terrainDefaults.Decoration
                end
                if terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSize ~= nil then
                    terrain.WaterWaveSize = terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSize
                end
                if terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSpeed ~= nil then
                    terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = terrainDefaults.WaterWaveSpeed
                end
                if terrainDefaults.WaterReflectance ~= nil then
                    terrain.WaterReflectance = terrainDefaults.WaterReflectance
                end
                if terrainDefaults.WaterTransparency ~= nil then
                    terrain.WaterTransparency = terrainDefaults.WaterTransparency
                end
                for _, effect in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                    pcall(function()
                        if effect:IsA("BlurEffect") or effect:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or effect:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or effect:IsA("BloomEffect") or effect:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
                            effect.Enabled = true
                        end
                    end)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
    do
        _G._AdaptStartVisualStrip = function()
            if _G._AdaptVisualStripOn then
                return
            end
            _G._AdaptVisualStripOn = true
            _G._AdaptVisualStripConnections = _G._AdaptVisualStripConnections or {}
            for _, conn in ipairs(_G._AdaptVisualStripConnections) do
                pcall(function()
                    conn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _G._AdaptVisualStripConnections = {}
            local function isBrainrotVisual(obj)
                local heldTool = obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Tool")
                if heldTool and LP.Character and obj:IsDescendantOf(LP.Character) and LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") == true then
                    return true
                end
                for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if player.Character and obj:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
                        return false
                    end
                end
                local current = obj
                local inAnimalPodiums, animatedModel = false, false
                for _ = 1, 10 do
                    if not current then
                        break
                    end
                    local name = string.lower(current.Name or "")
                    if string.find(name, "brainrot", 1, true) then
                        return true
                    end
                    if name == "animalpodiums" then
                        inAnimalPodiums = true
                    end
                    if current:IsA("Model") and(current:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController") or current:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")) then
                        animatedModel = true
                    end
                    current = current.Parent
                end
                return inAnimalPodiums and animatedModel
            end
            local function strip(obj)
                if not _G._AdaptVisualStripOn then
                    return
                end
                pcall(function()
                    local brainrotVisual = isBrainrotVisual(obj)
                    if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                        if not brainrotVisual then
                            obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                            obj.MaterialVariant = ""
                        end
                        obj.Reflectance = 0
                        obj.CastShadow = false
                        local partName = string.lower(obj.Name or "")
                        if obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Light", true) or string.find(partName, "light", 1, true) or string.find(partName, "lamp", 1, true) then
                            obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                        end
                        if obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then
                            obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("Shirt") or obj:IsA("Pants") or obj:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or obj:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
                        obj:Destroy()
                    elseif obj:IsA("FaceControls") then
                        obj:Destroy()
                    elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") or obj:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
                        if not brainrotVisual then
                            obj:Destroy()
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
                        if not brainrotVisual then
                            obj.TextureId = ""
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("Animator") then
                        local model = obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
                        if not(model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)) then
                            for _, track in ipairs(obj:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                                pcall(function()
                                    track:Stop(0);
                                    track:AdjustSpeed(0)
                                end)
                            end
                            table.insert(_G._AdaptVisualStripConnections, obj.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(track)
                                if _G._AdaptVisualStripOn then
                                    pcall(function()
                                        track:Stop(0);
                                        track:AdjustSpeed(0)
                                    end)
                                end
                            end))
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Beam") or obj:IsA("Smoke") or obj:IsA("Fire") or obj:IsA("Sparkles") or obj:IsA("Highlight") then
                        if obj.Name ~= "AdaptESP_HL" then
                            obj:Destroy()
                        end
                    elseif obj:IsA("Light") then
                        local sourcePart = obj:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("BasePart")
                        if sourcePart then
                            sourcePart.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
                        end
                        obj:Destroy()
                    elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                        obj.Image = ""
                    elseif obj:IsA("Sky") or obj:IsA("Atmosphere") or obj:IsA("Clouds") or obj:IsA("PostEffect") then
                        if not obj:GetAttribute("_AdaptSky") then
                            obj:Destroy()
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            pcall(function()
                Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
                Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0
                Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
                Lighting.FogStart = 1e9
                Lighting.FogEnd = 1e9
                local terrain = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
                if terrain then
                    terrain.Decoration = false
                    terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
                    terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
                    terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
                    terrain.WaterTransparency = 1
                end
                for _, effect in ipairs(Lighting:GetDescendants()) do
                    strip(effect)
                end
            end)
            task.spawn(function()
                for index, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if not _G._AdaptVisualStripOn then
                        return
                    end
                    strip(obj)
                    if index % 200 == 0 then
                        task.wait()
                    end
                end
            end)
            table.insert(_G._AdaptVisualStripConnections, workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                task.defer(strip, obj)
            end))
            table.insert(_G._AdaptVisualStripConnections, Lighting.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                task.defer(strip, obj)
            end))
        end
        _G._AdaptStopVisualStrip = function()
            _G._AdaptVisualStripOn = false
            for _, conn in ipairs(_G._AdaptVisualStripConnections or {}) do
                pcall(function()
                    conn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _G._AdaptVisualStripConnections = {}
        end
    end
    local _stretchConn, _fovConn
    local function startStretch()
        Util.stretch = true
        if _stretchConn then
            _stretchConn:Disconnect();
            _stretchConn = nil
        end
        _G._VynxStretchValue = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VynxStretchValue) or 0.70, 0.3, 1.0)
        _stretchConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not Util.stretch then
                return
            end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then
                return
            end
            local value = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VynxStretchValue) or 0.70, 0.3, 1.0)
            pcall(function()
                local wantFov = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VezyStretchFOV) or 120, 70, 120)
                if cam.FieldOfView ~= wantFov then
                    cam.FieldOfView = wantFov
                end
                cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, value, 0, 0, 0, 1)
            end)
        end))
    end
    local function stopStretch()
        Util.stretch = false
        if _stretchConn then
            _stretchConn:Disconnect();
            _stretchConn = nil
        end
        pcall(function()
            workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 70
        end)
    end
    local function startFov()
        Util.fov = true
        if _fovConn then
            _fovConn:Disconnect();
            _fovConn = nil
        end
        _fovConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not Util.fov then
                return
            end
            local c = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local want = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VezyCustomFOV) or 120, 70, 120)
            if c and c.FieldOfView ~= want then
                pcall(function()
                    c.FieldOfView = want
                end)
            end
        end))
    end
    local function stopFov()
        Util.fov = false
        if _fovConn then
            _fovConn:Disconnect();
            _fovConn = nil
        end
        pcall(function()
            workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 70
        end)
    end
    _G.VezyEnableFOV = startFov
    _G.VezyDisableFOV = stopFov
    _G._VynxEnableStretchRez = startStretch
    _G._VynxDisableStretchRez = stopStretch
    local function setNoCamCollision(on)
        pcall(function()
            LP.DevCameraOcclusionMode = on and Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Invisicam or Enum.DevCameraOcclusionMode.Zoom
        end)
    end
    enableNoCameraCollision = function()
        setNoCamCollision(true)
    end
    disableNoCameraCollision = function()
        setNoCamCollision(false)
    end
    local function setHeadless(character, enabled)
        local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then
            return
        end
        local transparency = enabled and 1 or 0
        head.Transparency = transparency
        head.LocalTransparencyModifier = transparency
        for _, object in ipairs(head:GetChildren()) do
            if object:IsA("Decal") or object:IsA("Texture") or object:IsA("BasePart") then
                object.Transparency = transparency
                if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    object.LocalTransparencyModifier = transparency
                end
            end
        end
    end
    _G._KawatanSetHeadless = setHeadless

    _G._RaVeClearKorblox = function()
        local character = LP.Character
        if not character then
            return
        end
        for _, name in ipairs({
            "Korblox_LeftLeg",
            "Korblox_RightLeg",
            "RaVeKorblox_Left",
            "RaVeKorblox_Right",
        }) do
            local old = character:FindFirstChild(name)
            if old then
                pcall(function()
                    old:Destroy()
                end)
            end
        end
        for _, name in ipairs({
            "LeftUpperLeg",
            "LeftLowerLeg",
            "LeftFoot",
            "RightUpperLeg",
            "RightLowerLeg",
            "RightFoot",
        }) do
            local limb = character:FindFirstChild(name)
            if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then
                limb.Transparency = 0
                limb.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
            end
        end
    end
    _G._RaVeAttachKorblox = function(itemName)
        local config = _G._RaVeKorbloxAssets[itemName]
        local character = LP.Character
        if not config or not character then
            return false, "No character"
        end
        local targetPart = character:FindFirstChild(config.targetBodyPart)
        if not targetPart then
            return false, "Target part missing"
        end
        local oldAsset = character:FindFirstChild("Korblox_" .. itemName:gsub("%s+", ""))
        if oldAsset then
            oldAsset:Destroy()
        end
        for _, partName in ipairs(config.partsToHide) do
            local limb = character:FindFirstChild(partName)
            if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then
                limb.Transparency = 1
            end
        end
        local success, objects = pcall(function()
            return game:GetObjects(config.id)
        end)
        if not success or not objects or # objects == 0 then
            return false, "Asset fetch failed"
        end
        local assetModel = objects[1]
        assetModel.Name = "Korblox_" .. itemName:gsub("%s+", "")
        local mainMesh = assetModel:IsA("BasePart") and assetModel or assetModel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
        if not mainMesh then
            pcall(function()
                assetModel:Destroy()
            end)
            return false, "No MeshPart in asset"
        end
        mainMesh.Size = mainMesh.Size * config.scale
        mainMesh.CanCollide = false
        mainMesh.CanTouch = false
        mainMesh.CanQuery = false
        mainMesh.Massless = true
        mainMesh.CFrame = targetPart.CFrame * config.offset
        local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
        weld.Part0 = targetPart
        weld.Part1 = mainMesh
        weld.Parent = mainMesh
        assetModel.Parent = character
        if config.audio then
            local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
            sound.SoundId = config.audio
            sound.Volume = 0.5
            sound.Parent = mainMesh
            sound:Play()
            game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(sound, 3)
        end
        return true, nil
    end
    _G._RaVeApplyKorblox = function(mode)
        if mode == "Left Leg" then
            mode = "Left"
        elseif mode == "Right Leg" then
            mode = "Right"
        end
        mode =(mode == "Left" or mode == "Right" or mode == "Both") and mode or "Off"
        _G._RaVeClearKorblox()
        _G._RaVeKorbloxMode = mode
        if mode == "Left" or mode == "Both" then
            pcall(_G._RaVeAttachKorblox, "Left Leg")
        end
        if mode == "Right" or mode == "Both" then
            pcall(_G._RaVeAttachKorblox, "Right Leg")
        end
    end
    local startShiny, stopShiny do
        _G.AceShinyGraphics = _G.AceShinyGraphics or {
            shinyEnabled = false,
            runtimeOn = false,
            shinyConns = {},
            shinyOriginals = {}
        }
        local SH = _G.AceShinyGraphics
        for _, conn in ipairs(SH.shinyConns or {}) do
            pcall(function()
                conn:Disconnect()
            end)
        end
        SH.shinyConns = {}
        SH.shinyOriginals = SH.shinyOriginals or {}
        SH.runtimeOn = false
        SH.shinyEnabled = false
        local function shinePart(obj)
            pcall(function()
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    SH.shinyOriginals[obj] = SH.shinyOriginals[obj] or {
                        Material = obj.Material,
                        Reflectance = obj.Reflectance,
                        CastShadow = obj.CastShadow
                    }
                    obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
                    obj.Reflectance = 0.75
                    obj.CastShadow = false
                end
            end)
        end
        local function effect(class, name)
            local inst = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
            if inst and not inst:IsA(class) then
                pcall(function()
                    inst:Destroy()
                end)
                inst = nil
            end
            if not inst then
                inst = Instance.new(class)
                inst.Name = name
                inst.Parent = Lighting
            end
            return inst
        end
        local function applyEffects()
            local bloom = effect("BloomEffect", "AceShinyBloom")
            bloom.Intensity, bloom.Size, bloom.Threshold, bloom.Enabled = 1.6, 52, 0.75, true
            local rays = effect("SunRaysEffect", "AceShinySunRays")
            rays.Intensity, rays.Spread, rays.Enabled = 0.55, 1, true
            local cc = effect("ColorCorrectionEffect", "AceShinyColorCorrection")
            cc.Saturation, cc.Contrast, cc.Brightness, cc.Enabled = 0.9, 0.22, 0.07, true
        end
        startShiny = function()
            Util.shiny = true
            SH.shinyEnabled = true
            if SH.runtimeOn then
                pcall(applyEffects);
                return
            end
            SH.runtimeOn = true
            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                shinePart(obj)
            end
            for _, conn in ipairs(SH.shinyConns) do
                pcall(function()
                    conn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            SH.shinyConns = {}
            table.insert(SH.shinyConns, workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                if SH.shinyEnabled then
                    shinePart(obj)
                end
            end))
            pcall(applyEffects)
        end
        stopShiny = function()
            Util.shiny = false
            SH.shinyEnabled = false
            SH.runtimeOn = false
            for _, conn in ipairs(SH.shinyConns) do
                pcall(function()
                    conn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            SH.shinyConns = {}
            for obj, saved in pairs(SH.shinyOriginals) do
                pcall(function()
                    obj.Material = saved.Material
                    obj.Reflectance = saved.Reflectance
                    obj.CastShadow = saved.CastShadow
                end)
            end
            SH.shinyOriginals = {}
            for _, name in ipairs({
                "AceShinyBloom",
                "AceShinySunRays",
                "AceShinyColorCorrection"
            }) do
                local inst = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
                if inst then
                    pcall(function()
                        inst:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    do
        _G._RaVeDarkMode = _G._RaVeDarkMode or {
            enabled = false,
            saved = nil
        }
        if type(_G._RaVeDarkLevel) ~= "number" then
            _G._RaVeDarkLevel = 2
        end
        _G._RaVeSetDarkLevel = function(value)
            _G._RaVeDarkLevel = math.clamp(tonumber(value) or 2, 0.5, 6)
            if _G._RaVeDarkMode and _G._RaVeDarkMode.enabled then
                pcall(function()
                    Lighting.ExposureCompensation = - _G._RaVeDarkLevel
                end)
            end
        end
        _G._RaVeSetDarkMode = function(on)
            local state = _G._RaVeDarkMode
            if on == true then
                if not state.saved then
                    state.saved = {
                        brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
                        clock = Lighting.ClockTime,
                        outdoor = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
                        exposure = Lighting.ExposureCompensation,
                    }
                end
                state.enabled = true
                pcall(function()
                    local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChild("RaVeDarkModeSky")
                    if not sky or not sky:IsA("Sky") then
                        if sky then
                            sky:Destroy()
                        end
                        sky = Instance.new("Sky")
                        sky.Name = "RaVeDarkModeSky"
                    end
                    sky.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://159454299"
                    sky.SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://159454296"
                    sky.SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://159454293"
                    sky.SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://159454286"
                    sky.SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://159454289"
                    sky.SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://159454291"
                    sky.Parent = Lighting
                    Lighting.Brightness = 0
                    Lighting.ClockTime = 0
                    Lighting.ExposureCompensation = -(_G._RaVeDarkLevel or 2)
                    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                end)
                return
            end
            state.enabled = false
            pcall(function()
                local sky = Lighting:FindFirstChild("RaVeDarkModeSky")
                if sky then
                    sky:Destroy()
                end
                local saved = state.saved
                if saved then
                    Lighting.Brightness = saved.brightness
                    Lighting.ClockTime = saved.clock
                    Lighting.ExposureCompensation = saved.exposure
                    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = saved.outdoor
                end
            end)
            state.saved = nil
        end
    end
    do
        _G._AdaptESPColor = _G._VioletteccAccent or ACC
        _G._AdaptESPEnabled = _G._VynxAuraESP == true
        _G._AdaptESPShowBox = _G._VynxBoxedESP == true
        if type(_G._AdaptESPBoxFill) ~= "number" then
            _G._AdaptESPBoxFill = 0.72
        end
        _G._AdaptESPShowTracer = _G._VynxShowTracker == true
        local espData = {}
        local espSG = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
        espSG.Name = "AdaptESP_Visual"
        espSG.ResetOnSpawn = false
        espSG.IgnoreGuiInset = true
        espSG.DisplayOrder = - 1000
        pcall(function()
            espSG.Parent =(gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
        end)
        if not espSG.Parent then
            espSG.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        end
        local function attachHL(player, char)
            if not char then
                return
            end
            local old = char:FindFirstChild("AdaptESP_HL");
            if old then
                old:Destroy()
            end
            local col = _G._AdaptESPColor
            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Name = "AdaptESP_HL"
            hl.FillColor = col;
            hl.OutlineColor = col
            hl.FillTransparency = 0.4;
            hl.OutlineTransparency = 1
            hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
            hl.Enabled = _G._AdaptESPEnabled
            hl.Adornee = char;
            hl.Parent = char
            return hl
        end
        local function buildVisuals(player)
            local col = _G._AdaptESPColor
            local box = Instance.new("Frame", espSG)
            box.Name = "ESP_BOX_" .. player.Name
            box.BackgroundColor3 = col
            box.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            box.BorderSizePixel = 0
            box.Visible = false;
            box.ZIndex = 9999
            local boxSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", box)
            boxSt.Color = col;
            boxSt.Thickness = 1.5
            boxSt.Transparency = 0.1
            boxSt.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
            local tracer = Instance.new("Frame", espSG)
            tracer.Name = "ESP_TRACER_" .. player.Name
            tracer.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            tracer.BackgroundColor3 = col
            tracer.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
            tracer.BorderSizePixel = 0;
            tracer.Visible = false;
            tracer.ZIndex = 9998
            local offscreen = Instance.new("TextLabel", espSG)
            offscreen.Name = "ESP_DIRECTION_" .. player.Name
            offscreen.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            offscreen.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24)
            offscreen.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            offscreen.Text = utf8.char(0x25B2)
            offscreen.TextColor3 = col
            offscreen.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            offscreen.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1
            offscreen.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
            offscreen.TextSize = 21
            offscreen.Visible = false
            offscreen.ZIndex = 10002
            return box, tracer, offscreen
        end
        local function refreshESPColor(newColor)
            _G._AdaptESPColor = newColor
            for _, d in pairs(espData) do
                if d.box then
                    local st = d.box:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
                    if st then
                        st.Color = newColor
                    end
                    d.box.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
                end
                if d.tracer then
                    d.tracer.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
                end
                if d.offscreen then
                    d.offscreen.TextColor3 = newColor
                end
                if d.hl then
                    d.hl.FillColor = newColor;
                    d.hl.OutlineColor = newColor
                end
            end
        end
        _G._AdaptRefreshESPColor = refreshESPColor
        local function createForPlayer(player)
            if player == LP then
                return
            end
            if espData[player] then
                return
            end
            local box, tracer, offscreen = buildVisuals(player)
            local d = {
                box = box,
                tracer = tracer,
                offscreen = offscreen,
                hl = nil
            }
            espData[player] = d
            if player.Character then
                d.hl = attachHL(player, player.Character)
            end
            d.charConn = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
                task.wait(0.4)
                d.hl = attachHL(player, char)
            end)
        end
        local function clearPlayer(player)
            local d = espData[player];
            if not d then
                return
            end
            if d.charConn then
                pcall(function()
                    d.charConn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            for _, key in ipairs({
                "box",
                "tracer",
                "offscreen",
                "hl"
            }) do
                if d[key] then
                    pcall(function()
                        d[key]:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
            espData[player] = nil
        end
        hubConnect(Players.PlayerAdded, createForPlayer)
        hubConnect(Players.PlayerRemoving, clearPlayer)
        task.spawn(function()
            while espSG.Parent do
                task.wait(2)
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= LP then
                        if not espData[p] then
                            pcall(createForPlayer, p)
                        else
                            local d = espData[p]
                            local char = p.Character
                            if char and(not d.hl or d.hl.Parent ~= char) then
                                pcall(function()
                                    if d.hl then
                                        d.hl:Destroy()
                                    end
                                end)
                                d.hl = attachHL(p, char)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        hubConnect(RunService.RenderStepped, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera;
            if not cam then
                return
            end
            local boxOn = _G._AdaptESPShowBox == true
            local tracerOn = _G._AdaptESPShowTracer == true
            local on = boxOn or tracerOn
            local viewSize = cam.ViewportSize
            local startX, startY
            local myChar = LP.Character
            local myHRP = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if myHRP then
                local myScr = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(myHRP.Position + Vector3.new(0, - 0.5, 0))
                if myScr.Z > 0 then
                    startX = math.clamp(myScr.X, 10, viewSize.X - 10)
                    startY = math.clamp(myScr.Y, 10, viewSize.Y - 10)
                end
            end
            if not startX then
                startX = viewSize.X / 2;
                startY = viewSize.Y * 0.85
            end
            for player, d in pairs(espData) do
                local char = player.Character
                local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not on or not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then
                    d.box.Visible = false;
                    d.tracer.Visible = false
                    d.offscreen.Visible = false
                else
                    local topS = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0))
                    local botS = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, - 3.0, 0))
                    if topS.Z > 0 then
                        local boxH = math.abs(botS.Y - topS.Y)
                        local boxW = boxH * 0.55
                        local cx =(topS.X + botS.X) / 2
                        local cy =(topS.Y + botS.Y) / 2
                        d.box.Position = UDim2.new(0, cx - boxW / 2, 0, cy - boxH / 2)
                        d.box.Size = UDim2.new(0, boxW, 0, boxH)
                        d.box.Visible = boxOn
                        local dx, dy = cx - startX, cy - startY
                        local length = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
                        d.tracer.Position = UDim2.new(0,(startX + cx) / 2, 0,(startY + cy) / 2)
                        d.tracer.Size = UDim2.new(0, length, 0, 1)
                        d.tracer.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
                        d.tracer.Visible = tracerOn
                        d.offscreen.Visible = false
                    else
                        d.box.Visible = false
                        local rootS = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
                        local centerX, centerY = viewSize.X * 0.5, viewSize.Y * 0.5
                        local targetX, targetY = rootS.X, rootS.Y
                        if rootS.Z <= 0 then
                            targetX = viewSize.X - targetX
                            targetY = viewSize.Y - targetY
                        end
                        local dx, dy = targetX - centerX, targetY - centerY
                        if math.abs(dx) < 0.001 and math.abs(dy) < 0.001 then
                            dy = - 1
                        end
                        local margin = 30
                        local tx =(centerX - margin) / math.max(math.abs(dx), 0.001)
                        local ty =(centerY - margin) / math.max(math.abs(dy), 0.001)
                        local edgeScale = math.min(tx, ty)
                        local edgeX = centerX + dx * edgeScale
                        local edgeY = centerY + dy * edgeScale
                        local lineDx, lineDy = edgeX - startX, edgeY - startY
                        local length = math.sqrt(lineDx * lineDx + lineDy * lineDy)
                        d.tracer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((startX + edgeX) * 0.5,(startY + edgeY) * 0.5)
                        d.tracer.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(length, 1)
                        d.tracer.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(lineDy, lineDx))
                        d.tracer.Visible = _G._AdaptESPShowTracer == true
                        d.offscreen.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(edgeX, edgeY)
                        d.offscreen.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)) + 90
                        d.offscreen.Visible = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end))
        _G._AdaptESPSetEnabled = function(on)
            _G._AdaptESPEnabled = on and true or false
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LP and not espData[p] then
                    pcall(createForPlayer, p)
                end
            end
            for _, d in pairs(espData) do
                if d.hl then
                    d.hl.Enabled = _G._AdaptESPEnabled
                end
            end
        end
        _G._AdaptESPSetShowTracer = function(on)
            _G._AdaptESPShowTracer = on and true or false
        end
        _G._AdaptESPSetShowBox = function(on)
            _G._AdaptESPShowBox = on and true or false
        end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP then
                pcall(createForPlayer, p)
            end
        end
        _G._AdaptESPSetEnabled(_G._VynxAuraESP == true)
    end
    enableOptimizer = function()
        Util.antilag = true;
        Enabled.Optimizer = true;
        pcall(_G._AdaptStartAntiLag)
    end
    disableOptimizer = function()
        Util.antilag = false;

    _G._AdaptSetNoCamCollision = setNoCamCollision
    _G._AdaptSetAuraESP = function(on)
        pcall(_G._AdaptESPSetEnabled, on)
    end
    _G._AdaptSetHeadless = function(on)
        _G._VynxHeadless = on and true or false
        pcall(setHeadless, LP.Character, _G._VynxHeadless)
    end
    _G._AdaptSetKorblox = function(m)
        pcall(_G._RaVeApplyKorblox, m or "Off")
    end
    _G._AdaptSetAntiLag = function(on)
        if on then
            enableOptimizer()
        else
            disableOptimizer()
        end
    end
    _G._AdaptSetPotato = function(on)
        if on then
            enableUltraMode()
        else
            disableUltraMode()
        end
    end
    _G._AdaptSetShiny = function(on)
        if on then
            startRemoveAccessories()
        else
            stopRemoveAccessories()
        end
    end
    _G._AdaptSetDarkMode = function(on)
        pcall(_G._RaVeSetDarkMode, on)
    end
    do
        local lastESP, lastBox, lastTrk = nil, nil, nil
        local lastHeadless, lastKorblox = nil, nil
        local lastDark, lastDarkLevel = nil, nil
        local acc = 0
        hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            acc = acc + dt
            if acc < 0.2 then
                return
            end
            acc = 0
            local esp = _G._VynxAuraESP == true
            if esp ~= lastESP then
                lastESP = esp;
                pcall(_G._AdaptESPSetEnabled, esp)
            end
            local box = _G._VynxBoxedESP == true
            if box ~= lastBox then
                lastBox = box;
                _G._AdaptESPShowBox = box
            end
            local trk = _G._VynxShowTracker == true
            if trk ~= lastTrk then
                lastTrk = trk;
                _G._AdaptESPShowTracer = trk
            end
            local hl = _G._VynxHeadless == true
            if hl ~= lastHeadless then
                lastHeadless = hl
                pcall(setHeadless, LP.Character, hl)
            end
            local kb = _G._VynxKorblox or "Off"
            if kb ~= lastKorblox then
                lastKorblox = kb;
                pcall(_G._RaVeApplyKorblox, kb)
            end
            local dark = _G._VynxDarkModeOn == true
            if dark ~= lastDark then
                lastDark = dark;
                pcall(_G._RaVeSetDarkMode, dark)
            end
            local lvl = tonumber(_G._VynxDarkness) or 2
            if lvl ~= lastDarkLevel then
                lastDarkLevel = lvl;
                pcall(_G._RaVeSetDarkLevel, lvl)
            end
        end))
    end
    hubConnect(LP.CharacterAdded,
    function(char)
        task.wait(0.3)
        if _G._VynxHeadless then
            pcall(setHeadless, char, true)
        end
        for _ = 1, 10 do
            task.wait(0.5)
            if char.Parent == nil then
                return
            end
            local mode = _G._RaVeKorbloxMode
            if mode == "Off" then
                return
            end
            local needLeft =(mode == "Left" or mode == "Both") and char:FindFirstChild("Korblox_LeftLeg") == nil
            local needRight =(mode == "Right" or mode == "Both") and char:FindFirstChild("Korblox_RightLeg") == nil
            if needLeft or needRight then
                pcall(_G._RaVeApplyKorblox, mode)
            end
        end
    end)
    _G._VioletteccVisualRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            pcall(_G._AdaptStopAntiLag)
            pcall(_G._AdaptStopVisualStrip)
            pcall(stopShiny)
            pcall(_G._RaVeSetDarkMode,
            false)
            pcall(stopFov);
            pcall(stopStretch)
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccVisualRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    if Enabled.Optimizer then
        enableOptimizer()
    end
    if _G._VezyDisplayMode == "FOV" then
        startFov()
    elseif _G._VezyDisplayMode == "STRETCH" then
        startStretch()
    end
    if noCamCollisionEnabled then
        setNoCamCollision(true)
    end
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    local SAVE_FILE = "VioletteHub_Auto.json"
    if _G._VioletteccAutoSaveRuntime and _G._VioletteccAutoSaveRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccAutoSaveRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local canWrite =(writefile ~= nil)
    local canRead =(readfile ~= nil and isfile ~= nil)
    local GLOBAL_KEYS = {
        "_VynxSpeedMethod",
        "NormalSpeed_Normal",
        "NormalSpeed_Carry",
        "LaggerSpeed_Normal",
        "LaggerSpeed_Carry",
        "_VynxAutoSpeedOn",
        "_VynxAutoSpeedMode",
        "_VynxAutoSpeedRange",
        "_VioletteccFakeSpeed",
        "_VynxAutoStealMode",
        "_VynxAutoGrabPause",
        "_VynxAutoStealVersion",
        "_AdaptStealBarScale",
        "_VynxStealRadiusNormal",
        "_VynxStealRadiusSemi",
        "_VynxStealDelayRadius",
        "_VezyBatAimbotSpeed",
        "_VezyBatAimbotSpeedLagger",
        "_VezyBatAimbotMode",
        "_VezyBatAimbotOn",
        "_VezyAutoSwingEnabled",
        "_VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing",
        "_VioletteccAutoMedusa",

        "_AdaptInfJumpMode",
        "_VynxRagdollMode",

        "_VynxTPDownMode",
        "_VynxAutoTPDownEnabled",
        "_VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger",
        "_VynxAnimPack",
        "_AdaptAnimPack",
        "_VioletteccIntroSong",
        "_VioletteccSkipIntro",

        "_VynxDarkModeOn",
        "_VynxDarkness",
        "_VynxCustomSkin",
        "_KawatanSkinColor",
        "_VlonEBodyType",
        "_VynxAvatarESP",
        "_VynxRagdollCountdown",
        "_VynxESPSelection",
        "_VynxESPOn",
        "_VynxBodyLockOn",
        "_VynxBodyLockRange",
        "_VynxMobileBtnScale",
        "_VynxMobileCircle",
        "_VezyHideSideBtns",
        "_VezyBgOpacity",
        "_VezyBtnOpacity",
        "_VezyBgImageId",
        "_VynxInstaResetKey",
        "_VynxUILocked",
    }
    local function isScalar(v)
        local t = type(v)
        return t == "string" or t == "number" or t == "boolean"
    end
    local function collect()
        local cfg = {
            version = 1
        }
        cfg.globals = {}
        for _, key in ipairs(GLOBAL_KEYS) do
            local v = _G[key]
            if isScalar(v) then
                cfg.globals[key] = v
            end
        end
        local settingPrefixes = {
            "_Vynx",
            "_Vezy",
            "_Adapt",
            "_Violettecc",
            "_RaVe",
            "_Kawatan",
            "_Vl",
            "_Ambitious",
            "_Candy",
            "_VX7",
        }
        for key, value in pairs(_G) do
            if type(key) == "string" and isScalar(value) then
                for _, prefix in ipairs(settingPrefixes) do
                    if string.sub(key, 1, # prefix) == prefix then
                        cfg.globals[key] = value
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        cfg.keybinds = {}
        pcall(function()
            for name, kc in pairs(Keybinds) do
                if typeof(kc) == "EnumItem" then
                    cfg.keybinds[name] = kc.Name
                end
            end
        end)
        cfg.enabled = {}
        pcall(function()
            for name, on in pairs(Enabled) do
                cfg.enabled[name] = on == true
            end
        end)
        cfg.infiniteJump = Enabled.InfiniteJump == true
        cfg.jumpMode =(_G._VezyJumpMode == "Manual") and "Manual" or "Hold"
        cfg.jumpPower = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VezyInfiniteJumpPower) or 55, 20, 150)
        cfg.autoTpDown = _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled == true
        cfg.autoTpDownY = tonumber(_G._VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger) or 20
        cfg.autoStealVersion =(_G._VynxAutoStealVersion == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
        cfg.globals._VynxAutoStealVersion = cfg.autoStealVersion
        cfg.settings = {}
        pcall(function()
            cfg.settings.StealRadius = Settings.StealRadius
            cfg.settings.AutoStealEnabled = Settings.AutoStealEnabled == true
        end)
        pcall(function()
            cfg.speed = {
                family = Spd.family,
                carry = Spd.carry == true
            }
        end)
        cfg.flags = {}
        pcall(function()
            cfg.flags.autoBat = autoBatToggled == true
            cfg.flags.autoSwing = autoSwingEnabled == true
            cfg.flags.medusaCounter = medusaCounterEnabled == true
            cfg.flags.batCounter =(BC and BC.enabled) == true
            cfg.flags.noCamCollision = noCamCollisionEnabled == true
            cfg.flags.ultraMode = ultraModeEnabled == true
            cfg.flags.desync = desyncEnabled == true
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local c = _G._VioletteccAccent
            if typeof(c) == "Color3" then
                cfg.accent = {
                    math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5),
                    math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5),
                    math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5)
                }
            end
        end)
        cfg.ui = {}
        pcall(function()
            cfg.ui.scale = UI_SCALE
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local outer = _G.VynxOuterRef
            if outer and outer.Parent then
                local p, s = outer.Position, outer.Size
                cfg.ui.winPos = {
                    p.X.Scale,
                    p.X.Offset,
                    p.Y.Scale,
                    p.Y.Offset
                }
                cfg.ui.winSize = {
                    s.X.Scale,
                    s.X.Offset,
                    s.Y.Scale,
                    s.Y.Offset
                }
                if _G._VioletteccIntroActive == true then
                    cfg.ui.winVisible = true
                    cfg.ui.userHidHub = _G._VioletteccUserHidHub == true
                else
                    cfg.ui.userHidHub = _G._VioletteccUserHidHub == true
                    if cfg.ui.userHidHub then
                        cfg.ui.winVisible = false
                    else
                        cfg.ui.winVisible = true
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(_G._VlPbPos) == "table" and # _G._VlPbPos == 4 then
                cfg.stealBarPos = _G._VlPbPos
            end
            cfg.stealBarScale = tonumber(_G._AdaptStealBarScale) or 1.0
        end)
        pcall(function()
            local frame = _G._VezyMobileButtonsFrame
            local parent = frame and frame.Parent
            if parent then
                local out = {}
                for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                    if child:IsA("TextButton") and child.Name:sub(1, 3) == "MB_" then
                        local p = child.Position
                        out[child.Name:sub(4)] = {
                            xs = p.X.Scale,
                            xo = p.X.Offset,
                            ys = p.Y.Scale,
                            yo = p.Y.Offset
                        }
                    end
                end
                if next(out) then
                    cfg.mobileBtnPos = out
                    cfg.mobileBtnLayout = _G._VynxMobileLayoutVersion
                end
                if type(_G._VynxMobileShown) == "table" then
                    local hidden = {}
                    for k, v in pairs(_G._VynxMobileShown) do
                        if v == false then
                            hidden[k] = false
                        end
                    end
                    if next(hidden) then
                        cfg.mobileBtnShown = hidden
                    end
                end
                cfg.ui.mobileVisible =(_G._VezyHideSideBtns ~= true)
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if _G._VioletteccCollectPanels then
                cfg.panels = _G._VioletteccCollectPanels()
            end
        end)
        return cfg
    end
    local function apply(cfg)
        if type(cfg) ~= "table" then
            return
        end
        if type(cfg.globals) == "table" then
            for key, v in pairs(cfg.globals) do
                if isScalar(v) then
                    _G[key] = v
                end
            end
        end
        local savedAutoStealVersion = cfg.autoStealVersion
        if savedAutoStealVersion == nil and type(cfg.globals) == "table" then
            savedAutoStealVersion = cfg.globals._VynxAutoStealVersion
        end
        if savedAutoStealVersion == "V1" or savedAutoStealVersion == "V2" then
            _G._VynxAutoStealVersion = savedAutoStealVersion
        end
        if cfg.jumpMode == "Manual" or cfg.jumpMode == "Hold" then
            _G._VezyJumpMode = cfg.jumpMode
            _G._AdaptInfJumpMode = string.upper(cfg.jumpMode)
        end
        if tonumber(cfg.jumpPower) then
            _G._VezyInfiniteJumpPower = math.clamp(tonumber(cfg.jumpPower), 20, 150)
        end
        if cfg.infiniteJump ~= nil then
            Enabled.InfiniteJump = cfg.infiniteJump == true
        end
        if cfg.autoTpDown ~= nil then
            _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled = cfg.autoTpDown == true
        end
        if tonumber(cfg.autoTpDownY) then
            _G._VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger = tonumber(cfg.autoTpDownY)
        end
        if _G._VezySetJumpPower then
            pcall(_G._VezySetJumpPower, _G._VezyInfiniteJumpPower or 55)
        end
        if _G._VezyRefreshJumpModeBtns then
            pcall(_G._VezyRefreshJumpModeBtns)
        end
        if type(cfg.keybinds) == "table" then
            pcall(function()
                for name, keyName in pairs(cfg.keybinds) do
                    if Keybinds[name] ~= nil and type(keyName) == "string" and Enum.KeyCode[keyName] then
                        Keybinds[name] = Enum.KeyCode[keyName]
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        if type(cfg.settings) == "table" then
            pcall(function()
                if tonumber(cfg.settings.StealRadius) then
                    Settings.StealRadius = tonumber(cfg.settings.StealRadius)
                    Values.STEAL_RADIUS = Settings.StealRadius
                    if RadiusInput then
                        RadiusInput.Text = tostring(Settings.StealRadius)
                    end
                end
                if cfg.settings.AutoStealEnabled ~= nil then
                    Settings.AutoStealEnabled = cfg.settings.AutoStealEnabled == true
                end
            end)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRefreshThemeChips then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRefreshThemeChips)
        end
        if type(cfg.ui) == "table" then
            pcall(function()
                if tonumber(cfg.ui.scale) and _G._VynxApplyUIScale then
                    _G._VynxApplyUIScale(math.clamp(tonumber(cfg.ui.scale), 0.5, 2.0))
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                local outer = _G.VynxOuterRef
                if not(outer and outer.Parent) then
                    return
                end
                local p, s = cfg.ui.winPos, cfg.ui.winSize
                if type(p) == "table" and # p == 4 then
                    outer.Position = UDim2.new(p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4])
                end
                if type(s) == "table" and # s == 4 and(s[2] > 0 or s[4] > 0) then
                    outer.Size = UDim2.new(s[1], s[2], s[3], s[4])
                end
            end)
            pcall(function()
                if cfg.ui.userHidHub ~= nil then
                    _G._VioletteccUserHidHub = cfg.ui.userHidHub == true
                elseif cfg.ui.winVisible == false then
                    _G._VioletteccUserHidHub = false
                end
                _G._VioletteccWantMinimized = _G._VioletteccUserHidHub == true
            end)
        end
        pcall(function()
            if type(cfg.stealBarPos) == "table" and # cfg.stealBarPos == 4 then
                _G._VlPbPos = cfg.stealBarPos
                if _G._VynxApplyStealBarPos then
                    _G._VynxApplyStealBarPos()
                end
            end
            local sc = tonumber(cfg.stealBarScale)
            if sc then
                _G._AdaptStealBarScale = sc
                if _G._RaVeSetStealBarScale then
                    _G._RaVeSetStealBarScale(sc * 100 *(_G._VioletteccDeviceScale or 1))
                end
                if _G._VynxRefreshStealBarScale then
                    pcall(_G._VynxRefreshStealBarScale)
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(cfg.mobileBtnPos) ~= "table" then
                return
            end
            if cfg.mobileBtnLayout ~= _G._VynxMobileLayoutVersion then
                _G._VezyMobileBtnPos = nil
                return
            end
            _G._VezyMobileBtnPos = cfg.mobileBtnPos
            local frame = _G._VezyMobileButtonsFrame
            local parent = frame and frame.Parent
            if not parent then
                return
            end
            for key, pos in pairs(cfg.mobileBtnPos) do
                local btn = parent:FindFirstChild("MB_" .. key)
                if btn and tonumber(pos.xs) then
                    btn.Position = UDim2.new(pos.xs, pos.xo, pos.ys, pos.yo)
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            _G._VynxMobileShown = _G._VynxMobileShown or {}
            if type(cfg.mobileBtnShown) == "table" then
                for k, v in pairs(cfg.mobileBtnShown) do
                    if v == false then
                        _G._VynxMobileShown[k] = false
                    end
                end
            end
            if _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale and tonumber(_G._VynxMobileBtnScale) then
                _G._VynxApplyMobileBtnScale(_G._VynxMobileBtnScale)
            end
            if VisualSetters.MobileCircle then
                pcall(VisualSetters.MobileCircle, _G._VynxMobileCircle == true)
            end
            if _G._VynxApplyHideMobile then
                pcall(_G._VynxApplyHideMobile, _G._VezyHideSideBtns == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.HideSideBtns then
                pcall(VisualSetters.HideSideBtns, _G._VezyHideSideBtns == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.SkipIntro then
                pcall(VisualSetters.SkipIntro, _G._VioletteccSkipIntro == true)
            end
            if _G._VynxRefreshMobilePickRows then
                pcall(_G._VynxRefreshMobilePickRows)
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if type(cfg.speed) == "table" then
                Spd.SetProfile(cfg.speed.family or "normal", cfg.speed.carry == true)
            end
        end)
        local en = type(cfg.enabled) == "table" and cfg.enabled or {}
        if cfg.infiniteJump ~= nil then
            en.InfiniteJump = cfg.infiniteJump == true
        end
        local fl = type(cfg.flags) == "table" and cfg.flags or {}
        pcall(function()
            for name, v in pairs(en) do
                Enabled[name] = v == true
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if en.InfiniteJump then
                _G.VezyEnableInfJump()
            end
            if en.AntiRagdoll then
                startAntiRagdoll()
            end
            if en.AutoSteal then
                startAutoSteal()
            end
            if en.Optimizer then
                enableOptimizer()
            end
            if fl.ultraMode then
                enableUltraMode()
            end
            if en.RemoveAccessories or en.ShinyGraphics then
                startRemoveAccessories()
            end
            if en.Unwalk then
                startUnwalk()
            end
            if fl.noCamCollision then
                noCamCollisionEnabled = true;
                enableNoCameraCollision()
            end
            if fl.medusaCounter then
                medusaCounterEnabled = true;
                setupMedusaCounter(LP.Character)
            end
            if fl.batCounter then
                _G.VezyStartBatCounter()
            end
            if _G._VynxBodyLockOn and _G._VioletteccStartBodyLock then
                _G._VioletteccStartBodyLock()
            end
            if _G._VioletteccSetAvatarESP then
                _G._VioletteccSetAvatarESP(_G._VynxAvatarESP == true)
            end
            if fl.autoSwing then
                autoSwingEnabled = true
                _G._VezyAutoSwingEnabled = true
            end
            if fl.autoBat then
                autoBatToggled = true
                _G._VezyBatAimbotOn = true
                if _G.VezyStartBatAimbotDispatch then
                    _G.VezyStartBatAimbotDispatch()
                end
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            for name, v in pairs(en) do
                local setter = VisualSetters[name]
                if setter then
                    pcall(setter, v == true)
                end
            end
            if VisualSetters.AutoBat then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AutoBat, fl.autoBat == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.AutoSwing then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AutoSwing, fl.autoSwing == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.AimbotAutoSwing then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AimbotAutoSwing, _G._VioletteccAimbotAutoSwing ~= false)
            end
            if VisualSetters.AimbotAutoMedusa then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AimbotAutoMedusa, _G._VioletteccAutoMedusa ~= false)
            end
            if VisualSetters.MedusaCounter then
                pcall(VisualSetters.MedusaCounter, fl.medusaCounter == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.BatCounter then
                pcall(VisualSetters.BatCounter, fl.batCounter == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.BodyLock then
                pcall(VisualSetters.BodyLock, _G._VynxBodyLockOn == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.NoCam then
                pcall(VisualSetters.NoCam, fl.noCamCollision == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.UltraMode then
                pcall(VisualSetters.UltraMode, fl.ultraMode == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.AntiDie then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AntiDie, _G._VynxAntiDie == true)
            end
            if _G._VynxAntiDie == true then
                if type(_G.startAntiDie) == "function" then
                    pcall(_G.startAntiDie)
                end
            else
                if type(_G.stopAntiDie) == "function" then
                    pcall(_G.stopAntiDie)
                end
            end
            if VisualSetters.AntiFling then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AntiFling, _G._VynxAntiFling == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.LockUI then
                pcall(VisualSetters.LockUI, _G._VynxUILocked == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.SafeMode then
                pcall(VisualSetters.SafeMode, _G._VynxSafeMode == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.AntiBat then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AntiBat, _G._VioletteccAntiBatEnabled == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.KickWarning then
                pcall(VisualSetters.KickWarning, _G._VynxKickWarning == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.MirrorTPDown then
                pcall(VisualSetters.MirrorTPDown, _G._VynxMirrorTPDown == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.RemoveCamShake then
                pcall(VisualSetters.RemoveCamShake, _G._VynxRemoveCamShake == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.Headless then
                pcall(VisualSetters.Headless, _G._VynxHeadless == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.DarkMode then
                pcall(VisualSetters.DarkMode, _G._VynxDarkModeOn == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.AutoSpeed then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AutoSpeed, _G._VynxAutoSpeedOn == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.CustomSkin then
                pcall(VisualSetters.CustomSkin, _G._VynxCustomSkin == true)
            end
            if _G._VlonEBodyType and _G._VlonEBodyType ~= "OFF" and _G._VioletteccSetBodyType then
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(_G._VioletteccSetBodyType, _G._VlonEBodyType)
                end)
            end
            if _G._VynxCustomSkin == true and _G._VioletteccSetCustomSkin then
                task.spawn(function()
                    pcall(_G._VioletteccSetCustomSkin, true)
                end)
            end
            if VisualSetters.AutoTPDown then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AutoTPDown, _G._VynxAutoTPDownEnabled == true)
            end
            if VisualSetters.AutoTPDownY then
                pcall(VisualSetters.AutoTPDownY, tonumber(_G._VynxAutoTPDownHeightTrigger) or 20)
            end
            if VisualSetters.InfiniteJump then
                pcall(VisualSetters.InfiniteJump, Enabled.InfiniteJump == true)
            end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            for name, lbl in pairs(KB) do
                local kc = Keybinds[name]
                if lbl and lbl.Parent then
                    lbl.Text = _G._VioletteccKeyName(kc)
                end
            end
        end)
        for _, fn in ipairs({
            "_VynxRefreshSpeedModes",
            "_VynxRefreshSpeedMethod",
            "_VynxRefreshAutoSpeedMode",
            "_VynxRefreshAutoStealMode",
            "_VynxRefreshAutoStealVersion",
            "_VynxRefreshRagdollMode",
            "_VynxRefreshAimbotModeBtns",
            "_VynxRefreshAimbotSpeedInputs",
            "_VezyRefreshJumpModeBtns",
            "_VynxRefreshDropType",
            "_VynxRefreshAnimPack",
            "_VynxRefreshIntroSong",
            "_VezyRefreshSkyTheme",
            "_VezyRefreshDisplayMode",
            "_VynxRefreshDarkness",
            "_VezyRefreshCustomFOV",
            "_VezyRefreshStretchFOV",
            "_VynxRefreshESPKind",
            "_VynxSyncESPRow",
            "_VynxRefreshBodyLockRange",
            "_VynxRefreshCustomSkin",
            "_VynxRefreshBodyType",
            "_VynxRefreshHdrLockIcon",
            "_AdaptRefreshAutoPlayMode",
            "_VynxRefreshInstaResetKey",
            "_VynxRefreshDuelLaggerKey",
            "_VezyRefreshStealBarScale",
            "_VioletteccSyncMobileSpeedBtns",
            "_VynxSyncMobileBtns",
            "_VynxRefreshSpeedInputs",
            "_VynxRefreshUISizeButtons",
            "_VynxRefreshMobileBtnSizeButtons",
            "_VynxRefreshUIToggleKey",
            "VezySyncBgPicker",
            "_VynxRefreshAutoSteal",
            "_VynxRefreshKorblox",
            "_VynxRefreshAutoGrabPause",
            "_VynxRefreshStealRadius",
        }) do
            if type(_G[fn]) == "function" then
                pcall(_G[fn])
            end
        end
        task.delay(0.6,
        function()
            pcall(function()
                if _G.VezyApplyCustomSky and _G._VezyCustomSkyMode then
                    _G.VezyApplyCustomSky(_G._VezyCustomSkyMode)
                end
                if _G._RaVeApplySelectedAnimation and _G._VynxAnimPack then
                    _G._RaVeApplySelectedAnimation(_G._VynxAnimPack)
                end
                if _G._VezyDisplayMode == "FOV" and _G.VezyEnableFOV then
                    _G.VezyEnableFOV()
                elseif _G._VezyDisplayMode == "STRETCH" and _G._VynxEnableStretchRez then
                    _G._VynxEnableStretchRez()
                end
                if _G._VioletteccRestorePanels then
                    _G._VioletteccRestorePanels(cfg.panels)
                end
                if _G._VioletteccRefreshPanelBtns then
                    _G._VioletteccRefreshPanelBtns()
                end
            end)
        end)
    end
    local lastJson = nil
    local pending = false
    _G._VioletteccBootDone = false
    local function writeNow()
        if not canWrite then
            return
        end
        if not _G._VioletteccBootDone then
            return
        end
        if _G._VioletteccSettingsReset == true then
            return
        end
        pending = false
        local ok, json = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONEncode(collect())
        end)
        if not ok or type(json) ~= "string" then
            return
        end
        if json == lastJson then
            return
        end
        local writeOk = pcall(writefile, SAVE_FILE, json)
        if writeOk then
            lastJson = json
        end
    end
    local function writeSoon()
        if pending then
            return
        end
        pending = true
        task.delay(0.6,
        function()
            if pending then
                writeNow()
            end
        end)
    end
    _G.KRIXSaveNow = writeSoon
    _G.KRIXSaveNowInstant = writeNow
    saveConfig = writeSoon
    _G._VioletteccSaveNow = writeNow
    _G._VioletteccCollectConfig = collect
    _G._VioletteccApplyConfig = apply
    local acc = 0
    hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        acc = acc + dt
        if acc < 5 then
            return
        end
        acc = 0
        writeNow()
    end))
    pcall(function()
        hubConnect(LP.AncestryChanged,
        function(_, parent)
            if not parent then
                writeNow()
            end
        end)
    end)
    pcall(function()
        game:BindToClose(function()
            writeNow()
        end)
    end)
    _G._VioletteccAutoSaveRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccAutoSaveRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    if canRead and isfile(SAVE_FILE) then
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, raw = pcall(readfile, SAVE_FILE)
            if not ok or type(raw) ~= "string" then
                task.wait(2);
                _G._VioletteccBootDone = true
                return
            end

(function()

    local function clearPlayer(player)
        local bb = billboards[player]
        if bb then

                bb:Destroy()

    hubConnect(Players.PlayerRemoving, clearPlayer)

    local AVA_NEAR = 24
    local AVA_FAR = 160

    hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local on = _G._VynxAvatarESP == true
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local camPos = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
