(function()
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccBodyLockRuntime and _G._VioletteccBodyLockRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccBodyLockRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local BodyLock = {
        Enabled = false,
        PlayersOnly = true,
        UseRange = true,
        Range = tonumber(_G._VynxBodyLockRange) or 9,
        TurnSpeed = 30,
    }
    _G._VioletteccBodyLock = BodyLock
    local connection
    local charConn
    local character
    local rootPart
    local humanoid
    local function validTarget(targetHumanoid, targetRoot)
        if not targetHumanoid or not targetRoot or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return false
        end
        if BodyLock.PlayersOnly then
            local targetPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(targetHumanoid.Parent)
            if not targetPlayer or targetPlayer == LocalPlayer then
                return false
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    local function getTarget()
        BodyLock.Range = tonumber(_G._VynxBodyLockRange) or BodyLock.Range
        for _, model in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
            if model ~= character then
                local targetRoot = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local targetHumanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if validTarget(targetHumanoid, targetRoot) then
                    if BodyLock.UseRange and rootPart then
                        local distance =(rootPart.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
                        if distance <= BodyLock.Range then
                            return targetRoot
                        end
                    else
                        return targetRoot
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function stop()
        BodyLock.Enabled = false
        _G._VynxBodyLockOn = false
        if connection then
            connection:Disconnect()
            connection = nil
        end
        if rootPart then
            rootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.AutoRotate = true
        end
    end
    local function start()
        BodyLock.Enabled = true
        _G._VynxBodyLockOn = true
        if connection then
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
        connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not BodyLock.Enabled or not character or not character.Parent or not rootPart or not humanoid then
                return
            end
            local target = getTarget()
            if not target then
                rootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.zero
                humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                return
            end
            humanoid.AutoRotate = false
            local lookVector = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector
            local currentDirection = Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z)
            local offset = target.Position - rootPart.Position
            local targetDirection = Vector3.new(offset.X, 0, offset.Z)
            if currentDirection.Magnitude <= 0.001 or targetDirection.Magnitude <= 0.001 then
                return
            end
            currentDirection = currentDirection.Unit
            targetDirection = targetDirection.Unit
            local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(currentDirection:Dot(targetDirection), - 1, 1))
            local cross = currentDirection:Cross(targetDirection)
            rootPart.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0, cross.Y * angle * BodyLock.TurnSpeed, 0)
        end))
    end
    local function setupCharacter(newCharacter)
        character = newCharacter
        rootPart = newCharacter:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
        humanoid = newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
        if BodyLock.Enabled then
            task.delay(0.3, start)
        end
    end
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        task.spawn(setupCharacter, LocalPlayer.Character)
    end
    charConn = LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacter)
    BodyLock.Start = start
    BodyLock.Stop = stop
    BodyLock.Toggle = function(enabled)
        if enabled == nil then
            enabled = not BodyLock.Enabled
        end
        if enabled then
            start()
        else
            stop()
        end
        if VisualSetters and VisualSetters.BodyLock then
            pcall(VisualSetters.BodyLock, BodyLock.Enabled)
        end
        return BodyLock.Enabled
    end
    _G._VioletteccStartBodyLock = start
    _G._VioletteccStopBodyLock = stop
    _G._VioletteccToggleBodyLock = BodyLock.Toggle
    _G._VioletteccBodyLockRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            stop()
            if charConn then
                pcall(function()
                    charConn:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            charConn = nil
            _G._VioletteccBodyLockRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
    if _G._VynxBodyLockOn then
        start()
    end
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    local UIS = UserInputService
    if _G._VioletteccAutoPathRuntime and _G._VioletteccAutoPathRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccAutoPathRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local AP = {
        L = false,
        R = false,
        lRef = nil,
        rRef = nil
    }
    _G._AutoPath = AP
    _G._KawatanPathMode =(_G._KawatanPathMode == "AUTO PLAY") and "AUTO PLAY" or "NORMAL"
    local WAYPOINT_ORDER = {
        "L1",
        "LEND",
        "LFINAL",
        "R1",
        "REND",
        "RFINAL"
    }
    local WAYPOINT_DEFAULTS = {
        L1 = Vector3.new(- 474.92,
        - 7.29,
        94.61),
        LEND = Vector3.new(- 481.07,
        - 5.33,
        94.88),
        LFINAL = Vector3.new(- 471.56,
        - 6.83,
        6.73),
        R1 = Vector3.new(- 474.75,
        - 7.29,
        25.36),
        REND = Vector3.new(- 481.09,
        - 5.33,
        25.49),
        RFINAL = Vector3.new(- 470.93,
        - 6.83,
        113.65),
    }
    local NORMAL_L1 = Vector3.new(- 476.48, - 6.28, 92.73)
    local NORMAL_L2 = Vector3.new(- 483.12, - 4.95, 94.80)
    local NORMAL_R1 = Vector3.new(- 476.16, - 6.52, 25.62)
    local NORMAL_R2 = Vector3.new(- 483.06, - 5.03, 25.48)
    local function pathIsAutoPlay()
        if _G._AdaptAutoPlayMode == "Auto Play" then
            _G._KawatanPathMode = "AUTO PLAY"
        elseif _G._AdaptAutoPlayMode == "Normal" then
            _G._KawatanPathMode = "NORMAL"
        end
        return _G._KawatanPathMode == "AUTO PLAY"
    end
    local function getHRP()
        local char = LP.Character
        return char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end
    local function getHum()
        local char = LP.Character
        return char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
    local function flatTo(root, target)
        return Vector3.new(target.X - root.Position.X, 0, target.Z - root.Position.Z)
    end
    local function speedPair()
        local n, c = Spd.Values()
        return tonumber(n) or 60, tonumber(c) or 29
    end
    local function autoRouteSpeed()
        local n = speedPair();
        return n
    end
    local function forwardSpeed()
        local n = speedPair();
        return n
    end
    local function returnSpeed()
        local _, c = speedPair();
        return c
    end
    local function routeStep(target)
        local character = LP.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not root or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return false, nil
        end
        local offset = Vector3.new(target.X - root.Position.X, 0, target.Z - root.Position.Z)
        if offset.Magnitude <= 1 then
            return true, root
        end
        local direction = offset.Unit
        local speed = autoRouteSpeed()
        _G._RaVeLiveSpeed = {
            v = speed,
            t = os.clock()
        }
        local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        humanoid:Move(direction, false)
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(direction.X * speed, velocity.Y, direction.Z * speed)
        return false, root
    end
    local function tryAutoRouteSteal()
        local hook = _G._RaVeTryAutoRouteSteal
        if type(hook) == "function" then
            pcall(hook)
        end
    end
    local function clearAutoRouteMotion()
        local character = LP.Character
        local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        end
        if root then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end
    local WAYPOINT_FILE = "KawatanAutoPathWaypoints.json"
    local Waypoints = {}
    for key, value in pairs(WAYPOINT_DEFAULTS) do
        Waypoints[key] = value
    end
    _G._KawatanAutoPathWaypoints = Waypoints
    local function saveWaypoints()
        if not writefile then
            return
        end
        local plain = {}
        for _, key in ipairs(WAYPOINT_ORDER) do
            local v = Waypoints[key]
            plain[key] = {
                x = v.X,
                y = v.Y,
                z = v.Z
            }
        end
        local ok, json = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONEncode(plain)
        end)
        if ok then
            pcall(writefile, WAYPOINT_FILE, json)
        end
    end
    local function loadWaypoints()
        if not(isfile and isfile(WAYPOINT_FILE)) then
            return
        end
        local ok, data = pcall(readfile, WAYPOINT_FILE)
        if not ok then
            return
        end
        local ok2, saved = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(data)
        end)
        if not(ok2 and type(saved) == "table") then
            return
        end
        for _, key in ipairs(WAYPOINT_ORDER) do
            local entry = saved[key]
            if type(entry) == "table" and tonumber(entry.x) and tonumber(entry.y) and tonumber(entry.z) then
                Waypoints[key] = Vector3.new(tonumber(entry.x), tonumber(entry.y), tonumber(entry.z))
            end
        end
    end
    pcall(loadWaypoints)
    _G._KawatanAutoPathSetWaypoint = function(key, position)
        if not Waypoints[key] then
            return false
        end
        position = position or(getHRP() and getHRP().Position)
        if not position then
            return false
        end
        Waypoints[key] = position
        saveWaypoints()
        return true
    end
    _G._KawatanAutoPathResetWaypoints = function()
        for key, value in pairs(WAYPOINT_DEFAULTS) do
            Waypoints[key] = value
        end
        saveWaypoints()
    end
    local SPEED_MAX_ACCEL = 1600
    local SPEED_DECEL_RESPONSE = 24
    local SPEED_TURN_RESPONSE = 34
    local speedLV, speedAttachment
    local smoothedVelocity = Vector2.zero
    local lastTargetMagnitude = 0
    local function destroySpeedActuator()
        if speedLV then
            pcall(function()
                speedLV.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.zero
                speedLV.Enabled = false
                speedLV:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        if speedAttachment then
            pcall(function()
                speedAttachment:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        speedLV, speedAttachment = nil, nil
        smoothedVelocity = Vector2.zero
        lastTargetMagnitude = 0
    end
    local function getSpeedActuator(root)
        if not(root and root.Parent) then
            return nil
        end
        if not(speedLV and speedLV.Parent == root) then
            destroySpeedActuator()
            speedAttachment = root:FindFirstChild("VilonPathAttachment")
            if not(speedAttachment and speedAttachment:IsA("Attachment")) then
                speedAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
                speedAttachment.Name = "VilonPathAttachment"
                speedAttachment.Parent = root
            end
            speedLV = root:FindFirstChild("VilonPathLinearVelocity")
            if not(speedLV and speedLV:IsA("LinearVelocity")) then
                speedLV = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
                speedLV.Name = "VilonPathLinearVelocity"
                speedLV.Parent = root
            end
            speedLV.Attachment0 = speedAttachment
            speedLV.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
            speedLV.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Plane
            speedLV.PrimaryTangentAxis = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
            speedLV.SecondaryTangentAxis = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
            speedLV.ForceLimitsEnabled = true
            speedLV.ForceLimitMode = Enum.ForceLimitMode.PerAxis
            speedLV.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.zero
        end
        local force = math.max(root.AssemblyMass, 1) * SPEED_MAX_ACCEL
        speedLV.MaxPlanarAxesForce = Vector2.new(force, force)
        return speedLV
    end
    local function driveTowards(root, humanoid, moveDir, speed, dt)
        local lv = getSpeedActuator(root)
        if not lv then
            return
        end
        dt = math.clamp(dt or(1 / 60), 1 / 240, 1 / 30)
        local target = Vector2.new(moveDir.X * speed, moveDir.Z * speed)
        local magnitude = target.Magnitude
        if magnitude > lastTargetMagnitude + 0.01 or(magnitude >= 0.01 and smoothedVelocity.Magnitude < 0.01) then
            smoothedVelocity = target
        else
            local response = SPEED_DECEL_RESPONSE
            if magnitude >= 0.01 and smoothedVelocity.Magnitude >= 0.01 then
                response = smoothedVelocity.Unit:Dot(target.Unit) < 0.96 and SPEED_TURN_RESPONSE or SPEED_DECEL_RESPONSE
            end
            smoothedVelocity = smoothedVelocity:Lerp(target, 1 - math.exp(- response * dt))
        end
        lastTargetMagnitude = magnitude
        _G._RaVeLiveSpeed = {
            v = speed,
            t = os.clock()
        }
        pcall(function()
            humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        end)
        lv.Enabled = true
        lv.PlaneVelocity = smoothedVelocity
    end
    local function haltMovement(root, humanoid)
        smoothedVelocity = Vector2.zero
        lastTargetMagnitude = 0
        if humanoid then
            pcall(function()
                humanoid:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
            end)
        end
        if speedLV and speedLV.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                speedLV.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.zero
                speedLV.Enabled = false
            end)
        end
    end
    local movementLock = {
        active = false,
        controls = nil,
        jumpConn = nil,
        watchdog = nil,
        originalMoveFunction = nil,
        usedDisableFallback = false,
    }
    local function noopMove()
    end
    local function getPlayerControls()
        local ok, controls = pcall(function()
            local ps = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
            local pm = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
            if not pm then
                return nil
            end
            return require(pm):GetControls()
        end)
        return ok and controls or nil
    end
    local function applyMoveLock(controls)
        if not controls then
            return false
        end
        if controls.moveFunction == nil then
            return false
        end
        if controls.moveFunction ~= noopMove then
            movementLock.originalMoveFunction = controls.moveFunction
        end
        controls.moveFunction = noopMove
        return true
    end
    local function unlockMovement()
        if not movementLock.active then
            return
        end
        movementLock.active = false
        if movementLock.jumpConn then
            movementLock.jumpConn:Disconnect()
            movementLock.jumpConn = nil
        end
        movementLock.watchdog = nil
        local controls = movementLock.controls or getPlayerControls()
        if controls then
            pcall(function()
                if controls.moveFunction == noopMove then
                    controls.moveFunction = movementLock.originalMoveFunction or LP.Move
                end
                if movementLock.usedDisableFallback then
                    controls:Enable()
                end
            end)
        end
        movementLock.originalMoveFunction = nil
        movementLock.usedDisableFallback = false
        movementLock.controls = nil
    end
    local function playerRequestingMove()
        if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Up) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Down) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Left) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Right) then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local function lockMovement()
        if movementLock.active then
            return
        end
        movementLock.active = true
        movementLock.controls = getPlayerControls()
        movementLock.usedDisableFallback = false
        local ok = true
        if movementLock.controls then
            ok = false
            pcall(function()
                ok = applyMoveLock(movementLock.controls)
            end)
        end
        if not ok then
            movementLock.usedDisableFallback = true
            if movementLock.controls then
                pcall(function()
                    movementLock.controls:Disable()
                end)
            end
            movementLock.jumpConn = UIS.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
                if not movementLock.active then
                    return
                end
                local humanoid = getHum()
                if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    humanoid.Jump = true
                end
            end)
        end
        local token = {}
        movementLock.watchdog = token
        task.spawn(function()
            while movementLock.active and movementLock.watchdog == token do
                if not(AP.L or AP.R) then
                    unlockMovement()
                    break
                end
                local controls = movementLock.controls
                if not controls then
                    controls = getPlayerControls()
                    movementLock.controls = controls
                end
                if controls then
                    pcall(function()
                        if movementLock.usedDisableFallback then
                            controls:Disable()
                        else
                            applyMoveLock(controls)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end)
    end
    local orientConstraint = {
        hiddenPart = nil,
        targetAttach = nil,
        alignOrient = nil,
        charAttach = nil,
        charAttachOwned = false,
        originalAutoRotate = true,
    }
    local function cleanupOrientConstraint()
        if orientConstraint.hiddenPart then
            pcall(function()
                orientConstraint.hiddenPart:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        if orientConstraint.charAttachOwned and orientConstraint.charAttach and orientConstraint.charAttach.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                orientConstraint.charAttach:Destroy()
            end)
        end
        local humanoid = getHum()
        if humanoid and orientConstraint.originalAutoRotate ~= nil then
            pcall(function()
                humanoid.AutoRotate = orientConstraint.originalAutoRotate
            end)
        end
        orientConstraint.originalAutoRotate = nil
        orientConstraint.alignOrient = nil
        orientConstraint.targetAttach = nil
        orientConstraint.hiddenPart = nil
        orientConstraint.charAttach = nil
        orientConstraint.charAttachOwned = false
    end
    local function setupOrientConstraint()
        local root, humanoid = getHRP(), getHum()
        if not root or not humanoid then
            return
        end
        cleanupOrientConstraint()
        local hiddenPart = Instance.new("Part")
        hiddenPart.Name = "TerrainHelper"
        hiddenPart.Anchored = true
        hiddenPart.CanCollide, hiddenPart.CanQuery, hiddenPart.CanTouch = false, false, false
        hiddenPart.Transparency = 1
        hiddenPart.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
        hiddenPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, - 1000, 0)
        hiddenPart.Parent = workspace:FindFirstChild("Terrain") or workspace
        local targetAttach = Instance.new("Attachment")
        targetAttach.Name = "RootAttachment"
        targetAttach.Parent = hiddenPart
        local charAttach = root:FindFirstChild("RootRigAttachment")
        local charAttachOwned = false
        if not charAttach then
            charAttach = Instance.new("Attachment")
            charAttach.Name = "RootRigAttachment"
            charAttach.Parent = root
            charAttachOwned = true
        end
        local alignOrient = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
        alignOrient.Name = "PhysicsConstraint"
        alignOrient.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
        alignOrient.Attachment0 = charAttach
        alignOrient.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + Vector3.new(- 1, 0, 0))
        alignOrient.MaxTorque = math.huge
        alignOrient.MaxAngularVelocity = 90
        alignOrient.Responsiveness = 10
        alignOrient.RigidityEnabled = false
        alignOrient.PrimaryAxisOnly = false
        alignOrient.Parent = hiddenPart
        orientConstraint.hiddenPart = hiddenPart
        orientConstraint.targetAttach = targetAttach
        orientConstraint.charAttach = charAttach
        orientConstraint.charAttachOwned = charAttachOwned
        orientConstraint.alignOrient = alignOrient
        orientConstraint.originalAutoRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
        humanoid.AutoRotate = false
    end
    local function updateOrientConstraint(root)
        local ao = orientConstraint.alignOrient
        if ao and ao.Parent and root then
            ao.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(root.Position, root.Position + Vector3.new(- 1, 0, 0))
        end
    end
    local function engageAssists()
        lockMovement()
        local ok = pcall(setupOrientConstraint)
        if not ok then
            pcall(cleanupOrientConstraint)
            unlockMovement()
            return false
        end
        return true
    end
    local function releaseAssists()
        unlockMovement()
        cleanupOrientConstraint()
    end
    hubConnect(LP.CharacterRemoving,
    function()
        if AP.L then
            pcall(function()
                AP.stopL()
            end)
        end
        if AP.R then
            pcall(function()
                AP.stopR()
            end)
        end
        pcall(releaseAssists)
    end)
    hubConnect(LP.CharacterAdded,
    function()
        destroySpeedActuator()
        if not(AP.L or AP.R) then
            pcall(releaseAssists)
        end
    end)
    local alConn, arConn = nil, nil
    local alPhase, arPhase = 1, 1
    AP.stopL = function()
        if alConn then
            alConn:Disconnect();
            alConn = nil
        end
        alPhase = 1
        AP.L = false
        haltMovement(getHRP(), getHum())
        clearAutoRouteMotion()
        destroySpeedActuator()
        if not AP.R then
            releaseAssists()
        end
        if AP.lRef and AP.lRef.SetVisual then
            AP.lRef.SetVisual(false)
        end
    end
    AP.stopR = function()
        if arConn then
            arConn:Disconnect();
            arConn = nil
        end
        arPhase = 1
        AP.R = false
        haltMovement(getHRP(), getHum())
        clearAutoRouteMotion()
        destroySpeedActuator()
        if not AP.L then
            releaseAssists()
        end
        if AP.rRef and AP.rRef.SetVisual then
            AP.rRef.SetVisual(false)
        end
    end
    AP.startL = function()
        if alConn then
            alConn:Disconnect()
        end
        alPhase = 1
        AP.L = true
        if pathIsAutoPlay() then
            engageAssists()
        else
            unlockMovement()
        end
        alConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not AP.L then
                return
            end
            local root, humanoid = getHRP(), getHum()
            if not root or not humanoid then
                return
            end
            if pathIsAutoPlay() then
                updateOrientConstraint(root)
            end
            if not pathIsAutoPlay() then
                if playerRequestingMove() then
                    AP.stopL()
                    return
                end
                local reached, hit = routeStep(alPhase == 1 and NORMAL_L1 or NORMAL_L2)
                if not reached then
                    return
                end
                if alPhase == 1 then
                    alPhase = 2
                    return
                end
                if hit then
                    hit.CFrame = CFrame.new(hit.Position)
                end
                tryAutoRouteSteal()
                AP.stopL()
                return
            end
            if alPhase == 1 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.L1)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    alPhase = 2
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, forwardSpeed(), dt)
            elseif alPhase == 2 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.LEND)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    alPhase = 0
                    haltMovement(root, humanoid)
                    task.delay(0.2,
                    function()
                        if AP.L then
                            alPhase = 3
                        end
                    end)
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, forwardSpeed(), dt)
            elseif alPhase == 0 then
                return
            elseif alPhase == 3 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.L1)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    alPhase = 4
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, returnSpeed(), dt)
            elseif alPhase == 4 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.LFINAL)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    haltMovement(root, humanoid)
                    AP.stopL()
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, returnSpeed(), dt)
            end
        end))
    end
    AP.startR = function()
        if arConn then
            arConn:Disconnect()
        end
        arPhase = 1
        AP.R = true
        if pathIsAutoPlay() then
            engageAssists()
        else
            unlockMovement()
        end
        arConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            if not AP.R then
                return
            end
            local root, humanoid = getHRP(), getHum()
            if not root or not humanoid then
                return
            end
            if pathIsAutoPlay() then
                updateOrientConstraint(root)
            end
            if not pathIsAutoPlay() then
                if playerRequestingMove() then
                    AP.stopR()
                    return
                end
                local reached, hit = routeStep(arPhase == 1 and NORMAL_R1 or NORMAL_R2)
                if not reached then
                    return
                end
                if arPhase == 1 then
                    arPhase = 2
                    return
                end
                if hit then
                    hit.CFrame = CFrame.new(hit.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)
                end
                tryAutoRouteSteal()
                AP.stopR()
                return
            end
            if arPhase == 1 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.R1)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    arPhase = 2
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, forwardSpeed(), dt)
            elseif arPhase == 2 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.REND)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    arPhase = 0
                    haltMovement(root, humanoid)
                    task.delay(0.2,
                    function()
                        if AP.R then
                            arPhase = 3
                        end
                    end)
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, forwardSpeed(), dt)
            elseif arPhase == 0 then
                return
            elseif arPhase == 3 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.R1)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    arPhase = 4
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, returnSpeed(), dt)
            elseif arPhase == 4 then
                local d = flatTo(root, Waypoints.RFINAL)
                if d.Magnitude < 1 then
                    haltMovement(root, humanoid)
                    AP.stopR()
                    return
                end
                driveTowards(root, humanoid, d.Unit, returnSpeed(), dt)
            end
        end))
    end
    local function safeBlocked()
        if _G._RaVeSafeMode and _G._RaVeSafeMode.IsLocked then
            local ok, locked = pcall(_G._RaVeSafeMode.IsLocked)
            if ok and locked then
                pcall(_G._RaVeSafeMode.ForceStop)
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function setAutoLeft(on)
        if on and safeBlocked() then
            return
        end
        if on then
            if AP.R then
                AP.stopR()
            end
            AP.startL()
        else
            AP.stopL()
        end
    end
    local function setAutoRight(on)
        if on and safeBlocked() then
            return
        end
        if on then
            if AP.L then
                AP.stopL()
            end
            AP.startR()
        else
            AP.stopR()
        end
    end
    _G._VynxStartFullAutoLeft = function()
        setAutoLeft(true)
    end
    _G._VynxStopFullAutoLeft = function()
        setAutoLeft(false)
    end
    _G._VynxStartFullAutoRight = function()
        setAutoRight(true)
    end
    _G._VynxStopFullAutoRight = function()
        setAutoRight(false)
    end
    _G._VynxToggleAutoLeft = function()
        setAutoLeft(not AP.L)
    end
    _G._VynxToggleAutoRight = function()
        setAutoRight(not AP.R)
    end
    _G._AdaptSetAutoLeft = setAutoLeft
    _G._AdaptSetAutoRight = setAutoRight
    _G._VynxOnPathModeChanged = function()
        setAutoLeft(false)
        setAutoRight(false)
        pathIsAutoPlay()
    end
    hubConnect(UIS.InputBegan,
    function(input, gp)
        if gp then
            return
        end
        if not _isBindableInput(input) then
            return
        end
        if waitingForKey then
            return
        end
        local kc = input.KeyCode
        if Keybinds.AutoLeft and Keybinds.AutoLeft ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and kc == Keybinds.AutoLeft then
            setAutoLeft(not AP.L)
        elseif Keybinds.AutoRight and Keybinds.AutoRight ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and kc == Keybinds.AutoRight then
            setAutoRight(not AP.R)
        end
    end)
    _G._VioletteccAutoPathActive = function()
        return AP.L == true or AP.R == true
    end
    _G._VioletteccAutoPathRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            pcall(AP.stopL);
            pcall(AP.stopR)
            pcall(releaseAssists)
            destroySpeedActuator()
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            _G._VioletteccAutoPathRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
end)();
(function()
    local LP = LocalPlayer
    if _G._VioletteccRagdollCDRuntime and _G._VioletteccRagdollCDRuntime.Destroy then
        pcall(_G._VioletteccRagdollCDRuntime.Destroy)
    end
    local _conns = {}
    local function hubConnect(signal, handler)
        local c = signal:Connect(handler)
        _conns[# _conns + 1] = c
        return c
    end
    local HIT_TIME = 2.6
    local MEDUSA_TIME = 4.5
    local lbl = nil
    local function accent()
        return _G._VioletteccAccent or _G._AdaptESPColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
    local function buildTag(char)
        if not char then
            return
        end
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        if not head then
            return
        end
        local old = head:FindFirstChild("RaVeRagdollBB")
        if old then
            old:Destroy()
        end
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui", head)
        bb.Name = "RaVeRagdollBB"
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 44)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4.4, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        bb.ResetOnSpawn = false
        bb.LightInfluence = 0
        local t = Instance.new("TextLabel", bb)
        t.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        t.Text = ""
        t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
        t.TextScaled = true
        t.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        t.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        local g = Instance.new("UIGradient", t)
        g.Name = "CDTint"
        g.Color = ColorSequence.new(accent())
        lbl = t
    end
    if LP.Character then
        buildTag(LP.Character)
    end
    hubConnect(LP.CharacterAdded,
    function(char)
        task.wait(0.3)
        pcall(function()
            buildTag(char)
        end)
    end)
    _G._VioletteccRefreshRagdollCDColor = function()
        if lbl and lbl.Parent then
            local g = lbl:FindFirstChild("CDTint")
            if g then
                g.Color = ColorSequence.new(accent())
            end
        end
    end
    local function isMedusa(char)
        if not char then
            return false
        end
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Anchored and(part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or part.Transparency == 1) then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function isDown(hum)
        if not hum then
            return false
        end
        local st = hum:GetState()
        return hum.PlatformStand or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    end
    local function hasRagdollMarker(char, hum)
        if isDown(hum) then
            return true
        end
        for _, holder in ipairs({
            char,
            hum
        }) do
            for _, name in ipairs({
                "Ragdoll",
                "Ragdolled",
                "IsRagdolled",
                "Stun",
                "Stunned"
            }) do
                local attr = holder:GetAttribute(name)
                if attr == true or(type(attr) == "number" and attr > 0) then
                    return true
                end
                local value = holder:FindFirstChild(name, true)
                if value and value:IsA("BoolValue") and value.Value then
                    return true
                end
                if value and(value:IsA("NumberValue") or value:IsA("IntValue")) and value.Value > 0 then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        local endTime = LP:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")
        if endTime and(endTime - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) > 0 then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    local active, locked, wasTriggered = false, false, false
    local startedAt, endsAt, total, goUntil = 0, 0, HIT_TIME, 0
    hubConnect(RunService.Heartbeat, LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local char = LP.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        _G._RaVeRagdollCountdown = _G._VynxRagdollCountdown == true
        if _G._VynxRagdollCountdown ~= true then
            if lbl and lbl.Parent and lbl.Text ~= "" then
                lbl.Text = ""
            end
            active, locked, wasTriggered, goUntil = false, false, false, 0
            return
        end
        if not lbl or not lbl.Parent then
            if char then
                pcall(function()
                    buildTag(char)
                end)
            end
            return
        end
        if not hum or not root or hum.Health <= 0 then
            if active then
                active = false;
                lbl.Text = ""
            end
            return
        end
        local now = tick()
        local medusa = isMedusa(char)
        local triggered = hasRagdollMarker(char, hum) or medusa
        if triggered and not wasTriggered and not active and not locked then
            active = true
            total = medusa and MEDUSA_TIME or HIT_TIME
            startedAt = now
            endsAt = startedAt + total
            lbl.Text = string.format("%.1f", total)
        elseif active and medusa and total ~= MEDUSA_TIME then
            total = MEDUSA_TIME
            endsAt = startedAt + total
        end
        wasTriggered = triggered
        if not triggered and not active then
            locked = false
        end
        if active then
            local left = endsAt - now
            if left <= 0 then
                active = false
                locked = true
                lbl.Text = "GO"
                goUntil = now + 0.65
            else
                lbl.Text = string.format("%.1f", left)
            end
        elseif goUntil > 0 and now >= goUntil then
            lbl.Text = ""
            goUntil = 0
        end
    end))
    _G._RaVeRagdollTimer = {
        setTimes = function(hit,
        medusa)
            if type(hit) == "number" then
                HIT_TIME = hit
            end
            if type(medusa) == "number" then
                MEDUSA_TIME = medusa
            end
        end,
    }
    _G._VioletteccRagdollCDRuntime = {
        Destroy = function()
            for _,
            c in ipairs(_conns) do
                pcall(function()
                    c:Disconnect()
                end)
            end
            _conns = {}
            local char = LP.Character
            local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local bb = head and head:FindFirstChild("RaVeRagdollBB")
            if bb then
                pcall(function()
                    bb:Destroy()
                end)
            end
            lbl = nil
            _G._VioletteccRagdollCDRuntime = nil
        end,
    }
end)();

    _G._VioletteccFadeIntroSong = function(dur)

        local snd = _G._VioletteccIntroSound
        _G._VioletteccIntroSongToken =(_G._VioletteccIntroSongToken or 0) + 1
        _G._VioletteccIntroSound = nil
        if not snd then
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            TweenService:Create(snd, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
                Volume = 0
            }):Play()
        end)
        task.delay(dur + 0.05,
        function()
            pcall(function()
                snd:Stop()
            end)
            pcall(function()
                snd:Destroy()
            end)
        end)
    end
    _G._VioletteccGetIntroSongAsset = function(name)
        local entry = _G._VioletteccIntroSongs[name]
        if not entry then
            return nil
        end
        if _G._VioletteccIntroSongCache[name] then
            return _G._VioletteccIntroSongCache[name]
        end
        local asset = getcustomasset or getsynasset
        if type(asset) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then
            return nil
        end
        local onDisk = false
        pcall(function()
            onDisk = type(isfile) == "function" and isfile(entry.file) and true or false
        end)
        if not onDisk then
            local ok, body = pcall(function()
                return game:HttpGet(entry.url)
            end)
            if not ok or type(body) ~= "string" or # body == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            if not pcall(writefile, entry.file, body) then
                return nil
            end
        end
        local ok, id = pcall(asset, entry.file)
        if not ok or not id then
            return nil
        end
        _G._VioletteccIntroSongCache[name] = id
        return id
    end
    _G._VioletteccPlayIntroSong = function(name, preview)
        _G._VioletteccStopIntroSong()
        if name == nil then
            name = _G._VioletteccIntroSong
        end
        if name == "Off" then
            _G._VioletteccIntroSong = "Off";
            return
        end
        if not _G._VioletteccIntroSongs[name] then
            return
        end
        _G._VioletteccIntroSong = name
        local token = _G._VioletteccIntroSongToken
        task.spawn(function()
            local id = _G._VioletteccGetIntroSongAsset(name)
            if token ~= _G._VioletteccIntroSongToken or not id then
                return
            end
            local snd = Instance.new("Sound")
            snd.Name = preview and "VioletteIntroPreview" or "VioletteIntroMusic"
            snd.SoundId = id
            snd.Volume = INTRO_VOLUME
            snd.Looped = false
            snd.Parent = SoundService
            _G._VioletteccIntroSound = snd
            if not preview then
                snd.Ended:Connect(function()
                    if _G._VioletteccFinishIntro then
                        pcall(_G._VioletteccFinishIntro)
                    end
                end)
            end
            pcall(function()
                snd:Play()
            end)
        end)
    end

    local function blockRemote()
        local rrs = game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
        if not rrs then
            return nil
        end
        for _, name in ipairs({
            "SetPlayerBlockList",
            "UpdatePlayerBlockList",
            "SetBlockList",
            "UpdateBlockList"
        }) do
            local r = rrs:FindFirstChild(name)
            if r and r:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                return r
            end
        end
        for _, c in ipairs(rrs:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("RemoteEvent") and c.Name:find("Block") then
                return c
            end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function fireBlockList(payload)
        local r = blockRemote()
        if not r then
            return false
        end
        return pcall(function()
            r:FireServer(payload)
        end)
    end
    local SB_DEPTH = 90
    local SB_DELAY = 0.12
    local sbState = {
        running = false,
        thread = nil,
        bomb = nil
    }
    local function sbBuild(power, depth)
        local maintable = {}
        local spammed = {
            {}
        }
        local z = spammed[1]
        for _ = 1, depth do
            local t = {};
            table.insert(z, t);
            z = t
        end
        local maximum = math.floor((power or 100000) /(depth + 2))
        for _ = 1, maximum do
            table.insert(maintable, spammed)
        end
        return maintable
    end
    local function sbFire(bomb)
        local rrs = game:FindFirstChild("RobloxReplicatedStorage")
        local direct = rrs and rrs:FindFirstChild("SetPlayerBlockList")
        if direct then
            pcall(function()
                direct:FireServer(bomb)
            end)
        else
            fireBlockList(bomb)
        end
    end
    local function sbStop()
        if not sbState.running then
            return
        end
        sbState.running = false
        if sbState.thread then
            pcall(function()
                task.cancel(sbState.thread)
            end);
            sbState.thread = nil
        end
        sbState.bomb = nil
        pcall(function()
            NetworkClient:SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(0)
        end)
    end
    local function sbStart()
        if sbState.running then
            return
        end
        sbState.running = true
        pcall(function()
            NetworkClient:SetOutgoingKBPSLimit(math.huge)
        end)
        local power = math.clamp(tonumber(_G._VioletteccSpeedBypass and _G._VioletteccSpeedBypass.power) or 100000, 10000, 150000)
        sbState.bomb = sbBuild(power, SB_DEPTH)
        sbState.thread = task.spawn(function()
            while sbState.running do
                if sbState.bomb then
                    sbFire(sbState.bomb)
                end
                task.wait(SB_DELAY)
            end
        end)
    end

    local plState = {
        running = false,
        remote = nil
    }
    local plBrainrotMode, plLastBrainrot, plManualOverride = false, false, false
    local function plFindRemote()
        return blockRemote()
    end
    local function plPayload(power)
        local main = {}
        local nested = {
            {}
        }
        local current = nested[1]
        for _ = 1, 186 do
            local t = {};
            table.insert(current, t);
            current = t
        end
        local maxRep = math.min(math.floor((power or 100000) / 188), 10000)
        for _ = 1, maxRep do
            table.insert(main, nested)
        end
        return main
    end
    local function plLoop()
        local st = _G._VioletteccPingLagger
        local delay = tonumber(st and st.interval) or 0.125
        while plState.running do
            if not(plState.remote and plState.remote.Parent) then
                plState.remote = plFindRemote()
            end
            if not plState.remote then
                break
            end
            local ok = pcall(function()
                plState.remote:FireServer(plPayload(tonumber(st and st.speed) or 100000))
            end)
            if ok then
                delay = math.max(delay * 0.995, 0.05)
            else
                delay = math.min(delay * 1.5, 0.5)
            end
            task.wait(delay)
        end
        plState.running = false
    end
    local function plStart()
        if plState.running then
            return
        end
        plState.remote = plFindRemote()
        if not plState.remote then
            return false
        end
        plState.running = true
        task.spawn(plLoop)
        return true
    end
    local function plStop()
        plState.running = false
    end
    _G._VioletteccPingLaggerFlip = function(state, isManual)
        state = state == true
        local st = _G._VioletteccPingLagger
        if isManual then
            plManualOverride = plBrainrotMode and not state or false
        end
        st.enabled = state
        if state then
            if plStart() == false then
                st.enabled = false
            end
        else
            plStop()
        end
        if _G._VioletteccPingLaggerRefresh then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccPingLaggerRefresh)
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccPingLaggerApply = function(on)
        _G._VioletteccPingLaggerFlip(on, false)
    end

            if plBrainrotMode then
                plBrainrotMode, plLastBrainrot = false, false
            end
            return
        end
        local char = LP.Character
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then
            return
        end
        local hasBrainrot = hum.WalkSpeed < 25
        if hasBrainrot and not plLastBrainrot then
            plBrainrotMode, plLastBrainrot, plManualOverride = true, true, false
            _G._VioletteccPingLaggerFlip(true, false)
        elseif not hasBrainrot and plLastBrainrot then
            plBrainrotMode, plLastBrainrot, plManualOverride = false, false, false
            _G._VioletteccPingLaggerFlip(false, false)
        end
    end))

    end
    local function pnlDrag(frame, handle, key)
        local held, from, start, ref
        pnlHomes[key] = {
            frame = frame,
            home = frame.Position
        }
        local saved = _G._VioletteccPanelPos and _G._VioletteccPanelPos[key]
        if type(saved) == "table" and # saved == 4 then
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(saved[1], saved[2], saved[3], saved[4])
        end
        handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(p)
            local t = p.UserInputType
            if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                held, from, start, ref = true, p.Position, frame.Position, p
            end
        end)
        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(p)
            if not held then
                return
            end
            if p.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or p == ref then
                local dl = p.Position - from
                frame.Position = UDim2.new(start.X.Scale, start.X.Offset + dl.X, start.Y.Scale, start.Y.Offset + dl.Y)
            end
        end)
        UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(p)
            if held and(p == ref or p.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or p.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                held, ref = false, nil
                local la = frame.Position
                _G._VioletteccPanelPos = _G._VioletteccPanelPos or {}
                _G._VioletteccPanelPos[key] = {
                    la.X.Scale,
                    la.X.Offset,
                    la.Y.Scale,
                    la.Y.Offset
                }
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function addPower(card, order, onFlip, setLit)
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", card)
        btn.Name = "PowerButton"
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34);
        btn.LayoutOrder = order
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = C_CTRL;
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0;
        btn.AutoButtonColor = false
        btn.Text = "Enable";
        btn.TextColor3 = C_DIM
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold;
        btn.TextSize = 14;
        btn.ZIndex = 61
        corner(btn, 9)
        local bStroke = stroke(btn, C_LINE, 1, 0.5)
        local api = {}
        function api.SetVisual(on)
            btn.Text = on and "Disable" or "Enable"
            TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.14), {
                BackgroundColor3 = on and accent() or C_CTRL,
                TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(0,
                0,
                0) or C_DIM,
            }):Play()
            bStroke.Color = on and accent() or C_LINE
            bStroke.Transparency = on and 0.1 or 0.5
            if setLit then
                setLit(on)
            end
        end
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(onFlip)
        table.insert(pnlRefresh,
        function()
            if api.Refresh then
                api.Refresh()
            end
        end)
        return api, btn
    end

    local function panelTag(st)
        if st == _G._VioletteccDuelLagger then
            return "panel:duelLagger"
        elseif st == _G._VioletteccPingLagger then
            return "panel:pingLagger"
        elseif st == _G._VioletteccSpeedBypass then
            return "panel:speedBypass"
        end
        return nil
    end
    local panelKeyDraws = {}
    local function bindKey(chip, state, onPress)
        local function draw()
            local kc = state.key and Enum.KeyCode[state.key]
            chip.Text = kc and _G._VioletteccKeyName(kc) or "None"
        end
        draw()
        panelKeyDraws[# panelKeyDraws + 1] = draw
        chip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            chip.Text = "..."
            if _G._VioletteccBeginKeyCapture then
                _G._VioletteccBeginKeyCapture()
            end
            local conn;
            conn = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, g)
                if not(i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or isGamepad(i)) then
                    return
                end
                local kc = i.KeyCode
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
                    draw();
                    if _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture then
                        _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture()
                    end;
                    conn:Disconnect();
                    return
                end
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace then
                    state.key = nil;
                    draw()
                    if _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture then
                        _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture()
                    end
                    conn:Disconnect()
                    if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                        pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                    end
                    return
                end
                if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
                    return
                end
                state.key = kc.Name
                if _G._AdaptKeybindSteal then
                    pcall(_G._AdaptKeybindSteal, kc, panelTag(state))
                end
                draw()
                if _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture then
                    _G._VioletteccEndKeyCapture()
                end
                conn:Disconnect()
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end)
        end)
        panelList[# panelList + 1] = {
            state = state,
            onPress = onPress
        }
        return draw
    end
    _G._VioletteccRefreshAllPanelKeys = function()
        for _, d in ipairs(panelKeyDraws) do
            pcall(d)
        end
    end
    do

            power.SetVisual(st.enabled)

                pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)

        modeRow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        modeRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
        local ml = Instance.new("UIListLayout", modeRow)
        ml.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
        ml.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
        ml.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
        ml.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
        local modeBtns = {}
        local function refreshModes()
            for _, m in ipairs(DL_MODES) do
                local b = modeBtns[m]
                if b then
                    local on =(m == st.mode)
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = on and accent() or C_KEY
                    b.TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0) or C_DIM
                end
            end
        end
        for i, m in ipairs(DL_MODES) do
            local b = Instance.new("TextButton", modeRow)
            b.LayoutOrder = i
            b.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, - 4, 1, 0)
            b.BackgroundColor3 = C_KEY;
            b.BorderSizePixel = 0;
            b.AutoButtonColor = false
            b.Text = m;
            b.TextColor3 = C_DIM
            b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold;
            b.TextSize = 11;
            b.ZIndex = 62
            corner(b, 8);
            stroke(b, C_LINE, 1, 0.6)
            modeBtns[m] = b
            b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                if st.mode ~= m then
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = C_CTRL;
                    b.TextColor3 = C_TXT
                end
            end)
            b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                if st.mode ~= m then
                    b.BackgroundColor3 = C_KEY;
                    b.TextColor3 = C_DIM
                end
            end)
            b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if st.mode == m then
                    return
                end
                st.mode = m
                refreshModes()
                if _G.KRIXSaveNow then
                    pcall(_G.KRIXSaveNow)
                end
            end)
        end
        table.insert(pnlRefresh, refreshModes)
        power = addPower(card, 1,
        function()
            flip()
        end, setLit)
        local keyRow = addRow(body, 3, "Keybind", 62)
        local keyChip = addChip(keyRow, 62, "None", false)
        drawKey = bindKey(keyChip, st,
        function()
            flip()
        end)
        power.Refresh = function()
            power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
        end
        power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
        refreshModes()
        _G._VioletteccShowDuelLagger = function(on)
            gui.Enabled = on == true
            if not gui.Enabled then
                flip(false)
            end
        end
        _G._VioletteccDuelLaggerRefresh = function()
            drawKey();
            refreshModes();
            power.SetVisual(st.enabled)
        end
    end

    _G._VioletteccShowPanel = function(key, on)
        if on and _G._VioletteccIntroActive then
            _G._VioletteccPanelOpen[key] = true
            return
        end
        if key == "duelLagger" and _G._VioletteccShowDuelLagger then
            _G._VioletteccShowDuelLagger(on)
        elseif key == "pingLagger" and _G._VioletteccShowPingLagger then
            _G._VioletteccShowPingLagger(on)
        elseif key == "speedBypass" and _G._VioletteccShowSpeedBypass then
            _G._VioletteccShowSpeedBypass(on)
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccRefreshPanels = function()
        for _, fn in ipairs(pnlRefresh) do
            pcall(fn)
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccResetPanels = function()
        _G._VioletteccPanelPos = {}
        for _, nh in pairs(pnlHomes) do
            pcall(function()
                nh.frame.Position = nh.home
            end)
        end
        for _, key in ipairs({
            "duelLagger",
            "pingLagger",
            "speedBypass"
        }) do
            _G._VioletteccPanelOpen[key] = false
            pcall(_G._VioletteccShowPanel, key, false)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRefreshPanelBtns then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRefreshPanelBtns)
        end
    end
    _G._VioletteccRevealPanels = function()
        local queue = {
            {
                "duelLagger",
                _G._VioletteccPanelOpen.duelLagger == true
            },
            {
                "pingLagger",
                _G._VioletteccPanelOpen.pingLagger == true
            },
            {
                "speedBypass",
                _G._VioletteccPanelOpen.speedBypass == true
            },
        }
        local step = 0
        for _, q in ipairs(queue) do
            if q[2] then
                task.delay(step * 0.12,
                function()
                    pcall(_G._VioletteccShowPanel, q[1], true)
                end)
                step = step + 1
            else
                pcall(_G._VioletteccShowPanel, q[1], false)
            end
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRefreshPanels then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRefreshPanels)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRefreshPanelBtns then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRefreshPanelBtns)
        end
    end
    UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
        if gpe then
            return
        end
        if _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive and _G._VioletteccKeyCaptureActive() then
            return
        end
        if not(input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or isGamepad(input)) then
            return
        end
        local name = input.KeyCode.Name
        for _, p in ipairs(panelList) do
            if p.state.key and p.state.key == name then
                pcall(p.onPress)
            end
        end
    end)
    _G._VioletteccCollectPanels = function()
        local dl, sb, pl = _G._VioletteccDuelLagger, _G._VioletteccSpeedBypass, _G._VioletteccPingLagger
        return {
            open = {
                duelLagger = _G._VioletteccPanelOpen.duelLagger == true,
                pingLagger = _G._VioletteccPanelOpen.pingLagger == true,
                speedBypass = _G._VioletteccPanelOpen.speedBypass == true,
            },
            pos = _G._VioletteccPanelPos,
            keys = {
                duelLagger = dl.key,
                speedBypass = sb.key,
                pingLagger = pl.key
            },
            bypassPower = sb.power,
            pingSpeed = pl.speed,
            pingDelay = pl.interval,
            pingAuto = pl.autoBrainrot == true,
            duelMode = dl.mode,
            duelScale = dl.scale,
            duelMini = dl.minimized == true,
            duelLocked = dl.locked == true,
        }
    end
    _G._VioletteccRestorePanels = function(saved)
        if type(saved) ~= "table" then
            return
        end
        if type(saved.pos) == "table" then
            _G._VioletteccPanelPos = saved.pos
            for key, nh in pairs(pnlHomes) do
                local p = saved.pos[key]
                if nh.frame and type(p) == "table" and # p == 4 then
                    nh.frame.Position = UDim2.new(p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4])
                end
            end
        end
        if type(saved.open) == "table" then
            for k, v in pairs(saved.open) do
                _G._VioletteccPanelOpen[k] = v == true
            end
        end
        local dl, sb, pl = _G._VioletteccDuelLagger, _G._VioletteccSpeedBypass, _G._VioletteccPingLagger
        if type(saved.keys) == "table" then
            dl.key, sb.key, pl.key = saved.keys.duelLagger, saved.keys.speedBypass, saved.keys.pingLagger
        end
        do
            local m = saved.duelMode
            if m == "LOW" or m == "MID" or m == "HIGH" or m == "ULTRA" then
                dl.mode = m
            end
            if tonumber(saved.duelScale) then
                dl.scale = math.clamp(tonumber(saved.duelScale), 0.7, 1.5)
            end
            dl.minimized = saved.duelMini == true
            dl.locked = saved.duelLocked == true
        end
        if tonumber(saved.bypassPower) then
            sb.power = math.clamp(math.floor(saved.bypassPower), 10000, 150000)
        end
        if tonumber(saved.pingSpeed) then
            pl.speed = math.clamp(math.floor(saved.pingSpeed), 1000, 500000)
        end
        if tonumber(saved.pingDelay) then
            pl.interval = math.clamp(saved.pingDelay, 0.01, 1)
        end
        pl.autoBrainrot = saved.pingAuto == true
        if _G._VioletteccDuelLaggerRefresh then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccDuelLaggerRefresh)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccPingLaggerRefresh then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccPingLaggerRefresh)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccSpeedBypassRefresh then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccSpeedBypassRefresh)
        end
        if _G._VioletteccRevealPanels then
            pcall(_G._VioletteccRevealPanels)
        end
    end
end)();

        local KAWATAN_SKIN_COLORS = {}
        local function applyKawatanSkinColor(character)
            local char = character or LP.Character
            local tint = KAWATAN_SKIN_COLORS[_G._KawatanSkinColor or "1"]
            if not char or not tint then
                return
            end
            for _, object in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local current = object
                    local belongsToSkin = false
                    while current and current ~= char do
                        if current:GetAttribute("_VlonESkin") then
                            belongsToSkin = true;
                            break
                        end
                        current = current.Parent
                    end
                    if belongsToSkin then
                        object.Color = tint
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local vloneSkinEnabled = false

        local function isVlonEAccessoryAllowed(assetId)
            local id = tonumber(assetId)
            if not id then
                return false
            end
            local skin = getVlonESkin()
            for _, allowed in ipairs(skin.accessories or {}) do
                if id == allowed then
                    return true
                end
            end
            for _, allowed in ipairs(skin.clothing or {}) do
                if id == allowed then
                    return true
                end
            end
            for _, list in ipairs({
                skin.hats,
                skin.hair
            }) do
                for entry in tostring(list or ""):gmatch("%d+") do
                    if id == tonumber(entry) then
                        return true
                    end
                end
            end
            return false
        end
        local function markVlonESkin(instance)
            pcall(function()
                instance:SetAttribute("_VlonESkin", true)

        local function clearVlonESkinObjects(character)

        (function()
            local SCALE_VALUES = {
                "BodyDepthScale",
                "BodyHeightScale",
                "BodyWidthScale",
                "HeadScale",
                "BodyProportionScale",
                "BodyTypeScale",
            }
            local BODY_TYPES = {

                        Torso = 86499666,

                _G._VlonEBodyType = "OFF"
